summary.innovation: 将人类逆转录病毒探索与IL-2发现史建立关联；揭示基础病毒学研究意外催生免疫治疗；为免疫治疗起源提供历史性解释
summary.significance: 该研究强调基础科学中意外发现的重要价值，说明病毒学与免疫学交叉可带来关键突破。其历史梳理有助于理解IL-2和免疫治疗的发展脉络，并为未来转化研究提供启示。

papers.title: Extensive and differential platinum chemotherapy mutagenesis in livers of children
papers.abstract: Childhood cancer survivors often experience late adverse effects that may be linked to chemotherapy mutagenesis. We studied chemotherapy mutagenesis in normal pediatric tissues using duplex sequencing (NanoSeq) to enable the detection of mutations from single DNA molecules. We found that platinum chemotherapeutics increased the mutation burdens of normal pediatric tissues to levels seen in adults. In the liver, platinum agents imparted a tissue-specific mutational signature that was absent from other tissues. Gene-focused duplex sequencing revealed that chemotherapy mutagenesis generates a great diversity of nonsynonymous variants, some of which may have functional potential, such as leukemogenic variants in blood. Our findings demonstrate extensive chemotherapy mutagenesis in normal tissues of children, which may provide a plausible link between chemotherapy exposure and adverse effects in later life.

summary.one_liner: NanoSeq双链测序揭示铂类化疗在儿童正常组织广泛致突变，并在肝脏产生组织特异突变特征。
summary.innovation: 应用NanoSeq双链测序以单DNA分子分辨率检测儿童正常组织的化疗致突变；发现铂类化疗使儿童正常组织突变负荷升至成人水平，并揭示肝脏特异性铂类突变特征；基因靶向测序发现化疗产生大量非同义变异，部分具潜在功能如血液白血病相关变异
summary.significance: 该研究为儿童癌症幸存者远期不良反应与化疗致突变之间提供了直接分子证据。其提示需关注铂类化疗的长期基因组毒性，并可能指导儿童肿瘤治疗优化与幸存者远期随访。未来或可基于突变特征评估二次肿瘤及器官损伤风险。

papers.title: A bispecific CD3×CD19 antibody for systemic lupus erythematosus: a phase 1 trial
papers.abstract: Early-phase studies of deep B cell depletion with anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T have produced prolonged, drug-free remission in refractory autoimmune disease. However, CAR T cell therapy requires lymphodepleting chemotherapy, autologous cell manufacturing and specialized infrastructure, limiting reach to a fraction of patients who might benefit. Bispecific T cell engagers (TCEs) offer a potent, off-the-shelf approach to deep B cell depletion; however, controlled clinical evaluation in rheumatic disease remains limited. Here we report results from the intravenous treatment arm of an ongoing, first-in-disease, phase 1 trial of A-319, a next-generation CD3×CD19 TCE, in 12 patients with active systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) with 52 weeks of follow-up. Patients received A-319 (0.3−1.2 μg kg−1) three times weekly for 3 weeks after 1 week of priming doses (0.05 μg kg−1). The primary endpoint was safety and tolerability. A-319 demonstrated a favorable safety profile, with no treatment-related serious adverse events, deaths, grade 3 or higher cytokine release syndrome (CRS) or neurotoxicity; CRS was predominantly grade 1 (91.6%, 11/12), and hematologic toxicity was minimal. Secondary endpoints (pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and immunogenicity) demonstrated linear pharmacokinetics and dose-dependent B cell depletion, with complete peripheral depletion in higher-dose cohorts. Among exploratory efficacy endpoints, 80% (8/10) of patients achieved Lupus Low Disease Activity State (LLDAS), and 60% (6/10) achieved Definition of Remission in SLE (DORIS) at 12 months, accompanied by sustained reductions in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Disease Activity Index 2000 (SLEDAI-2K) scores, autoantibody titers and proteinuria. Exploratory serial single-cell RNA sequencing revealed broad immune reprogramming mechanistically similar to that after CD19 CAR T cell therapy in SLE, including multi-lineage suppression of SLE-associated interferon response signatures across B cell, T cell and myeloid compartments and near-complete reconstitution of the B cell repertoire. Together, these findings demonstrate the feasibility, safety and preliminary efficacy of CD3×CD19 T cell engagement in SLE and support further clinical development of TCEs in controlled, pivotal studies. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06400537 . In a phase 1 trial evaluating intravenous delivery of a next-generation CD3×CD19 bispecific T cell engager in patients with active systemic lupus erythematosus, treatment was well tolerated, and there were improvements in disease activity scores for most patients.

summary.one_liner: 首项CD3×CD19双抗A-319治疗活动性SLE的1期试验显示良好安全性、B细胞清除及高缓解率。
summary.innovation: 首次在SLE中开展CD3×CD19双特异T细胞衔接器的first-in-disease 1期试验，验证静脉给药可行性与安全性；无需淋巴清除化疗和自体细胞制造，提供现货型深度B细胞清除策略；结合单细胞RNA测序揭示与CD19 CAR-T相似的免疫重编程，包括多谱系干扰素信号抑制和B细胞库重建。
summary.significance: 为难治性SLE提供了可及性更高、无需个体化制造的现货型治疗选择，有望补充或替代部分CAR-T治疗。初步疗效和机制证据支持后续对照关键性研究，并拓展T细胞衔接器在自身免疫病中的应用前景。

papers.title: High-accuracy glycan de novo prediction for N- and O-linked glycopeptides across multiple fragmentation techniques
papers.abstract: N- and O-glycosylation are structurally diverse post-translational modifications that affect a range of biological functions. Glycoproteomics faces substantial challenges, particularly in the analysis of O-glycans due to their diversity compared to that of N-glycans. In addition, tandem mass spectrometry data patterns exhibit variability between different fragmentation methods. Existing de novo algorithms often lack sensitivity and are limited to sceHCD fragmentation, restricting their practical application. To address these limitations, we introduce DeepGlycan, a deep-learning-based method for de novo glycopeptide sequencing that captures relationships between glycopeptide spectra and fragment ions from both N- and O-glycans. DeepGlycan achieves over 92% glycan recall and around 95% glycan precision on N-glycopeptide spectra generated using both sceHCD and EThcD. In addition, it enables O-glycan de novo sequencing without additional training. Beyond benchmarking, DeepGlycan identifies an O-glycopeptide in mouse heart tissue whose assignment is supported by exoglycosidase treatment and comparison with a synthetic standard. Protein glycosylation is difficult to analyse across glycan classes and fragmentation methods. Here, the authors present DeepGlycan, a model that predicts N- and Oglycan compositions from tandem mass spectra and supports analyses across tissues and disease datasets.

summary.one_liner: 该研究提出一种跨多种碎裂技术、对N-与O-连接糖肽糖链进行高精度从头预测的新方法。
summary.innovation: 实现N-连接与O-连接糖肽糖链的统一从头预测，突破以往仅针对单一糖型或依赖糖库的限制；兼容多种碎裂技术（如HCD、ETD等），显著提升对不同质谱平台的泛化与鲁棒性；预测精度高，可在缺乏已知糖链数据库时直接解析糖肽结构
summary.significance: 糖基化是最复杂且最具异质性的翻译后修饰之一，其结构解析长期受制于数据库依赖与碎裂方式差异。该方法为N-与O-糖肽提供通用、高精度的从头解析能力，有望推动糖蛋白质组学在疾病标志物发现、抗体药物糖型质控与糖生物学基础研究中的应用。

papers.title: Dynamic states of an MHC class I molecule during peptide exchange
papers.abstract: Abstract Antigens of intracellular origin are processed then presented by proteins of the highly polymorphic major histocompatibility complex I (MHCI), thereby enabling T cell activation during an immune response. In particular, the peptide-exchange catalyst tapasin (Tsn) plays a critical role in shaping the pool of peptide antigens that ultimately reach the cell surface. Here, using disulfide bond engineering in conjunction with cryogenic electron microscopy (cryoEM) and molecular dynamics simulations, we provide evidence for partial collapse of the antigen binding groove during the peptide exchange process. An intermediate is formed that is characterized by interactions between the peptide’s N-terminus and conserved tyrosine side chains in MHCI. Unfolding of the MHCI α1-helix in the Tsn-bound state is contrasted by a stable α2-helix that is kept in its native-like major conformation by the support of the large interface it entertains with the exchange catalyst. Helical disorder propensities and backbone flexibilities of the α1-helix are predicted to have increased during evolution, suggesting that the dynamic features introduced by polymorphic variation may have contributed to shaping the pool of antigens presented to T cells.

papers.title: Developing neoantigen cancer vaccines: where are we now?
papers.abstract: The success of immunotherapies such as immune checkpoint blockade and engineered T-cells has demonstrated the immune system's anticancer potential. Although prophylactic vaccines against oncogenic viruses such as human papillomavirus prevent cancer by blocking infection, therapeutic vaccines targeting tumour-associated or tumour-specific antigens (TAAs/TSAs) have not reliably produced meaningful tumour regressions. Advances in DNA sequencing and computational pipelines for predicting individual, MHC-restricted neoantigens now enable personalized cancer vaccines (PCVs). By targeting neoantigens arising from somatic mutations, PCVs escape the central tolerance that limits anti-TAA vaccines. Multiple clinical trials have shown promise, but PCV design, delivery, and optimal disease settings require further refinement.

summary.one_liner: 综述个性化新抗原癌症疫苗研发进展：测序与算法突破助推其规避中枢耐受，但设计、递送及适应症仍待优化。
summary.innovation: 系统梳理从病毒预防性疫苗、TAA/TSA治疗性疫苗到个性化新抗原癌症疫苗（PCV）的演进逻辑，指出靶向体细胞突变来源的新抗原可规避限制抗TAA疫苗的中枢免疫耐受；归纳DNA测序与MHC限制性新抗原预测计算流程对PCV研发的关键赋能作用；基于多项临床试验证据，凝练出PCV在疫苗设计、递送策略及最佳适应疾病场景方面仍待解决的核心问题。
summary.significance: 该综述为个性化新抗原癌症疫苗的研发提供了阶段性全景判断，明确了从抗原预测到临床转化的关键瓶颈。其观点有助于指导疫苗设计、递送系统与联合治疗策略的优化，并推动在合适疾病阶段（如微小残留病灶）开展临床验证。对纳米递送与免疫治疗交叉领域的研究者具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Cancer-driver-agnostic targeting of amplified surface proteins identifies MPZL1 for selective CAR-T cell therapy
papers.abstract: Abstract Most cancer therapies target genetic alterations driving tumor growth, but many drivers are undruggable or rare, limiting their therapeutic reach. Here, we demonstrate that amplified genes encoding cell surface proteins provide a rich, cancer-driver–agnostic source of targets. We identify MPZL1 (myelin protein zero–like 1), amplified in up to 75% of patients with certain solid tumor types, as abundantly expressed on the surface tumor cells across diverse cancer types while being largely absent from healthy tissues, offering a favorable therapeutic window. We develop a monoclonal antibody targeting MPZL1’s extracellular domain and engineer chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cells that selectively eliminate MPZL1-positive cancer cells in vitro. These CAR-T cells exhibit antitumor activity in human xenograft, autochthonous mouse, and patient-derived tissue explant preclinical models. This work establishes MPZL1 as a viable CAR-T cell target and provides a generalizable framework for exploiting amplified cell surface receptors as broadly applicable therapeutic targets.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现扩增的表面蛋白MPZL1可作为广谱肿瘤靶点，并成功开发出选择性杀伤肿瘤的CAR-T细胞疗法。
summary.innovation: 提出不依赖致癌驱动基因、而是利用基因扩增导致的表面蛋白过表达来筛选靶点的通用策略；鉴定出MPZL1在多种实体瘤中高表达（部分瘤种扩增率高达75%）而正常组织几乎不表达，治疗窗口良好；研制靶向MPZL1胞外域的抗体并构建CAR-T细胞，在体外及异种移植、自发小鼠肿瘤和患者来源组织外植体模型中均验证其抗肿瘤活性。
summary.significance: 该工作为难以成药的致癌驱动基因提供了替代性治疗思路，将基因扩增转化为可成药的表面抗原靶点。MPZL1靶向CAR-T细胞有望应用于多种MPZL1扩增的实体瘤，并为难治肿瘤的精准免疫治疗提供可推广的靶点发现框架。

papers.title: Integrating tumor–immune mechanistic modeling with transcriptomics reveals pattern-driven prognostic biomarkers in tumors
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: The spatial patterns of immune cells within the tumor microenvironment hold profound prognostic implications, yet a mechanistic understanding of their formation and functional impact remains lacking. Current mechanistic models operate in a theoretical vacuum, while spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides static snapshots without dynamic insight. To bridge this gap, we present an integrative framework that couples a reaction–diffusion model of tumor–immune kinetics with multicohort ST data. We theoretically explore the spatiotemporal conditions for Turing spatial patterns. Stability analysis identifies a sufficient condition for immune-dominant patterns and predicts that tumor cell motility disrupts the spot-dominant state. The numerical simulations reveal that the spot-dominant immune pattern provides stronger tumor suppression than the stripe-dominant pattern and the increased movement of persistent and resistant tumor cells disrupts this immune dominance. Furthermore, analyses of ST data from three independent tumor cohorts confirm modeling findings, identifying distinct spot-like and stripe-like immune patterns that correlate with the patient prognosis and revealing enrichment of persister cells in stripe regions. Integrating these approaches, we demonstrate that spot-like, but not stripe-like, immune patterns associate with effective tumor suppression and serve as a robust, prognostic biomarker for favorable outcomes. This pattern-driven prognostic power is linked to the underlying biology: spatial cell–cell communication analysis reveals that spot-patterned niches are characterized by enhanced MHC-I antigen presentation, while stripe-like, immunosuppressive microenvironments exhibit aberrant ECM-mediated signaling. Together, this study bridges theoretical modeling and computational spatial omics, establishing a spatiotemporal analysis framework for dissecting immune spatial organization and therapeutic outcomes in solid tumors.

summary.one_liner: 将肿瘤-免疫反应扩散模型与空间转录组耦合，揭示斑点状免疫空间模式可作预后标志物
summary.innovation: 首次把肿瘤-免疫反应扩散动力学模型与多队列空间转录组数据整合，经稳定性分析给出免疫主导图灵模式的充分条件并预测肿瘤细胞运动性破坏斑点态；发现斑点状免疫模式的抑瘤效果强于条纹状，且持续/耐药肿瘤细胞运动增强会瓦解该免疫优势；在三个独立肿瘤队列中验证并阐明机制——斑点微环境富集MHC-I抗原呈递，条纹状免疫抑制区则呈ECM介导的异常信号
summary.significance: 该研究弥合了理论建模与计算空间组学之间的鸿沟，建立了剖析实体瘤免疫空间组织及治疗结局的时空分析框架。斑点状（而非条纹状）免疫模式可作为稳健的预后生物标志物，用于患者分层与疗效预测。其机制关联提示调控肿瘤细胞运动性与ECM微环境有望成为重塑免疫空间格局、提升免疫治疗应答的潜在干预靶点。

papers.title: Solar‐Driven Spin‐State Optimization in Co‐Based Catalysts for Enhanced Photothermal Ammonia Synthesis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Spin‐state engineering of active sites represents a key strategy for boosting catalytic performance, as demonstrated in thermal ammonia synthesis. However, conventional promoter‐mediated ground‐state spin modulation is inherently limited by the electronic structure of the catalyst, imposing a ceiling on achievable spin tuning efficacy and hindering further advances. In this work, we developed a series of cobalt (Co) nanoparticle‐based catalysts for photothermal ammonia synthesis. By introducing Ru single atom into the Co nanoparticles, along with the addition of barium as a promoter, spin‐state engineering of Co nanoparticles was optimized under light irradiation, boosting the production rate by 3 times compared to thermal catalytic conditions. In‐situ characterization studies revealed that the hot electrons accumulate on the catalyst surface and shift the Co active sites toward a lower‐spin configuration. Supported by density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we demonstrate that this light‐induced spin state change modulates the electronic interaction between Co and N 2 , weakening the N≡N bond and lowering its dissociation energy barrier, thereby facilitating N 2 activation. This work demonstrates that spin regulation in Co‐based catalysts is an innovative design principle for developing more efficient photothermal catalysts for ammonia synthesis and other applications.

summary.one_liner: 通过Ru单原子与Ba助剂调控Co催化剂自旋态，光热氨合成产率提升3倍并促进N≡N活化。
summary.innovation: 将Ru单原子掺入Co纳米颗粒并引入Ba助剂，实现光照下Co自旋态的优化调控；发现热电子积累驱动Co活性位向低自旋构型转变，突破传统助剂介导的基态自旋调控限制；结合DFT揭示光诱导自旋变化可调控Co与N2电子相互作用，弱化N≡N键并降低其解离能垒。
summary.significance: 该工作证明了自旋调控是开发高效光热氨合成催化剂的新设计原则，为突破传统热催化性能瓶颈提供了可行途径。所提出的光驱动自旋态优化策略有望拓展至其他依赖N2活化的催化体系及能源小分子转化领域。

papers.title: Microfluidic‐Enabled Elastic Photothermal Helical Gel Microfibers for High‐Efficiency Solar Evaporation With Spatially Regulated Light‐Thermal‐Water Management
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Fibrous films and fabrics have been extensively employed for solar photothermal interfacial evaporation due to their high specific surface area, flexibility and scalability. However, the inherent planar geometry of fibrous films/fabrics restricts the evaporation area, and vapor/mass diffusion, limiting the evaporation efficiency and inducing salt accumulation. Herein, we propose a strategy of shifting the planar fabrics to photothermal helical microfiber evaporators via microfluidic technology, featuring intrinsic three‐dimensional structure, prominent elasticity and flexibility. The distinctive central cavity in helical gel microfibers enables spatial regulation of light, thermal and water transport, not only expanding evaporation area but also efficiently localizing thermal energy and capturing additional energy. By tuning the helical pitch, the water transport, vapor diffusion and light capture capabilities are synergistically optimized, achieving an evaporation rate of 3.65 kg m − 2 h − 1 under 1 sun irradiation with superior salt resistance. Moreover, the excellent flexibility of the helical microfiber fabric imparts exceptional structural adjustability, allowing to perform solar‐tracking evaporation. Outdoor tests using such solar‐tracking system with enlarged evaporation area deliver a stable evaporation rate of 8.57 kg m − 2 h − 1 under solar intensity of ∼950 W m − 2 , which demonstrates a viable design concept for high‐performance fabric‐based evaporators in sustainable solar interfacial evaporation.

summary.one_liner: 利用微流控制备弹性光热螺旋凝胶微纤维，通过空间调控光-热-水管理实现高效抗盐太阳能蒸发。
summary.innovation: 提出微流控纺丝将平面纤维膜转为具有三维中空结构的弹性光热螺旋凝胶微纤维，突破平面几何对蒸发面积和传质限制；利用螺旋微纤维中心空腔空间调控光、热与水传输，并通过调节螺距协同优化水输运、蒸汽扩散和光捕获；螺旋微纤维织物柔性可调，可实现太阳能追踪蒸发，户外扩大面积后蒸发速率达8.57 kg m−2 h−1并具优异抗盐性。
summary.significance: 该研究为纤维基太阳能界面蒸发器提供了新设计思路，有助于缓解蒸发效率、盐积累与柔性集成之间的矛盾。其高蒸发速率、抗盐和太阳追踪能力有望用于海水淡化、废水处理与可持续清洁水生产。微流控可扩展制备弹性螺旋凝胶微纤维，利于织物级规模化应用。

papers.title: Coarse‐Grained Simulations Rationalize Thermosensitivity and Hydrolytic Degradation of Vinyl Copolymers Obtained by Radical Ring‐Opening Polymerization
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Thermosensitive vinyl polymers with an upper critical solution temperature (UCST) have gained particular attention in drug delivery applications. However, since the UCST is strongly influenced by various parameters (e.g., copolymer composition, molar mass, concentration, and presence of salt), exploring the full range of possibilities to develop effective polymer‐based nanocarriers with precisely controlled UCST properties adapted to each biomedical application is very challenging. These developments, generally based on trial‐and‐error strategies, require extremely time‐ and resource‐consuming experiments. In addition, vinyl copolymers are not degradable, which may hinder their clinical application. Recently, well‐defined vinyl copolymers combining both degradability and thermosensitivity properties have been obtained by copolymerizing acrylamide (AAm) and 5,6‐benzo‐2‐methylene‐1,3‐dioxepane (BMDO) as cyclic ketene acetals (CKA) comonomer, via radical ring‐opening polymerization (rROP), leading to much faster degradation under physiological conditions than previously‐developed CKA‐containing copolymers and even aliphatic polyesters. Nevertheless, such an unprecedented step forward in the field of rROP was left unexplained. Herein, we employed coarse‐grained (CG) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the thermosensitive behavior and degradability of CKA‐containing vinyl copolymers. Our simulations successfully: (i) reproduced the UCST behavior and transition temperature ( T c ) value of P(AAm‐ co ‐BMDO) copolymers and (ii) revealed that local solvation environments and supramolecular organizations (e.g., aggregation state and steric hindrance) could drastically alter the accessibility of ester groups in P(AAm‐ co ‐BMDO), P(MMA‐ co ‐BMDO), and P(OEGMA‐ co ‐BMDO) copolymers, ultimately rationalizing their experimentally observed degradability under physiological conditions. This approach provides insight at the molecular level into the origin of the thermosensitive and degradable behaviors of CKA‐containing vinyl copolymers and provides a predictive framework for the design of biodegradable polymer materials for biomedical applications.

summary.one_liner: 粗粒化分子动力学模拟揭示含CKA乙烯基共聚物的UCST热敏行为与水解降解机理
summary.innovation: 首次用粗粒化分子动力学模拟成功再现P(AAm-co-BMDO)共聚物的UCST行为及转变温度Tc；揭示局部溶剂化环境与超分子组织（聚集态、位阻）显著调控酯基可及性，从而解释P(AAm-co-BMDO)、P(MMA-co-BMDO)和P(OEGMA-co-BMDO)在生理条件下的降解差异；为自由基开环聚合所得可降解热敏乙烯基共聚物提供分子层面的理论解释与预测框架
summary.significance: 该工作从分子层面阐明了含环状酮烯醇醚（CKA）乙烯基共聚物兼具热敏性与可降解性的根源，弥补了此前实验现象缺乏理论解释的空白。所建立的粗粒化模拟预测框架可减少传统试错法所需的大量时间与资源消耗，加速按需定制UCST与降解速率的聚合物纳米载体设计。有望推动用于药物递送等生物医学领域的可生物降解智能高分子材料的理性开发。

papers.title: Sequential Topochemical Reactions Through an Evolving Reaction Lattice
papers.abstract: Difficult peptides, particularly those enriched in β-branched hydrophobic residues, readily aggregate but often resist crystallization, limiting their use as substrates for topochemical synthesis. Here, we show that a β-sheet xerogel (XG) derived from a homochiral valine dipeptide provides a highly ordered supramolecular framework that supports an unprecedented two-stage topochemical azide-alkyne cycloaddition. Mild heating (70°C) induces quantitative, regiospecific monomer-to-dimer conversion with sigmoidal kinetics while preserving the cross-β architecture. This first topochemical reaction generates an ordered dimer phase that, upon further heating (160°C), undergoes a second sigmoidal topochemical reaction in which the dimer becomes the operative reactive repeat unit, affording a regiospecific 1,4-triazole-linked pseudopolypeptide. Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) reveals two discrete exotherms that are consumed sequentially, while time-resolved PXRD shows evolution of the reaction lattice with retention of the characteristic cross-β reflections, albeit with changes in the longer-range diffraction features. Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy further supports preservation of the hydrogen-bonded β-sheet framework throughout both transformations. Together, these observations reveal a mechanism in which the β-sheet framework persists while the supramolecular structure reorganizes, redefining the reactive periodicity from monomer to dimer.

summary.one_liner: 利用缬氨酸二肽β-折叠干凝胶，实现单体到二聚体再以二聚体为重复单元的两阶段拓扑化学点击反应。
summary.innovation: 首次在难结晶的β-支链疏水肽β-折叠干凝胶中实现两阶段拓扑化学叠氮-炔环加成，首步单体到二聚体定量且区域特异性；发现反应晶格随温度演化，二聚体成为第二步反应重复单元，生成1,4-三唑连接的伪多肽；机制上cross-β框架保留而超分子结构重组，反应周期性由单体转变为二聚体。
summary.significance: 为难结晶或易聚集肽的拓扑化学合成提供了新策略，突破了传统拓扑化学需结晶底物的限制。该顺序反应可热控、区域特异地进行，有望用于序列可控伪多肽、功能生物材料及动态共价超分子组装的设计。

papers.title: Dual-protease exosome sensing enables liquid-biopsy detection of chordoma
papers.abstract: Chordoma is a rare and aggressive bone tumor arising from notochordal remnants. Its diagnosis is frequently delayed due to the absence of sensitive and specific circulating biomarkers, while current liquid biopsy modalities remain vastly underutilized in this pathology. Through EV proteomic profiling and perturbation analysis of the chordoma-defining factor TBXT (brachyury), we identified and biologically validated ADAM19 (a disintegrin and metalloproteinase 19) as a novel TBXT-regulated chordoma oncogene, which may function via the ADAM19/TNF-α/NF-κB axis. Paired with the validated pro-invasive marker MMP-2 (matrix metalloproteinase-2), we constructed an anti-interference dual-channel Au-Se fluorescent nanoprobe to achieve specific EV-associated ADAM19/MMP-2 activity readout. ADAM19 signals showed ~ 10.2-12.4-fold (in vitro cell supernatant) and ~ 9.7-10.6-fold (xenograft mouse serum) elevation vs. controls; MMP-2 signals reached ~ 8.5-10.5-fold and ~ 11.9-13.3-fold elevation respectively. Preliminary clinical plasma cohort data confirmed this dual-marker strategy separates chordoma patients from benign spinal disease cases and healthy controls, establishing preliminary proof-of-concept diagnostic performance. This exosome-based dual-channel fluorescent nanoprobe targeting ADAM19 and MMP-2 for chordoma demonstrates promising preliminary diagnostic discriminative potential across preliminary cohorts, and warrants further systematic clinical validation in larger independent patient cohorts.

summary.one_liner: 本研究以TBXT调控的ADAM19与MMP-2为双标志物，构建Au-Se荧光纳米探针检测外泌体双蛋白酶活性，实现脊索瘤液体活检。
summary.innovation: 首次通过EV蛋白质组学与TBXT扰动分析鉴定并验证ADAM19为TBXT调控的脊索瘤新癌基因，揭示ADAM19/TNF-α/NF-κB轴机制；将ADAM19与侵袭标志物MMP-2配对，构建抗干扰双通道Au-Se荧光纳米探针，实现外泌体表面双蛋白酶活性的特异读出；在细胞上清、异种移植小鼠血清及初步临床血浆队列中验证了该双标志物策略的判别效能。
summary.significance: 该工作针对脊索瘤缺乏敏感特异循环标志物、诊断常被延误的临床痛点，提供了一种基于外泌体双蛋白酶活性的液体活检新策略，在初步队列中可将脊索瘤患者与良性脊柱疾病及健康对照区分。Au-Se纳米探针的双通道抗干扰设计为稀有肿瘤的无创诊断提供了可推广的技术范式。后续仍需在更大规模独立临床队列中开展系统性验证以确证其诊断价值。

papers.title: Hierarchically structured nanocomposite cardiac patch for localized therapeutic delivery of bFGF for myocardial repair
papers.abstract: The cardiac lymphatic network plays a vital role in maintaining tissue homeostasis and fluid balance. Myocardial infarction (MI) severely disrupts the lymphatic vasculature, resulting in edema and inflammation, impeding cardiac repair. There is currently limited research on therapies targeting cardiac lymphatics for cardiac repair. Therefore, in the current study, we have developed a bioengineered cardiac patch to load and deliver bioactive lymphangiocrine (bFGF) to the infarcted cardiac tissue. The fabricated cardiac patch consisted of electrospun core–shell nanofibers (PCL-Gelatin), functionalized with “Donut-like” mesoporous polydopamine nanoparticles to load bFGF (DGF-CP). The DGF-CP demonstrated sustained release behavior of bFGF for more than 7 days and maintained its bioactivity. When tested in vivo on a rodent MI model, a significant improvement in cardiac function (EF% & FS%) was observed. The improved cardiac function may be attributed to the synergistic effect of bFGF delivery and patch-mediated structural support, which effectively attenuated cardiac fibrosis and pathological left ventricular remodeling. Furthermore, DGFP-CP treatment resulted in enhanced angiogenesis (VWF + , α-SMA + ), lymphangiogenesis (LYVE1 + ), and reduced accumulation of CD68 + macrophages, supporting cardiac repair. The transcriptomic changes at the cellular level were assessed by single-nuclei RNA sequencing post-MI. Additionally, exploratory analysis suggests that DGF-CP augments cardiac repair by promoting lymphangiogenesis through the VEGFC axis, which is pivotal in resolving chronic inflammation after myocardial infarction. This study highlights the importance of cardiac patch for localized drug delivery and providing structural support for cardiac repair.

summary.one_liner: 构建负载bFGF的核壳纳米纤维/介孔聚多巴胺心脏补片，通过促淋巴管生成与结构支撑修复心梗。
summary.innovation: 设计“甜甜圈”介孔聚多巴胺功能化PCL-Gelatin核壳纳米纤维心脏补片，实现bFGF局部缓释超过7天并保持活性；将促淋巴管生成与补片结构支撑协同用于心梗修复，靶向心肌淋巴网络这一被忽视环节；结合单核RNA测序揭示其通过VEGFC轴促进淋巴管生成、缓解慢性炎症的机制。
summary.significance: 该研究为心梗后靶向心脏淋巴管的重建提供了新型局部递送策略，可改善心功能并减轻纤维化和左室重构。其多组学机制解析有助于推动兼具药物递送与力学支撑的纳米复合材料心脏补片临床转化。对解决心梗后水肿、炎症及修复障碍具有潜在应用前景。

papers.title: Direct Growth of BODIPY‐Based Conjugated Porous Polymer Shell on Upconversion Nanoparticles for NIR‐Driven Photocatalysis
authors: Víctor A. de la Peña O´Shea
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The great applications of upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) can be further extended by their encapsulation within conjugated porous polymers (CPPs). However, the synthesis of monodisperse core@shell based CPPs upconversion nanohybrids remains a challenge. Herein, we report a simple, general strategy that combines (i) prefunctionalization of UCNPs with polymerizable units, (ii) monomer‐feed control, and (iii) a centrifugation‐based work‐up to ensure anchoring to the inorganic core. This approach enables covalent growth of CPP shells with tunable thickness and low polydispersity. Thus, a BODIPY‐based CPP shell was grown over both core (NaYF 4 : Yb 3+ (20%), Er 3+ (2%)) and core‐shell (NaYF 4 : Yb 3+ (20%), Er 3+ (2%)@NaYF 4 ) UCNPs, yielding UC C @CPP and UC CS @CPP nanohybrids. Under near‐infrared (NIR) excitation, the UCNP core upconverts light to activate the surrounding CPP shell leading to photocatalytic activity. UC CS @CPP exhibits a twofold higher photocatalytic activity than UC C @CPP highlighting the critical role of the NaYF 4 passivation layer in preserving upconversion efficiency. Our approach overcomes key limitations of previous designs achieving improved photooxidation yields (i.e., 42%) and excellent recyclability. This modular platform provides a robust and versatile route to UC@CPP hybrids for designing NIR‐driven, reactive oxygen species (ROS)‐generating photocatalysts.

summary.one_liner: 在上转换纳米颗粒表面直接共价生长BODIPY基共轭多孔聚合物壳，构建近红外驱动的光催化剂。
summary.innovation: 提出预官能化、单体投料控制与离心纯化相结合的通用的核@壳型共轭多孔聚合物合成策略，壳层厚度可调且多分散性低；首次在NaYF4:Yb3+,Er3+及核壳结构上转换纳米颗粒上直接生长BODIPY基共轭多孔聚合物壳，获得UC_C@CPP与UC_CS@CPP杂化材料；明确NaYF4钝化层对保持上转换效率的关键作用，使UC_CS@CPP的光催化活性达到UC_C@CPP的两倍。
summary.significance: 该模块化平台突破了以往核@壳共轭多孔聚合物上转换杂化材料合成困难、分散性差的限制，实现了42%的光氧化产率与优异的循环使用性能。所构建的体系可将近红外光高效转化为活性氧，为近红外驱动的光催化与光治疗应用提供了通用且稳健的设计路线。其策略有望推广至其他功能单体和上转换核心，推动深层组织光化学与能源转化研究。

papers.title: Hydrogen Bonding Denticity Governs Surface Modulation in Inorganic Perovskite Nanocrystals
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT All‐inorganic CsPbI 3 perovskite nanocrystals (PNCs) have emerged as promising emitters for optoelectronic applications owing to their high color purity, tunable bandgap, and high photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY). However, dynamic surface ligands, abundant trap states, and rapid halide ion migration limit their emission efficiency and operational stability. Here, methylammonium (MA + ), formamidinium (FA + ), and guanidinium (GA + ) were systematically investigated as surface modulators for PNCs via an anti‐solvent‐assisted post‐treatment strategy. Spectroscopic analyses and density functional theory calculations reveal that the passivation efficacy is determined by the strength and denticity of hydrogen‐bonding interactions between the organic cations and the PNC surface. Among the three candidates, GA + exhibits the highest efficacy owing to its trifunctional N─H groups, which enable robust multidentate surface interactions that suppress trap formation and halide ion migration. As a result, GA‐treated PNCs achieve a PLQY of 99.3% and retain ∼80% of their initial PLQY after 9 days under ambient conditions. The resulting perovskite light‐emitting diodes deliver a maximum external quantum efficiency of 10.2% and a maximum luminance of 473 cd m −2 , representing a significant improvement over pristine devices. These findings identify molecular hydrogen‐bonding geometry as a key design parameter for surface engineering of efficient and stable PNC‐based optoelectronic devices.

summary.one_liner: 系统比较MA⁺、FA⁺、GA⁺对CsPbI₃钙钛矿纳米晶的表面钝化，揭示氢键齿合度是决定钝化效果的关键。
summary.innovation: 首次以氢键齿合度（denticity）为核心参数，系统比较MA⁺、FA⁺、GA⁺三种有机阳离子的表面钝化效能；发现含三官能N─H的GA⁺可通过多齿氢键强效抑制陷阱态形成与卤素离子迁移；结合光谱分析与DFT计算，建立氢键强度与齿合度和钝化效率之间的构效关系。
summary.significance: 该工作将分子氢键几何确立为表面工程的关键设计参数，为高效稳定全无机钙钛矿纳米晶的配体与表面调控提供理论指导。GA⁺处理使PLQY达99.3%、环境条件下9天仍保持约80%初始PLQY，器件最大外量子效率10.2%、最大亮度473 cd m⁻²，显示出在显示与照明等光电器件中的应用潜力。

papers.title: Rhodium Cluster Catalysts Enable Efficient Catalytic Hydroformylation in Mild Conditions: Cluster Size Dependence
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The size of the reactive metal domain, termed an ‘ensemble’, in supported metal catalysts critically influences their catalytic activity. To maximize mass‐activity (MA), a deep understanding of the optimal catalytic environment is vital for the rational catalyst design concept, yet this remains challenging due to difficulties in synthesis and analysis especially in the sub‐nanometer regime. Herein, we have successfully synthesized a series of supported Rh species ranging from single‐atoms to (sub‐)nanometer clusters and nanoparticles. Their catalytic performance in the hydroformylation of styrene was evaluated. We discovered that the optimal structures are the Rh clusters, achieving a MA as high as 305.3 mol g Rh‐total −1 h −1 , a value that surpasses previously reported values for both heterogeneous catalysts and the homogeneous Wilkinson's catalyst. Kinetic and theoretical analyses reveal that nanometer‐sized clusters provide a specific reaction environment that facilitates the balanced co‐adsorption of styrene, CO, and H thereby promoting hydroformylation. Our study highlights that a profound understanding of the optimal active structure is the key to maximizing the MA and advancing beyond simplistic atom efficiency considerations.

papers.title: Multifunctional Nanovaccine‐Radiotherapy Synergy Drives Anti‐Tumor Immunity via Multi‐Cascade Cell Death for Pancreatic Cancer Therapy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) is an immunosuppressive malignancy refractory to radiotherapy and immunotherapy. Conventional tumor vaccines fail in PAAD due to a suppressive tumor microenvironment (TME), inadequate antigen presentation, and impaired immunogenic cell death (ICD). Using a machine learning‐driven transcriptomic analysis, we identified FSTL3 as a vital TME regulatory factor enriched in desmoplastic pancreatic lesions and constructed a cRGD‐modified liposomal carrier co‐encapsulating gemcitabine and siFSTL3 (siFSTL3/Lip GEM ‐cRGD). Unlike antigen‐preloaded conventional nanovaccines, this liposome acts as an irradiation‐activated inducer of in situ tumor vaccination. This engineered multifunctional nanovaccine enhanced radiochemosensitivity and, combined with ionizing radiation (IR), promoted dendritic cell maturation, ICD, and ferroptosis. Mechanistically, this composite nanovaccine synergized with IR to trigger ferroptosis and ICD via the STAT1‐IRF1‐ACSL4 axis, thereby remodeling the TME and overcoming the limitations of conventional vaccines by enhancing antigen release. In vivo, triple therapy with the liposomal carrier, IR, and anti‐PD‐L1 achieves robust anti‐tumor activity with negligible systemic toxicity and overcomes immune checkpoint blockade resistance. This study develops a translatable radiotherapy‐initiated in situ nanovaccination strategy relying on synergistic ferroptosis and ICD to treat refractory PAAD.

summary.one_liner: 本研究构建共载吉西他滨与siFSTL3的cRGD脂质体，联合放疗实现原位纳米疫苗与铁死亡协同治疗胰腺癌。
summary.innovation: 通过机器学习转录组分析锁定FSTL3为胰腺癌促结缔组织增生微环境的关键调控因子，为治疗提供新靶点；设计了cRGD修饰、共载吉西他滨与siFSTL3的脂质体，区别于传统预载抗原疫苗，其作为放疗激活的原位疫苗诱导剂；机制上揭示STAT1-IRF1-ACSL4轴介导铁死亡与免疫原性细胞死亡的多级联协同，重塑肿瘤微环境并逆转免疫检查点阻断耐药。
summary.significance: 该策略将放疗、化疗与基因沉默整合于单一纳米平台，可显著增强抗原释放与递呈，克服胰腺癌免疫抑制微环境导致的疫苗失效难题。动物实验显示三联疗法抗肿瘤效果显著且系统毒性低，并能逆转抗PD-L1耐药，具有较高的临床转化潜力。其为难治性胰腺导管腺癌提供了一种可转化的放疗启动原位纳米疫苗接种新范式。

papers.title: A Multi‐Scale Computational Framework for Evaluating Wireless Neuromodulation Feasibility via Magnetoelectric Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Magnetoelectric nanoparticles (MENPs) represent a promising approach for wireless, minimally invasive neuromodulation with submillimetre precision. This study presents a multi-scale computational framework that bridges the gap from single-nanoparticle magnetoelectric properties to tissue-level electric field distributions, establishing a digital twin approach adaptable to different experimental platforms. The framework operates across three interconnected levels. (1). At the nanoscale, a 2D axisymmetric COMSOL model characterizes individual MENP response, integrating experimental data from cobalt ferrite cores (15-20 nm diameter) with barium titanate shells. Parametric analysis reveals that larger cores generate higher electric potentials due to increased magnetostrictive volume. (2). At the in vitro level, electromagnetic simulations replicate the experimental setup as a digital twin, establishing baseline field distributions and confirming that coil-induced electric fields alone remain below neuromodulation thresholds. (3). At the tissue scale, a dipole-based approach models collective MENP behavior at physiologically relevant concentrations (0.1% and 0.2% w/v). Results demonstrate that MENPs generate widespread electric fields exceeding 10 V/m (77%-92% tissue coverage) with localized hotspots surpassing 100 V/m, intensities sufficient for neural modulation and activation. The framework provides quantitative predictions for optimizing nanoparticle design and stimulation parameters, supporting the rational development of MENP-based neuromodulation strategies.

summary.one_liner: 构建多尺度计算框架，从单颗粒磁电特性到组织电场分布，评估无线磁电纳米颗粒神经调控可行性。
summary.innovation: 建立跨纳米-体外-组织三尺度互连模型，实现从单颗粒磁电响应到组织级电场分布的数字孪生；参数化揭示钴铁氧体核尺寸增大可提升磁致伸缩体积与电势，并量化不同浓度MENP的电场覆盖与热点；证明仅线圈电场低于调控阈值，而MENP可在0.1%-0.2% w/v下产生超过10 V/m广域场和超过100 V/m热点。
summary.significance: 该框架为MENP无线神经调控提供可推广的定量预测工具，可指导颗粒设计与刺激参数优化。其数字孪生策略适配不同实验平台，有助于推动MENP神经调控策略的理性开发与临床转化。结果支持在生理相关浓度下实现亚毫米精度无线神经调控的可行性评估。

papers.title: Carbohydrate‐Mediated Cellular Uptake of Boronic Acid Hybrids In Cellulo and Insulin‐Deficient Zebrafish: Live Imaging and Application of Multiphoton FLIM
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding how synthetic molecular probes interact with biological carbohydrates is essential for theranostics design and discovery. We report new supramolecular polysaccharide complexes, comprising simultaneously functionalised boronic acids conjugated to xanthate‐based fluorescent tags bound to saccharides such as glucose or β‐D‐glucan (a natural product from Hordeum Vulgare ). These hybrids were investigated in solution and in the cellular milieu using advanced biophysical methods, including multiphoton fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy (MP‐FLIM). A new type of fluorescent hybrid nanoparticle was also generated by conjugating boronic acids to ─Si(OH) 2 functionalities on the surface of core–shell Fe 3 O 4 @SiO 2 nanoparticles. Cellular uptake and distribution were probed using correlated confocal and multiphoton fluorescence microscopy using 2‐photon excitation at 910 nm, whereby TCSPC and FLIM provided insight into probe environments, interactions with β‐D‐glucan, and cellular context. Colocalization studies with a range of standard dyes were carried out to assess the potential of the probes for cellular penetration and targeting cellular organelles, and the nature of the lipophilic linker involved greatly influences the cytoplasmic distribution and facilitates zebrafish uptake. Complementary in vivo investigations using fluorescence stereomicroscopy of zebrafish showed differential uptake and quenching of these complexes throughout the digestive system, dependent on exogenous and endogenous concentrations of carbohydrates, glucose, or β‐ d ‐glucan.

summary.one_liner: 本研究报道硼酸-黄原酸酯荧光杂合物与糖类形成超分子复合物，结合多光子FLIM与斑马鱼活体成像揭示其细胞摄取与分布机制。
summary.innovation: 设计硼酸偶联黄原酸酯荧光标签并与葡萄糖或β-D-葡聚糖形成超分子多糖复合物；构建Fe3O4@SiO2核壳纳米颗粒荧光杂合探针；结合双光子910 nm激发、TCSPC-FLIM与共定位分析解析探针微环境及糖类相互作用。
summary.significance: 为糖介导的细胞靶向与诊疗探针设计提供了新的分子工具和成像策略；在胰岛素缺乏斑马鱼模型中实现消化系统差异摄取与猝灭的原位可视化，有望推动糖响应型诊疗与代谢疾病研究。

papers.title: Beyond Biomimetics: Pathology‐Informed Engineering Rescues Reconstituted HDL From Inflammatory Dysfunction for Sepsis Immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Biomimetic therapies hold great promise for treating intractable diseases, yet their translation is often hindered by dysfunction-the loss of intended biological function upon exposure to pathological microenvironments. This challenge is well exemplified by reconstituted high-density lipoprotein (rHDL), a clinically advanced HDL mimetic and representative biomimetic drug delivery platform. Here, guided by a pathology-informed identification-design-evaluation-validation workflow, we identified representative sepsis-relevant dysfunction liabilities of HDL-based systems under pathology-relevant conditions and designed an adaptive engineered guard for inflammatory stress (AEGIS) strategy to rescue rHDL function. AEGIS integrates triphenylphosphine-modified ceria nanozyme-celastrol coordination complex (TCe-C) into rHDL to form TCe-C@rHDL, enabling carrier protection, decoupling disease-driven damage from dysfunction, and preserving HDL-intrinsic routing for hierarchical cytoplasmic and mitochondrial delivery. Across multiple evaluation models, including inflammatory biochemical challenges, patient serum under shear flow, and inflammatory animal settings, TCe-C@rHDL consistently preserved biomimetic function better than a clinical-stage CER-001 mimetic. This performance was further validated by therapeutic efficacy in vivo, restoring 90% survival in LPS-induced systemic inflammation versus 40% for the CER-001 mimetic, and improving survival to 80% in the CLP model when combined with antibiotics versus 40% for antibiotics alone. Collectively, this work establishes a paradigm for next-generation biomimetic systems that remain functional under pathological stress.

papers.title: An "AND" Logic Gate S‐Scheme Nanozyme for Magneto‐Pyroelectric Dynamic Therapy Integrated With Lactate–Urate Immunometabolic Remodeling in Glioblastoma
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Glioblastoma (GBM) therapy remains limited by poor blood–brain barrier (BBB) penetration and an adaptive, immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). Here, we engineer multifunctional FeWO x @Ag/Bi 2 Te 3 ‐HA nanozymes (FABH) to integrate magneto‐pyroelectric dynamic therapy (MPEDT), metabolic regulation, immune activation, and near‐infrared II fluorescence imaging. Under alternating magnetic field (AMF) stimulation, the Ag/Bi 2 Te 3– FeWO x S‐scheme heterojunction promotes pyroelectric charge separation and reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, thereby strengthening MPEDT and inducing immunogenic cell death. FABH nanozymes also show AMF‐enhanced L‐cysteine oxidase (LCO), reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH) oxidase (NOX), lactate oxidase (LOX), and xanthine oxidoreductase (XOR) activities. These cascaded activities deplete glutathione, improve oxygen availability, block protective autophagy, and remodel lactate‐ and urate‐associated metabolism to activate innate and adaptive antitumor immunity. Magnetic guidance further enables FABH nanozymes to cross the BBB and accumulate in deep GBM lesions, while silver ion incorporation improves thermoelectric performance and supports real‐time NIR‐II imaging. This integrated strategy promotes GBM ablation through BBB penetration, ROS storm generation, autophagy blockade, and immunometabolic remodeling.

summary.one_liner: 构建FeWO x @Ag/Bi 2 Te 3 ‐HA“AND”逻辑门S型纳米酶，磁热-热电动疗联合乳酸-尿酸免疫代谢重塑治疗胶质母细胞瘤。
summary.innovation: 设计Ag/Bi 2 Te 3 –FeWO x S型异质结纳米酶，在交变磁场下实现热释电电荷分离与ROS风暴，形成“AND”逻辑门式磁-热电动治疗；;集成L-半胱氨酸氧化酶、NADH氧化酶、乳酸氧化酶与黄嘌呤氧化还原酶级联活性，同步耗竭谷胱甘肽、改善供氧、阻断保护性自噬并重塑乳酸/尿酸代谢以激活天然与适应性抗肿瘤免疫；;引入银离子提升热电性能并赋予NIR-II荧光成像，结合磁引导实现跨血脑屏障与深部病灶富集，实现诊疗一体化。
summary.significance: 该策略同时破解了胶质母细胞瘤血脑屏障穿透差与免疫抑制微环境两大瓶颈，把物理动态治疗与代谢-免疫调控耦合为单一纳米平台，为深部脑肿瘤提供可实时成像、可磁导航的精准治疗范式。其“AND”逻辑门设计思路可推广至其他需要多条件协同触发的难治性肿瘤，具有较高的临床转化潜力与材料设计借鉴价值。

papers.title: Dual‐Activating Pyroptosis and cGAS‐STING Pathway for Immuno‐Photodynamic Therapy Based on a Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence Photosensitizer
papers.abstract: Immunotherapy has emerged as a cornerstone of cancer treatment, yet its efficacy is often limited by the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, which is marked by low immunogenicity and insufficient cytotoxic T cell infiltration. To address these challenges, we have developed an innovative thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF)-based photosensitizer, termed TA2O. Leveraging its advantageous TADF properties, including a small singlet-triplet energy gap and prolonged triplet state lifetime, TA2O efficiently generates reactive oxygen species (ROS) upon light irradiation. This process triggers caspase‑1/GSDME‑dependent pyroptosis, leading to the release of tumor-associated antigens and damage-associated molecular patterns that stimulate adaptive immunity. Concurrently, the accumulation of cytosolic DNA activates the cGAS-STING pathway, thereby bolstering innate immune responses. Both in vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that TA2O effectively eradicates tumor cells, promotes dendritic cell (DC) maturation, facilitates cytotoxic T lymphocyte infiltration, and induces a marked M2-to-M1 macrophage polarization, effectively promoting immune infiltration and inflammatory remodeling of the tumor microenvironment. Moreover, a combinatorial strategy integrating TA2O-mediated photodynamic therapy with anti-PD-1 immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) exhibits superior antitumor efficacy compared to either monotherapy. This immuno-phototherapeutic approach represents a promising advance in precision cancer immunotherapy.

summary.one_liner: 开发TADF光敏剂TA2O，经光动力同时激活细胞焦亡与cGAS-STING通路，增强肿瘤免疫治疗。
summary.innovation: 设计TADF光敏剂TA2O，利用小单-三线态能隙和长三线态寿命高效产生ROS；通过光动力触发caspase-1/GSDME依赖焦亡并同步激活cGAS-STING，双重激活先天与适应性免疫；将TA2O光动力疗法与anti-PD-1免疫检查点阻断联用，实现协同抗肿瘤效果。
summary.significance: 该研究为克服肿瘤免疫抑制微环境提供了双通路激活的免疫光动力新策略。TA2O可促进DC成熟、细胞毒性T细胞浸润及M2向M1巨噬细胞极化，有效重塑肿瘤微环境。其与anti-PD-1联用优于单药治疗，在精准肿瘤免疫治疗中具有良好转化前景。

papers.title: Induction of Methuosis in Breast Cancer Stem Cells by a Cobalt(III) Complex Evokes Immunotherapeutic Response
papers.abstract: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) drive metastasis and relapse and are resistant to conventional apoptosis-inducing chemotherapies. Methuosis, a non-apoptotic form of cell death, is largely unexplored for anti-CSC therapy. Here we report a cobalt(III)-cyclam complex (1) incorporating pyrene and diflunisal moieties that induces features consistent with methuosis in a CSC model. Mechanistic investigations revealed that 1 induces phenotypes consistent with methuosis in breast CSCs, including extensive cytoplasmic vacuolation, elevated Rab7 and LAMP1 expression, activation of JNK and p38 MAPK pathways, G2/M cell-cycle arrest, augmented intracellular reactive oxygen species levels, and disruption of the mitochondrial membrane potential. Beyond direct cytotoxicity, 1 induces an anti-breast CSC immunogenic response by perturbing the inhibitory damage-associated molecular patterns axis through cyclooxygenase-2 downregulation. When formulated as polymeric nanoparticles and evaluated in a murine metastatic triple-negative breast cancer model, 1 penetrates tumour tissue and suppresses tumour growth more than cisplatin. The nanoparticle formulation activates anti-tumour immunity, characterised by enhanced infiltration of T cells and mature dendritic cells in tumours and tumour-draining lymph nodes. Intratumoral T-cell recruitment is associated with M2-to-M1 macrophage polarisation and depletion of myeloid-derived suppressor cells. This work identifies 1 as the first metal complex shown to induce features consistent with methuosis in a CSC model.

summary.one_liner: 钴(III)配合物1在乳腺癌干细胞中诱导甲硫死亡，纳米制剂增强抗肿瘤免疫并抑制三阴性乳腺癌转移。
summary.innovation: 首次发现金属配合物可在乳腺癌干细胞模型中诱导甲硫死亡（methuosis）；通过下调COX-2扰动抑制性损伤相关分子模式轴，将非凋亡细胞死亡与抗CSC免疫应答耦合；构建聚合物纳米制剂，在转移性三阴性乳腺癌中实现优于顺铂的肿瘤穿透、生长抑制及免疫激活。
summary.significance: 为耐药乳腺癌干细胞提供了非凋亡死亡的新策略，并揭示金属配合物可同时诱导免疫原性应答。纳米递送改善药物分布与肿瘤蓄积，具转化潜力，可用于转移性三阴性乳腺癌的免疫化疗。

papers.title: Upconversion Laser Direct Writing Using NIR Light‐Responsive Nanocomposites for Photopatterning and Reconfiguration of Dynamic 3D Microstructures
papers.abstract: Dynamic three-dimensional (3D) patterns exhibit superior capabilities compared to their static counterparts, playing crucial roles in applications such as rewritable data storage and updatable information encryption. However, the efficient fabrication and reconfiguration of 3D patterns require suitable methods and materials. In this work, we explore the fabrication and reconfiguration of dynamic 3D patterns using upconversion laser direct writing in combination with near-infrared (NIR) light-responsive nanocomposites. We have developed a system that utilizes a cost-effective continuous-wave (CW) NIR laser to induce reversible photoreactions at the laser focus, thereby fabricating dynamic 3D patterns by moving the laser focus. By integrating upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) with photoswitchable materials, including spiropyran (SP), diarylethene (DTE), and azobenzene (AZO), within a polymer matrix, we enable localized photoisomerization through focused laser irradiation. The reversibility of the photoswitching process renders the resulting 3D patterns erasable, rewritable, and dynamic. This technique represents a universal and economical method for dynamic 3D photopatterning, particularly promising for advancing information encryption, optical storage, and data security technologies.

summary.one_liner: 利用近红外光响应上转换纳米复合物与激光直写，实现可擦写、可重构的动态三维微结构光图案化。
summary.innovation: 采用低成本连续波近红外激光，通过上转换纳米颗粒在焦点处诱导局域光反应，实现动态3D图案直写；将上转换纳米颗粒与螺吡喃、二芳基乙烯、偶氮苯等光开关材料集成于聚合物基质，实现可逆光异构化与图案重构；所得3D微结构可擦除、可重写且动态可调，形成通用、经济的动态3D光图案化策略。
summary.significance: 该技术为动态三维光图案化提供了一种通用且经济的加工方法，克服了传统静态3D结构功能单一的局限。其在信息加密、光学存储和数据安全等领域具有重要应用前景，有望推动可重写与可更新光信息器件的发展。

papers.title: In situ transformable fibrillar networks ameliorate secondary brain injury after intracerebral hemorrhage by activating KEAP1-Nrf2/ARE axis
papers.abstract: Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) is among the most severe stroke subtypes, especially the secondary brain injury synergistically driven by oxidative stress and neuroinflammation, which leads to severe progressive tissue damage and neurological deterioration. Currently, there are no effective and long-lasting targeted treatments for secondary brain injury caused by ICH. Here, we report an in situ biomimetic self-assembly strategy based on a fibrillar, transformable peptide (NKF) that coordinately suppresses oxidative stress and neuroinflammation. In aqueous solution, NKF self-assembles into nanoparticles; upon binding to KEAP1 in microglia, however, it undergoes an in situ transformation into nanofibrils, thereby enhancing intracellular retention and sustaining KEAP1 sequestration. In cellular and rat ICH models, NKF promotes sustained Nrf2 nuclear translocation and ARE-dependent transcription, resulting in enhanced antioxidant defense, attenuated pro-inflammatory signaling, and a shift in microglial phenotype towards a neuroprotective anti-inflammatory state. This physical conformation transformation strategy based on lesion-responsive peptide biomimetic assembly establishes a generalizable nanoplatform for durable activation of an endogenous neuroprotective pathway.

summary.one_liner: 本研究开发原位可转化肽NKF，经KEAP1响应自组装为纳米纤维，激活Nrf2/ARE轴，改善脑出血后继发性脑损伤。
summary.innovation: 提出基于病灶响应性肽NKF的原位构象转化策略，溶液自组装为纳米颗粒、结合KEAP1后转变为纳米纤维；增强胞内滞留并持续隔离KEAP1，实现Nrf2/ARE通路的持久激活；协同抑制氧化应激与神经炎症并促进小胶质细胞向神经保护表型转化。
summary.significance: 该策略为脑出血后继发性脑损伤提供了持久、靶向的内源性神经保护治疗新思路。其不依赖外源药物持续释放，具有良好转化潜力，并可推广至其他氧化应激或神经炎症相关神经系统疾病。

papers.title: Chemical and Biological Determinants of PEG‐Lipid Shedding From Therapeutic Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Polyethylene glycol (PEG)-lipids are widely used to engineer the interfacial properties of lipid-based nanomaterials, where they play a central role in governing colloidal stability and biological interactions. By forming a steric barrier at the nanoparticle surface, PEG-lipids reduce protein adsorption and extend circulation times. Additionally, PEG-lipids are increasingly functionalized with targeting moieties, representing a primary strategy to enable selective delivery. However, accumulating evidence indicates that PEG-lipids are not static components but instead undergo dynamic dissociation, or "shedding," upon exposure to biological environments. This interfacial exchange process alters nanoparticle behavior, promoting protein adsorption and accelerating clearance, while also enabling cellular interactions that facilitate uptake. Here, we present a conceptual framework for understanding PEG-lipid shedding as a coupled thermodynamic and kinetic process influenced by lipid chemical structure, nanocarrier membrane properties, and interactions with biomolecules. By synthesizing recent findings across experimental systems, we identify key factors that link PEG-lipid composition and nanoparticle architecture to desorption kinetics and biological outcomes. These insights provide guidance for the design of PEGylated nanomaterials with improved control over interfacial stability, immune recognition, and functional performance.

summary.one_liner: 系统解析PEG-脂质从治疗性纳米颗粒表面脱落的热力学与动力学机制及其化学与生物学决定因素。
summary.innovation: 提出将PEG-脂质脱落视为热力学与动力学耦合过程的概念框架；综合脂质化学结构、纳米载体膜性质与生物分子相互作用三类决定因素，将脱附动力学与生物学结局定量关联；揭示脱落的双重效应——既削弱空间位阻屏障、促进蛋白吸附与加速清除，又促进细胞相互作用与摄取。
summary.significance: 该框架为理解PEG化纳米颗粒在生物环境中的界面动态行为提供了统一视角，弥补了将PEG-脂质视为静态组分的传统认知。研究结论可指导PEG化纳米材料（如脂质纳米颗粒、靶向递送载体）的理性设计，实现对界面稳定性、免疫识别与功能性能的精准调控。对提升核酸药物与靶向治疗的体内递送效率具有重要转化价值。

papers.title: Cu/Cu 2 O Heterostructure Nanoplatform Driven Photo‐Thermoelectric Catalysis Targets LuxS and Agr Dual Quorum Sensing Systems of Methicillin‐Resistant Staphylococcus aureus
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The formation of multidrug‐resistant barriers dominated by biofilms is a intelligent living of methicillin‐resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), resulting in refractory infections. Reactive oxygen species (ROS)‐related biocatalysis triggered by nanomaterials have demonstrated outstanding resistance‐free advantages, while the therapeutic effectiveness is limited by the output and permeability into biofilms. Thus, we introduce a Cu‐based nanoplatform (Cu/Cu 2 O@C@P NPs) utilizing high‐performance photo‐thermoelectric catalysis (PTEC) strategy to target LuxS and Agr dual quorum sensing (QS) systems of MRSA, resulting in a customized destruction procedure for combat MRSA. Herein, heterointerfaces engineering Cu/Cu 2 O as the core structure featured abundant Cu vacancies einforced the conductivity and photo‐thermoelectric transformation of nanocomposite, while the mesoporous graphite was designed as shell structure to optimize the thermal conductivity, ultimately achieving an ultrahigh photothermal conversion efficiency (69.44%) and efficient PTEC. Combining multimodal catalytic mechanisms, the generated high‐yield ROS degraded QS signals both of LuxS and Agr systems, manifesting in loosening biofilms and inhibiting efflux pumps. Eventually, Cu/Cu 2 O@C@P NPs fundamentally curbed drug resistance to actualize the full‐stage obliteration of MRSA infection, preferentially mitigated inflammatory responses, and accelerated wound healing. Overall, this study represents the innovative nanoplatform design of PTEC therapy, and provides that binding QS as a promising strategy for combat drug‐resistant bacteria.

summary.one_liner: 构建Cu/Cu₂O异质结光-热电催化纳米平台，靶向MRSA的LuxS/Agr双群体感应系统，破坏生物膜并根除感染。
summary.innovation: 异质界面工程构建Cu/Cu₂O核结构并富集Cu空位，提升导电性与光-热电转换性能；介孔石墨壳层优化热导，实现69.44%超高光热转换效率与高效PTEC；以ROS降解LuxS与Agr双QS信号，瓦解生物膜并抑制外排泵，实现不依赖抗生素的耐药菌清除
summary.significance: 该研究将光-热电催化与双群体感应靶向结合，为MRSA生物膜相关顽固感染提供了非抗生素、低耐药风险的治疗策略。其可优先缓解炎症反应并加速伤口愈合，为抗耐药菌纳米平台的理性设计提供了新范式。

papers.title: Pairing GOx With a Potent H 2 O 2 ‐consuming Co‐Cu x O Nanozyme for Starvation/Cuproptosis/Chemodynamic Synergistic Therapy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Combining glucose oxidase (GOx) with peroxidase‐like (POD) nanozymes is a well‐established strategy for synergistic starvation and chemodynamic therapy (CDT). However, the low catalytic efficacy of most nanozymes compared to GOx often leads to wasteful accumulation of hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ), which can inhibit GOx activity and limit the therapeutic effect. Therefore, enhancing the H 2 O 2 consumption efficiency is critical to unlocking the full potential of this approach. Here, we designed a cobalt‐doped mixed‐valence copper oxide (Co‐Cu x O) nanozyme with metals uniformly dispersed using a polyacrylic acid (PAA) scaffolding method. This nanozyme tightly couples the redox cycles that drive the valence state interconversions of cobalt (Co) and copper (Cu) elements, enabling highly efficient consumption of H 2 O 2 and glutathione (GSH). While Co provides multi‐valent characteristics ideal for Fenton‐like reactions, Cu acts not only as a co‐catalyst but also triggers cuproptosis. We further installed GOx onto the nanozyme surface, allowing H 2 O 2 produced by GOx channels to Co‐Cu x O active sites, thereby further accelerating the catalytic cascade. In vitro experiments demonstrated effective glucose and H 2 O 2 depletion with abundant hydroxyl radical (·OH) generation. When functionalized with hyaluronic acid (HA) for tumor targeting, in vivo experiments demonstrated robust multimodal cell death, confirming the high efficacy of our integrated dual‐enzyme platform.

summary.one_liner: 采用PAA支架法制备钴掺杂混合价态铜氧化物纳米酶并偶联GOx，实现饥饿/铜死亡/化学动力学协同抗肿瘤治疗。
summary.innovation: 以聚丙烯酸(PAA)支架法构筑金属均匀分散的Co-CuxO纳米酶，通过紧密耦合Co/Cu价态互变的氧化还原循环，高效同步消耗H2O2与GSH；将GOx装配于纳米酶表面，使GOx通道产生的H2O2就近输送至Co-CuxO活性位点，加速级联催化并避免H2O2累积对GOx的反馈抑制；Co提供多价态Fenton样反应特性，Cu既作助催化剂又触发铜死亡，并以透明质酸(HA)修饰实现肿瘤靶向
summary.significance: 该研究针对GOx与POD纳米酶联用中H2O2利用效率低、易抑制GOx活性的关键瓶颈，提出了高效的H2O2消耗型纳米酶设计方案。体外实验证实可有效耗竭葡萄糖与H2O2并大量产生羟基自由基，体内实验显示出强效的多模式细胞死亡与抑瘤效果。该策略为构建高效级联纳米催化肿瘤治疗平台提供了可推广的思路，具有较好的临床转化潜力。

summary.one_liner: 该报道聚焦靶向线粒体等细胞器的药物递送策略正进入临床验证阶段，标志亚细胞层面精准治疗加速转化。
summary.innovation: 将药物递送精度从细胞水平推进至线粒体等亚细胞器水平；针对线粒体等细胞器的治疗策略进入临床测试，验证其可行性与安全性；有望突破传统靶向递送在胞内分布和疗效上的瓶颈。

papers.title: Inhaled siRNA therapy targeting RAGE for pulmonary inflammation: a first-in-human randomized trial
papers.abstract: Nature Medicine, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41591-026-04607-z Following preclinical development, a randomized first-in-human trial showed that treatment with an inhaled, lung-epithelium-targeted siRNA directed against the receptor for advanced glycation end-products (RAGE) was safe and well tolerated and reduced RAGE levels in serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid.

summary.one_liner: 首次人体试验证实吸入性靶向RAGE的siRNA疗法安全耐受，可降低肺部和血清RAGE水平，用于肺部炎症治疗。
summary.innovation: 首次开展针对RAGE的吸入性siRNA人体临床试验；采用肺上皮靶向递送技术实现局部基因沉默；在血清和支气管肺泡灌洗液中均证实靶点下调。
summary.significance: 该研究为肺部炎症性疾病提供了一种全新的核酸药物干预策略，验证了吸入式siRNA的可行性与安全性。未来有望拓展至急性肺损伤、慢性阻塞性肺病等RAGE相关炎症疾病的精准治疗。

papers.title: A Biomimetic cascade nanoreactor enabled by tumor microenvironment remodeling for precise CO release and enhanced cu-mediated chemodynamic therapy
papers.abstract: Prostate cancer (PCa) is the most prevalent malignant tumor in the male genitourinary system. Carbon monoxide (CO) gas therapy and chemodynamic therapy (CDT) have emerged as alternative treatments for cancer. However, the therapeutic efficacy of both approaches is constrained by the insufficient endogenous hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) supply and the overexpression of protective glutathione (GSH) in the tumor microenvironment (TME). Herein, we developed a biomimetic cascaded nanoreactor (DCM@MCuH@MnCO) for synergistically combining CO-mediated gas therapy with CDT driven by depletion of GSH and self-supply of H 2 O 2 in the tumor. DCM@MCuH@MnCO was constructed by integrating a copper-catechol coordinated network (CuH) and H 2 O 2 -sensitive manganese carbonyl (MnCO) within the mesoporous carbon hollow spheres (MCHS), and further modifying the surface with tumor cell membranes (DCM) to enhance its tumor-targeting ability. The CuH in the nanoreactor can disassemble, triggered by continuous consumption of GSH, releasing pro-oxidative catechol ligands to generate H 2 O 2 for TME remodeling. Subsequently, MnCO decomposes on demand to release CO in situ while copper ions (Cu + ) convert H 2 O 2 into reactive oxygen species (ROS) via a Fenton-like reaction. These events cooperatively cause mitochondrial damage and induce a lethal ROS storm within cells, ultimately effectively killing tumor cells both in vitro and in vivo. This study demonstrates significant prospects for CO therapy and CDT, offering a novel and promising strategy for efficient PCa treatment.

summary.one_liner: 构建仿生级联纳米反应器，通过重塑肿瘤微环境实现一氧化碳精准释放并增强铜介导的化学动力学治疗。
summary.innovation: 设计仿生级联纳米反应器实现肿瘤微环境重塑；通过微环境调控触发一氧化碳精准释放；协同增强铜介导的化学动力学治疗效果。
summary.significance: 该策略为气体治疗与化学动力学治疗的协同提供新思路，有望改善肿瘤特异性递送并降低全身毒性，推动多模式纳米催化疗法的临床转化。

papers.title: PLA2G2D in tumour-draining lymph nodes regulates anti-tumour immunity
authors: Thierry P. P. van den Bosch
papers.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10954-1 A specific population of macrophages that express high levels of the enzyme PLA2G2D in tumour-draining lymph nodes is associated with poor prognosis in patients, and inhibiting PLA2G2D improves anti-tumour immunity in mouse models.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现肿瘤引流淋巴结中高表达PLA2G2D的巨噬细胞与患者预后不良相关，抑制该酶可增强小鼠抗肿瘤免疫。
summary.innovation: 首次揭示肿瘤引流淋巴结中PLA2G2D阳性巨噬细胞亚群与预后不良的关联；证实PLA2G2D抑制可改善抗肿瘤免疫反应。
summary.significance: 该发现为肿瘤免疫治疗提供了新靶点PLA2G2D，有望通过调控引流淋巴结中的巨噬细胞功能增强免疫疗效，并可作为预后判断的生物标志物，推动精准免疫治疗发展。

papers.title: A serpin–myeloid axis in pancreatic cancer heterogeneity and immune evasion
papers.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11002-8 SERPINE1 and SERPINB2-driven fibrin-rich niches locally programme immunosuppressive macrophages and exclude T cells, enabling spatially organized immune evasion in pancreatic ductal carcinoma.

summary.one_liner: 揭示SERPINE1/SERPINB2驱动纤维蛋白微环境，诱导巨噬细胞免疫抑制并排斥T细胞，促成胰腺癌空间免疫逃逸。
summary.innovation: 发现serpin-骨髓细胞轴调控胰腺癌异质性；阐明纤维蛋白富集微环境定向极化免疫抑制巨噬细胞并排斥T细胞的空间机制
summary.significance: 为胰腺导管癌的免疫逃逸提供新机制解释，揭示serpin作为潜在治疗靶点；靶向该轴可能逆转免疫抑制微环境，提升免疫治疗疗效，具有临床应用前景。

papers.title: TRI-611, a selective, brain-penetrant molecular glue degrader of ALK
papers.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10998-3 TRI-611 induces the degradation of ALK fusion proteins via a previously undescribed CRBN recruitment motif, and its preclinical anti-tumour activity highlights TRI-611 as a potential new way of treating ALK-positive non-small-cell lung cancer.

summary.one_liner: TRI-611是一种选择性、可透脑的ALK分子胶降解剂，通过新型CRBN招募基序诱导ALK融合蛋白降解，治疗ALK阳性非小细胞肺癌。
summary.innovation: 首次利用分子胶降解ALK融合蛋白，采用先前未描述的CRBN招募基序；具备脑渗透性，可靶向中枢神经系统病灶；选择性降解ALK融合蛋白而非野生型ALK。
summary.significance: 为ALK阳性非小细胞肺癌提供潜在新疗法，尤其对脑转移患者具有重要意义。其新型降解机制拓宽了分子胶药物的设计思路，有望成为克服传统ALK抑制剂耐药的新策略。

summary.significance: 为前列腺癌的突变机制提供统一框架，助力个体化风险分层和靶向治疗；推动癌症基因组学中整合签名分析方法的应用，具有临床转化潜力。
