summary.innovation: 首次在前瞻性II期试验中验证替雷利珠单抗联合仑伐替尼对FH-RCC的显著疗效，ORR高达95%；结合循环琥珀酰代谢物（琥珀酰腺苷、琥珀酰半胱氨酸）分析肿瘤负荷，探索代谢生物标志物作为影像学监测的补充手段。
summary.significance: 为无标准治疗的晚期FH-RCC提供了潜在的一线联合方案，疗效数据优异且安全性可控，具有指导临床实践的直接价值。循环代谢物标志物有望推动个体化治疗监测，但需更大样本验证其临床适用性。

papers.title: Canakinumab with chemoradiation and durvalumab consolidation in unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer: the phase I/II CHORUS trial
papers.abstract: CHORUS (NCT04905316) was an open-label, non-randomized, single-arm phase I/II trial of the anti-IL-1beta monoclonal antibody canakinumab given with concurrent chemoradiotherapy and continued with anti-PD-L1 durvalumab consolidation in unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer. The primary endpoint was 24-month progression-free survival (PFS) from radiotherapy initiation; secondary endpoints included overall survival, objective response rate, and safety. Forty-one patients were enrolled, 37 received canakinumab, and 32 comprised the prespecified efficacy population. At a median follow-up of 25 months, 24-month PFS was 67% (95% confidence interval, 52–88); the lower bound of the prespecified one-sided 90% confidence interval was 56.5%, exceeding the 46% historical benchmark, and the primary endpoint was met. Twelve- and 24-month overall survival were 93% and 73%, respectively, and the confirmed objective response rate was 81%. Canakinumab-related grade 3–4 events included neutropenia (n = 5), febrile neutropenia (n = 1), lymphopenia (n = 1), lung infection (n = 1), fatigue (n = 1), and hypertension (n = 1); no canakinumab-related deaths occurred. Pneumonitis of any attribution occurred in 9 of 37 patients (24%; grade 2, n = 7; grade 3, n = 2). Peripheral immune cell profiling showed attenuated expansion of myeloid-derived suppressor cells and CTLA-4-expressing CD8 + T-cell subsets among responders. Circulating tumor DNA cleared by week 6 in 20 of 30 evaluable patients (66%). These findings support randomized evaluation of interleukin-1β blockade in this setting. IL-1β targeting may attenuate myeloid-suppressive pathways and support antitumor immunity. Here, the authors report a phase I/II trial of concurrent canakinumab, an anti-IL-1β antibody, with chemoradiotherapy, followed by consolidation canakinumab plus the anti-PD-L1 antibody durvalumab, in patients with unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer.

summary.one_liner: 一项I/II期试验表明，卡纳基单抗联合同步放化疗及度伐利尤单抗巩固治疗不可切除III期非小细胞肺癌达到主要终点，24个月无进展生存率67%。
summary.innovation: 首次在不可切除III期非小细胞肺癌中评估抗IL-1β单抗联合放化疗及PD-L1抑制剂巩固治疗；显示IL-1β阻断可减弱髓源性抑制细胞扩增并促进抗肿瘤免疫；循环肿瘤DNA早期清除及外周免疫动态分析为疗效预测提供潜在生物标志物。
summary.significance: 该研究为IL-1β通路抑制联合标准放化疗及免疫巩固治疗提供了积极的疗效与安全性证据，有望改善局部晚期非小细胞肺癌患者预后。结果支持开展随机对照试验进一步验证，并为靶向肿瘤微环境中的髓系抑制机制开辟了新方向。

papers.title: Silica Aerogel Microcompartments with On-Demand Reactivation Enable Mimicry of Natural Resurrection
papers.abstract: Abstract Mimicking natural resurrection remains extraordinarily challenging. Herein, we report dormant aerogel-based synthetic microcompartments fabricated via a water-in-oil emulsion strategy to produce polyelectrolyte–surfactant complex membrane-coated mesoporous silica aerogel microcompartments loaded with various bioactive enzymes. The dormant aerogel microcompartments feature a high specific surface area (>500 m2/g), mesoporosity, and a superhydrophilic aerogel framework composed of SiO2 nanoparticles. Upon rehydration, the nanoscale capillarity of the aerogel framework, combined with its superhydrophilicity, drives rapid water uptake and recover activity of encapsulated glucose oxidase (Gox), horseradish peroxidase (HRP), and Urease. These dormant aerogel-based biomimetic microcompartments exhibit exceptional robustness: after exposure to elevated temperatures (≤180 °C), high-irradiance illumination, or pulsed electric fields, they recover substantial enzymatic activity, outperforming matched controls. Spatial programming of multiple dormant microcompartments within segregated soft architectures enables hydration-gated chemical communication, as demonstrated by color change in an artificial flower. Furthermore, a chitosan/poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate (PEGDA) bilayer flower embedding three types of dormant microcompartments (Gox@SiO2, HRP@SiO2, and Urease@SiO2) achieves reversible, enzyme-programmed morphochromic and shape actuation over repeated cycles. These dormant aerogel-based microcompartments provide a materials strategy that couples reversible biochemical reactivation with intercompartmental communication and macroscopic deformation, advancing aerogel biomimetics from structural mimicry toward functional actuation. This system provides a robust model for compartmentalized biocatalysis, signal transduction, and soft-matter actuation, enabling studies of mimicking a natural resurrection process.

summary.one_liner: 开发可复活的硅气凝胶微区室，通过复水恢复酶活性，实现自然复苏过程的仿生。
summary.innovation: 利用水包油乳液策略构建聚电解质-表面活性剂膜包覆介孔硅气凝胶微区室；气凝胶超亲水框架的纳毛细作用实现快速复水与酶活性可逆恢复；通过空间编程实现多微区室的化学通讯与变色/形变驱动。
summary.significance: 该材料将气凝胶仿生从结构模仿推进至功能驱动层面，为区室化生物催化、信号转导及软物质致动提供稳健模型。其在热、光、电场等极端条件下仍可恢复活性，有望用于智能生物反应器、感应驱动系统及仿生复活研究。

papers.title: Follicle-Oriented “Acid-Free” Supramolecular Microcapsules Achieve Efficient Acne Therapy via Skin Microbiota Remodeling
papers.abstract: Abstract Acne vulgaris is a multifactorial inflammatory disorder involving follicular obstruction, excessive sebum production, Cutibacterium acnes (C. acnes) colonization, immune activation, and barrier dysfunction. Current topical treatments are often limited by cutaneous irritation, antimicrobial resistance, and insufficient follicular deposition. Here, an acid-free, pH-responsive, follicle-oriented supramolecular polycystic microcapsule (SPM) particles system was developed based on a phosphatidylcholine/pterostilbene deep eutectic solvent (PC/PT DES). In this study, “SPM particles” refers to the optimized approximately 350 nm colloidal formulation, whereas “microcapsule-like” describes the compartmentalized capsule-like internal architecture observed by TEM rather than a micron-scale particle size. SPM particles showed measurable encapsulation of all three active components, storage-relevant colloidal stability, size-mediated preferential follicular deposition at an optimized particle size of approximately 350 nm, and accelerated payload release under acidic conditions. The formulation excluded conventional keratolytic acids and coencapsulated matrine, oligopeptide-32, and Centella asiatica extract to provide complementary antiacne functions. In vitro, SPM particles inhibited C. acnes, induced a membrane-damage-associated antibacterial phenotype, reduced sebocyte lipid accumulation, suppressed inflammatory cytokine release, promoted keratinocyte migration, and upregulated barrier-associated markers. In a C. acnes-induced murine acne-like model, topical SPM particles attenuated inflammatory histopathology and reduced TLR2/NF-κB-associated inflammatory signals. Exploratory 16S rRNA sequencing further showed treatment-associated changes in local skin microbiota composition, which should be interpreted as associative rather than causal evidence. In an early stage 28 day randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical evaluation, SPM particles improved selected acne-associated parameters, including erythema, lesion burden, and porphyrin-related signals, while showing favorable short-term tolerability, with no treatment-related adverse skin reactions recorded during the 28 day observation period. Overall, this PC/PT DES-based SPM particles platform provides an acid-free, follicle-oriented, multicomponent topical strategy with potential for multitarget acne intervention, while longer-term repeated-use safety remains to be established in larger clinical studies.

summary.one_liner: 开发基于磷脂酰胆碱/紫檀芪低共熔溶剂的免酸毛囊靶向超分子微胶囊，通过重塑皮肤菌群实现高效痤疮治疗。
summary.innovation: 构建酸性无刺激的pH响应型毛囊定向超分子微胶囊，实现约350nm尺寸介导的毛囊选择性沉积；共包载苦参碱、寡肽-32及积雪草提取物，多靶点协同抗痤疮；通过膜损伤抗菌机制避免传统抗生素耐药性问题。
summary.significance: 该平台提供了一种免酸、毛囊定向的多组分局部治疗策略，有望突破现有痤疮疗法的刺激性和耐药性局限。临床初步验证改善红斑、皮损及卟啉信号且短期耐受性良好，为多靶点痤疮干预和皮肤微生态调控提供了新方向，但长期安全性需更大规模研究确认。

papers.title: Nanozyme-Driven Tumor Microenvironment Remodeling for Potentiated Phototherapy–Immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Abstract Tumor hypoxia critically drives the development of an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) and accelerates tumor progression. Besides, hypoxia seriously restricts O2-dependent reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, thereby severely compromising the therapeutic efficacy of photodynamic therapy (PDT). To address these challenges, we developed a multifunctional manganese (Mn)-based nanozyme (MLDHI) loaded with indocyanine green (ICG) to reprogram the immunosuppressive TME for potentiated phototherapy combined with immunotherapy. Upon intratumoral injection, the Mn4+ doped within the nanozyme shell catalyzes the decomposition and conversion of overexpressed H2O2 in the tumor tissue into O2, markedly alleviating hypoxia and supplying O2 for ICG-mediated PDT to enhance cytotoxic ROS production. The resulting phototherapeutic efficacy promotes immunogenic cell death (ICD) of tumor cells and releases double-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (dsDNA), which together with Mn2+ embedded in the lamellar structure synergistically activates the cyclic guanosine monophosphate-adenosine monophosphate synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway, triggering interferon (IFN)-β release and dendritic cell (DC) maturation. In a breast tumor model, a single intratumoral injection of MLDHI plus laser irradiation achieved 75% tumor ablation and elicited robust immune memory to prevent recurrence and metastasis.

summary.one_liner: 开发锰基纳米酶催化肿瘤内H2O2产氧缓解缺氧，增强光疗并激活STING通路，协同免疫治疗实现肿瘤消融。
summary.innovation: Mn4+纳米酶壳催化H2O2分解供氧，缓解缺氧并增强ICG介导的光动力疗效；光疗诱导ICD释放dsDNA，与Mn2+协同激活cGAS-STING通路促进DC成熟和IFN-β释放；单次瘤内注射联合激光照射实现75%肿瘤消融并激发免疫记忆。
summary.significance: 该策略同时改善肿瘤乏氧和免疫抑制微环境，突破光动力治疗对氧气的依赖并激活先天免疫，为光疗-免疫联合治疗提供新思路。其诱导的免疫记忆可抑制肿瘤复发和转移，具有临床转化潜力。

papers.title: Drug-Loaded Bacterial Outer Membrane Vesicles Eradicate Intratumoral Fusobacterium nucleatum to Enhance Colorectal Cancer Treatment
papers.abstract: Abstract Colorectal cancer (CRC) represents one of the most commonly diagnosed malignancies in which Fusobacterium nucleatum (Fn) infiltration critically drives tumor progression by fostering an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) that compromises immunotherapy efficacy. Outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) originating from Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 offer an attractive tumor-targeting drug delivery system, combining intrinsic immunostimulatory properties with drug-loading capacity. We therefore developed an OMV-based dual-function system coencapsulating 5-fluorouracil (5-Fu) and metronidazole (MTZ), designated 5-Fu/MTZ@OMVs. In vitro, this system effectively eliminated both CT26 cells and Fn while promoting DC maturation and driving repolarization of M2 macrophages toward M1 as well as N2 neutrophils toward N1. In vivo, upon administration to an Fn-colonized CT26 model, the system homed to tumors, reduced the Fn burden, and inhibited tumor growth, demonstrating its bactericidal and antitumor efficacy. Notably, it reversed immunosuppressive TME by promoting DC maturation, M1 macrophage, and N1 neutrophil polarization, which enhanced the recruitment and functional activation of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells within the tumor. Thus, by integrating bactericidal, antitumor, and immune remodeling activities into a single OMV platform, our strategy constitutes a viable therapeutic approach for Fn-associated CRC.

summary.one_liner: 开发负载5-氟尿嘧啶和甲硝唑的细菌外膜囊泡，根除瘤内具核梭杆菌并重塑免疫微环境，增强结直肠癌治疗效果。
summary.innovation: 构建共包载5-Fu和甲硝唑的双功能OMV系统，同时发挥杀菌与抗肿瘤作用；利用OMV天然免疫刺激活性诱导DC成熟及巨噬细胞/中性粒细胞向抗肿瘤表型极化；实现针对具核梭杆菌相关结直肠癌的菌-瘤-免疫协同干预。
summary.significance: 该策略为具核梭杆菌感染的结直肠癌提供了一体化治疗平台，通过消除致病菌和逆转免疫抑制微环境增强T细胞应答。未来有望与免疫检查点抑制剂联用，提升免疫治疗疗效，并拓展至其他细菌相关肿瘤的精准治疗。

papers.title: Bridging Catalytic Worlds: A Coassembly Platform for Unified Chemoenzymatic Cascades
papers.abstract: Abstract The integration of biocatalytic and chemocatalytic cascades offers a promising route toward sustainable and efficient chemical synthesis. However, inherent incompatibilities between these catalytic systems have impeded progress in this area, particularly regarding their efficient coimmobilization within a single carrier. Herein, we report a general Pickering emulsion-driven interfacial coassembly strategy to construct modular micro/nanoreactors that enable the precise spatial integration of metal nanoparticles and multiple enzymes within a porous crystalline framework, including diverse metal–organic frameworks and covalent organic frameworks. These compartmentalized reactors orchestrate efficient chemoenzymatic one-pot reactions, as demonstrated by the dynamic kinetic resolution of racemic amines via synergistic Pd/enzyme catalysis. Furthermore, this architecture drives effective photoenzymatic cascades and exhibits robust utility in degrading pollutants under demanding conditions. By overcoming limitations inherent to conventional strategies, such as restricted carrier compatibility, insufficient active site exposure, and constrained mass transfer, this work provides a universal solution for integrating otherwise incompatible catalytic reactions.

summary.one_liner: 提出Pickering乳液驱动界面共组装策略，实现金属与酶在框架内的集成，用于化学酶级联反应。
summary.innovation: 开发普适性Pickering乳液界面共组装平台，支持多种MOF/COF框架；实现金属纳米颗粒与多酶在单一载体内的精确空间整合；克服载体兼容性、活性位点暴露和传质限制。
summary.significance: 该策略为构建模块化微纳反应器提供通用方案，可高效催化化学酶一锅反应如动态动力学拆分和光酶级联。有望推动可持续化学合成及复杂污染物降解应用，扩展原本不相容催化反应的集成可能性。

papers.title: Cystine-Dependent Redox Metabolism Determines Photodynamic Therapy Response in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
papers.abstract: Abstract Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) remains difficult to treat without substantial functional and cosmetic morbidity, as current management relies largely on surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy. However, these approaches often fail to achieve effective tumor control in therapy-resistant HNSCC. Photodynamic therapy (PDT) has strong potential for HNSCC treatment because it enables spatially restricted tumor ablation while limiting damage to surrounding healthy tissue. Here, we apply a near-infrared (NIR) cyanine–carborate photosensitizer (PS) platform to HNSCC to identify a redox-based mechanism that limits PDT response in resistant cells and evaluate a strategy for sensitizing resistant cells. Using complementary human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive and -negative HNSCC models, we show that PDT induces acute oxidative stress and lipid peroxidation in both sensitive and resistant cells. However, resistant cells counter this stress through an adaptive redox response marked by increased xCT (SLC7A11)-dependent cystine utilization. This response sustains glutathione-linked antioxidant buffering, limits lipid peroxidation, and promotes survival under PDT. Genetic or pharmacologic disruption of cystine uptake prevents this adaptive defense, restores oxidative vulnerability, and sensitizes PDT-resistant HNSCC cells to treatment. Consistent with these mechanistic findings, cyanine–carborate-induced PDT with xCT (SLC7A11) inhibition markedly suppressed tumor growth in vivo. Together, these findings identify xCT-dependent cystine metabolism as a targetable vulnerability for therapeutic sensitization of resistant HNSCC to PDT.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现头颈部鳞癌通过xCT依赖的胱氨酸代谢抵抗光动力治疗，抑制xCT可增敏治疗并抑制肿瘤生长。
summary.innovation: 揭示PDT耐药细胞通过上调xCT依赖性胱氨酸利用增强谷胱甘肽抗氧化缓冲，限制脂质过氧化并存活；提出基因或药理抑制胱氨酸摄取可恢复氧化脆弱性并增敏耐药细胞；验证近红外花菁-碳硼烷光敏剂联合xCT抑制在体内显著抑制肿瘤生长。
summary.significance: 该发现为PDT耐药的头颈部鳞癌提供了明确的代谢靶点，有望通过联合xCT抑制剂提高光动力治疗疗效。基于机理的联合策略可拓展PDT在难治性肿瘤中的应用，减少手术、放化疗带来的功能与美观损伤。

papers.title: Supracolloidal Chains of Patchy Micelles Triggering Forster Resonance Energy Transfer upon Their Growth for Macroscopic Monitoring of Colloidal Assembly
papers.abstract: Abstract Formation of supracolloidal chains from patchy micelles of diblock copolymers can provide valuable information to understand mechanisms and kinetics of colloidal and molecular assemblies. Direct observation of the assembled supracolloidal chains using microscopy enables statistical evaluation of the progress of the assembly, but sample preparation and data analysis processes prohibit the determination of chain length in the solution state. Here, we demonstrate supracolloidal chains induced from fluorescent diblock copolymers that can self-report the extension of chain length by a shift in emission color. Patchy micelles are engineered to perform Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) interactions that respond spontaneously upon colloidal assembly. For this purpose, fluorophore-functionalized diblock copolymers are designed and synthesized to form patchy micelles incorporated with fluorescent dyes selectively at the patches. Then, two different patchy micelles containing FRET donors or acceptors are prepared and coassembled into supracolloidal chains. The merging of patches between adjacent micelles enables the FRET pairs to come into vicinity inside the patches, allowing the enhancement of red emission occurred by FRET upon the supracolloidal coassembly. The shift in emission color from yellow to scarlet provides macroscopic evidence that can monitor the progress of colloidal assembly simply by observing photoluminescence. Moreover, quantitative analysis of the FRET interaction can be interpreted using step-growth polymerization kinetics, permitting facile real-time tracking of chain length during the progress of colloidal assembly. Lastly, colocalization of FRET pairs within single micelles enabled direct monitoring of solution-state behavior in patchy micelles and colloidal assemblies, which could not be revealed by microscopic structural analysis.

summary.one_liner: 利用荧光嵌段共聚物补丁胶束组装时FRET引发的发射色变化，实现胶体组装过程的宏观实时监测。
summary.innovation: 设计荧光染料定位于补丁的双嵌段共聚物胶束，使FRET对在组装时自发靠近并产生可检测信号；将FRET定量分析与逐步聚合动力学结合，实现链长的实时追踪；通过单胶束内FRET共定位揭示溶液态行为。
summary.significance: 该方法无需显微或复杂制样即可宏观感知胶体组装程度，为理解胶体与分子组装机制提供新工具。其发射色变化可直观指示链长，便于实时监控和动力学研究，在智能材料和纳米医学响应系统中有应用前景。

papers.title: Cu-deficient Cu–Fe Prussian blue analogues enable phosphate/GSH-coupled redox remodeling for catalytic/sonodynamic cancer therapy
papers.abstract: Cu–Fe Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) are promising platforms for nanocatalytic medicine owing to their redox-active Cu/Fe centers and open metal–cyano coordination frameworks. Nevertheless, the influence of Cu deficiency on their enzyme-mimetic catalytic behavior in tumor-relevant environments containing phosphate and glutathione (GSH) remains poorly defined. Here, we constructed a Cu-deficient Cu–Fe PBA core (CuPBA-D), loaded it with hematoporphyrin monomethyl ether (HMME), and coated it with hyaluronic acid (HA) to yield CuPBA-D/HMME/HA for microenvironment-responsive catalytic/sonodynamic cancer therapy. Etching-induced Cu deficiency altered the local Cu/Fe electronic environment, strengthened H 2 O 2 adsorption and activation, and enhanced catalytic activity, as supported by experimental results and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. CuPBA-D displayed pH-dependent H 2 O 2 conversion, with O 2 •− generation favored under mildly acidic conditions and O 2 evolution becoming more prominent near neutrality. Phosphate-containing media also increased the surface fractions of higher-valence Cu/Fe species and accelerated CuPBA-D-mediated GSH consumption, supporting phosphate-facilitated interfacial redox remodeling. In addition, CuPBA-D underwent GSH-concentration-dependent framework disassembly when phosphate and GSH coexisted, indicating coupled interfacial redox and structural evolution. The CAT-like O 2 -generating activity of CuPBA-D increased oxygen availability for HMME-mediated 1 O 2 production during ultrasound irradiation, thereby strengthening the sonodynamic response. In vitro, CuPBA-D/HMME/HA plus ultrasound increased intracellular ROS accumulation and induced ferroptosis-associated damage, supported by biochemical, ultrastructural, and transcriptomic analyses. In a 4T1 breast tumor model, the combined treatment markedly suppressed tumor growth while showing favorable biosafety under the tested conditions. Collectively, these findings identify phosphate/GSH-coupled redox remodeling in Cu-deficient Cu–Fe PBAs and provide a design basis for tumor-microenvironment-responsive nanoplatforms integrating catalytic ROS generation, redox disruption, and O 2 -assisted sonodynamic therapy.

summary.one_liner: 构建铜缺陷Cu-Fe普鲁士蓝类似物纳米平台，通过磷酸盐/GSH耦合氧化还原重塑实现催化联合声动力肿瘤治疗。
summary.innovation: 揭示铜缺陷增强过氧化氢吸附活化的催化机制；发现磷酸盐/GSH协同诱导界面氧化还原重塑与骨架解组装；整合催化产氧与声动力实现级联增效。
summary.significance: 为肿瘤微环境响应的多模式纳米诊疗提供设计依据，拓宽了普鲁士蓝类似物在生物催化领域的应用；该策略可协同产生活性氧、消耗谷胱甘肽并缓解缺氧，有望改善乳腺癌等实体瘤的治疗效果与安全性。

papers.title: Spin-state modulation at Fe-O-Cu interfaces enables dual ferroptotic-cuproptotic cancer therapy
papers.abstract: Engineering the spin states of transition-metal centers represents an unexplored yet powerful strategy to regulate catalytic reactivity and cell-death pathways in nanomedicine. Here, we introduce an interfacial spin-state engineering approach by decorating Fe-based MOFs (MIL-88B(Fe)) with PtCu nanoparticles, yielding FeMOF/PtCu hybrids in which Fe-O-Cu bridge bonds drive a ligand-field rearrangement that converts Fe centers from low-spin Fe 3+ to medium-spin Fe 2+ states under piezoelectric strain. This dynamic spin crossover fundamentally enhances electron transfer, lowers reaction barriers for H 2 O 2 decomposition, and maximizes ROS generation. Importantly, the redox interplay of Fe and Cu concurrently activates ferroptosis (lipid peroxidation/GSH depletion) and cuproptosis (mitochondrial proteotoxic stress), producing a dual regulated-cell-death synergy. Beyond cell killing, the oxidative stress triggers robust immunogenic cell death, dendritic-cell maturation, and durable antitumor immunity in vivo. Our findings establish spin-state modulation at metal-metal oxide interfaces as a new paradigm to couple redox catalysis with multimodal RCD, offering a transformative route for piezoelectric-driven cancer immunotherapy.

summary.one_liner: 通过Fe-O-Cu界面自旋态调控，将Fe转化为中自旋态，增强ROS生成并协同诱导铁死亡和铜死亡，实现压电驱动的肿瘤免疫治疗。
summary.innovation: 首次提出界面自旋态工程策略，利用Fe-O-Cu桥键和压电应变实现Fe自旋态动态转换；通过Fe/Cu氧化还原协同激活铁死亡与铜死亡双通路，并引发免疫原性细胞死亡增强抗肿瘤免疫。
summary.significance: 该研究为金属-金属氧化物界面的自旋态调控提供了新范式，将氧化还原催化与多模态调节性细胞死亡相结合。其压电驱动特性有望为深层肿瘤的无线精准治疗和免疫联合疗法提供新思路，具有临床转化潜力。

papers.title: Synthesis, preclinical evaluation, and the first-in-human study of [18F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR for neuroendocrine neoplasms compared with [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-NOC and [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE
papers.abstract: To improve the detection of neuroendocrine neoplasms (NENs), we developed a series of octreotide-based somatostatin receptor (SSTR)-targeted probes and sought to identify an optimal candidate through preclinical and clinical head-to-head evaluation versus [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE and [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-NOC. Eight original probes were synthesised and radiolabelled with 68 Ga or 18 F. The in vitro stability of the probes in saline and human serum, as well as their in vivo stability through urine sampling, was determined by radio-high-performance liquid chromatography (radio-HPLC). Micro-PET/CT imaging was performed in AR42J xenograft-bearing mice 60 min after injection of the radiotracers via the tail vein. On the basis of preclinical screening, [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR was selected for clinical PET/CT and directly compared with [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE and [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-NOC in patients with NENs. All probes were successfully synthesised and radiolabelled with high radiochemical purity (> 98%) and showed good in vitro and in vivo stability (> 95% for 2 h). Among them, [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR demonstrated the highest tumour uptake on micro-PET/CT in the AR42J model (41.17 ± 2.50%ID/g at 60 min), exceeding that of [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-NOC (29.67 ± 1.53%ID/g) and [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE (11.2 ± 1.13%ID/g). In clinical PET/CT studies, [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR detected lesions not identified by either [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-NOC or [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE. In a patient with liver metastases, [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR showed higher lesion uptake than [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE at both early and delayed imaging. At the early imaging time point (45–60 min post-injection), the SUVmax values of [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE and [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR were 8.3 and 8.9, respectively. A delayed scan was performed approximately 30 min after the initial imaging session, the corresponding SUVmax values were 10.6 and 8.8, respectively, with a liver background SUVmax of 6.9. In a patient with metastatic pulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma, [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR (SUVmax = 13.6 for rib, SUVmax = 9.1 for thoracic vertebrae) also demonstrated markedly greater sensitivity than [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-NOC (SUVmax = 1.4 for rib, SUVmax = 1.8 for thoracic vertebrae) for detecting bone metastases. We developed several novel SSTR-targeted probes with favourable physicochemical properties and identified [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR as the most promising candidate. Compared with [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE and [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTA-NOC, [ 18 F]AlF-NOTA-FZSR showed superior lesion detection in patients with NENs, supporting its potential for clinical translation.

papers.title: Multifunctional biogel-integrated wireless e-bandage for smartphone-controlled diabetic wound management
papers.abstract: Chronic diabetic wounds, among the most persistent clinical complications of diabetes mellitus, arise from a convergence of sustained inflammation, microbial colonization, oxidative stress, and impaired angiogenesis. Conventional wound care strategies often fail to simultaneously address these interconnected pathological barriers, resulting in delayed healing and high recurrent infection. Herein, we report a smartphone-integrated wearable e-bandage incorporating a multifunctional conductive biogel (ZnG-BG) for accelerated diabetic wound repair. ZnG-BG was fabricated using Prosopis juliflora gum, chitosan, gelatin, and bio-capped ZnO nanoparticles, yielding a thermoresponsive, adhesive (42.2 kPa), flexible, and electrically conductive (0.005–0.035 S/cm) interface capable of intimate skin contact and stable signal transmission. Moreover, ZnG-BG exhibited broad antibacterial, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory activities, while its combination with electrical stimulation (ES) further enhanced bacterial killing and biofilm disruption. Cellular studies demonstrated reduced intracellular oxidative stress and modulation of macrophage inflammatory responses, supporting a favorable microenvironment for tissue repair. In vitro, ES + ZnG-BG enhanced fibroblast migration while maintaining favorable cytocompatibility. The wearable e-bandage delivered monophasic rectangular pulses (35 V, 100 Hz, 100 µs pulse width, 1% duty cycle), while the ZnG-BG interface reduced tissue–electrode impedance and facilitated electrical coupling. In a streptozotocin-induced diabetic rat model, ES + ZnG-BG achieved 99.4 ± 0.5% wound closure within 14 days, outperforming the individual treatments. Histological and molecular analyses demonstrated improved tissue regeneration and collagen organization accompanied by attenuation of pro-inflammatory signaling (TNF-α, IL-6) and progression toward a pro-regenerative (IL-10, TGF-β) wound environment. Systemic biosafety evaluation further revealed no detectable treatment-related abnormalities in hematological and biochemical parameters or major-organ histology. By seamlessly integrating wearable bioelectronics with a multifunctional ZnG-BG interface, this work introduces a minimally invasive and adaptable therapeutic platform with substantial translational relevance for chronic diabetic wound management.

summary.one_liner: 开发智能电子绷带集成多功能导电生物凝胶，结合电刺激促进糖尿病慢性伤口愈合，实现手机控制与高效修复。
summary.innovation: 采用牧豆树胶、壳聚糖、明胶及生物封端ZnO构建兼具粘附性、导电性和多重生物活性的ZnG-BG凝胶；将导电凝胶与电刺激协同增强抗菌、抗生物膜及免疫调节效应；实现智能手机控制的无线可穿戴系统并验证体内促愈合与安全性。
summary.significance: 该平台同时应对炎症、感染、氧化应激和血管生成障碍，提供非侵入式慢性伤口管理方案；术后14天达99.4%闭合率，并具良好生物相容性，为糖尿病溃疡治疗提供可转化电子敷料策略。

papers.title: Unravelling the Atomic‐Scale Surface Chemistry for Intrinsically Bright and Stable Luminescence in CdSe Quantum Platelets
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional colloidal CdSe quantum platelets (QPLs) represent a promising class of next-generation luminescent materials, yet the atomic-level surface chemistry that governs their optoelectronic properties remains poorly understood. In this study, we combine ligand passivation experiments with density functional theory (DFT) to establish a comprehensive atomic-scale surface structure model. The model explicitly identifies four characteristic surface features of pristine QPLs: under-coordinated Cd and Se atoms, along with CdX and SeMX binding modes. Our results demonstrate that native X-type carboxylates provide baseline Cd-site passivation (CdX), yielding an initial photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of approximately 30%. L-type amines or phosphines disrupt native CdX passivation by forming CdXL, CdL, or SeL configurations, which induces more deep traps and quench fluorescence. Z*-type halide-amine ligands initially induce similar disruption, but they ultimately reorganize into a stable SeMXL binding mode that surpasses the original emission intensity. In contrast, Z-type ligands can rapidly achieve complete surface passivation via SeMX coordination by effectively eliminating Se-site deep trap states, boosting their fluorescence. In particular, passivation with Z-type cadmium octanoate equips the QPLs synthesized in ambient air with a record PLQY of 95%, together with exceptional spectral purity and enhanced emission stability.

summary.one_liner: 通过配体钝化实验与DFT计算，揭示CdSe量子片的原子级表面化学，实现95%发光量子产率。
summary.innovation: 建立了CdSe量子片原子级表面结构模型，明确四种特征表面位点及配体结合模式；发现Z型羧酸镉配体通过SeMX配位消除Se位深陷阱，实现近乎完美的表面钝化；在空气合成条件下获得创纪录的95%光致发光量子产率及优异发光稳定性。
summary.significance: 该研究从原子尺度阐明了表面配体与量子片发光性能的构效关系，为二维胶体纳米晶的表面工程提供了理论指导。所发展的Z型配体钝化策略可在常规空气环境中制备高亮度、高纯度和高稳定性发光材料，推动其在显示、照明及生物标记等领域的实际应用。

papers.title: Next‐Generation Magnetic Particle Imaging: Innovations In System Architectures, Tracer Engineering, and Clinical Translation
papers.abstract: Magnetic Particle Imaging (MPI) is an emerging tracer-based imaging modality that enables real-time, quantitative visualization with zero tissue background, high sensitivity, and depth-independent signal detection. Unlike conventional imaging methods that rely on intrinsic tissue contrast or radioactive decay, MPI image formation is governed by the nonlinear magnetization dynamics of superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles, making imaging performance fundamentally dependent on nanoparticle properties and magnetic field generation. This review presents a system- and materials-oriented overview of MPI. We first summarize the physical principles of MPI, including nonlinear magnetization, relaxation dynamics, and field-free-region-based spatial encoding. We then review representative MPI system architectures, ranging from closed-bore preclinical scanners to open, single-sided, hand-held, and hybrid platforms, and discuss how scaling, power consumption, and accessibility influence system performance in preclinical and human-scale settings. We further highlight rational tracer engineering using a "Core-Shell-Function" framework, emphasizing how magnetic core design, surface modification, and functionalization together determine signal generation, in vivo behavior, and imaging performance. Finally, we summarize key biomedical applications, including cell tracking, angiography, tumor imaging, and intraoperative guidance, and discuss remaining challenges for clinical translation. This review provides an integrated framework for advancing MPI toward functional imaging and precision medicine.

summary.one_liner: 系统综述磁粒子成像的系统架构、示踪剂工程与临床转化进展，构建核心-壳层-功能设计框架，推动精准医学应用。
summary.innovation: 提出“核心-壳层-功能”示踪剂理性设计框架，系统关联纳米颗粒结构与成像性能；全面梳理从封闭式到手持式及混合平台的系统架构演进，对比临床前与人体尺度技术挑战。
summary.significance: 为MPI从临床前研究迈向临床转化提供系统化指导，助力细胞追踪、血管成像及术中导航等应用；有望推动实时高灵敏成像在功能影像与精准医疗中的实际落地。

papers.title: Plasmonic Metals and Semiconductor Supports for Photothermal CO 2 Reforming of Methane: Recent Advances, Mechanistic Insights, and Future Opportunities
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photothermal dry reforming of methane (DRM) has emerged as a promising strategy for simultaneously mitigating the greenhouse effect and valorizing carbon resources by converting CH 4 and CO 2 into syngas under solar irradiation. In photothermal DRM systems, photons not only induce localized heating but also generate energetic charge carriers that actively participate in CH 4 and CO 2 activation, enabling reaction pathways inaccessible under purely thermal conditions and promoting catalysis under nonequilibrium regimes. In this review, we first systematically examine the fundamental mechanisms underpinning photothermal DRM. We then summarize recent advances in photothermal DRM catalysts, encompassing plasmonic metals, and metal‐semiconductor hybrids, with an emphasis on structure‐activity‐stability relationships. Finally, we discuss key challenges and future opportunities in mechanistic understanding, catalyst design, and reactor integration, aiming to provide guiding principles for the rational development of efficient and durable solar‐driven DRM technologies.

summary.one_liner: 综述光热甲烷干重整中等离子体金属与半导体载体的催化机制、材料进展及未来方向。
summary.innovation: 系统阐明光热协同中热效应与高能载流子对CH4/CO2活化的非平衡路径；总结等离激元金属及金属-半导体异质结的结构-活性-稳定性关系；提出机理认知、催化剂设计及反应器集成的前瞻性策略。
summary.significance: 该综述为太阳能驱动干重整催化剂理性设计提供指导，有助于实现温和条件下温室气体高效转化与合成气生产。推动光热催化从基础研究向规模化太阳燃料应用发展，助力碳资源循环利用。

papers.title: Transition-Metal Incorporation Enables Reverse Saturable Absorption in Gold Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Abstract Gold nanoparticles are renowned for intense localized surface plasmon resonances, featuring intense linear light extinction and low threshold saturable absorption, yet the reverse saturable absorption (RSA) in gold nanoparticles is typically limited to small clusters. Here, we show that alloying gold with iron or cobalt enables RSA at sizes readily achieved by standard nanoparticle synthesis methods. The size-dependent (5–34 nm) nonlinear optical response of colloidal bimetallic Au–Fe and Au–Co nanoalloys synthesized by laser ablation in liquid are investigated with open-aperture z-scan measurements at 532 nm and compared with monometallic Au nanoparticles. While pure Au exhibits no RSA, Au–Fe and Au–Co nanoalloys display RSA at larger sizes with remarkable nonlinear absorption cross sections up to 1012 GM. This behavior is attributed to alloy-induced transitions involving virtually bound states near the Fermi energy, providing a practical route to engineer nonlinear optical responses.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现金与铁或钴合金化可使较大尺寸金纳米颗粒产生反饱和吸收，非线性吸收截面高达10^12 GM。
summary.innovation: 首次在标准合成尺寸（5-34 nm）的胶体双金属Au-Fe和Au-Co纳米合金中实现反饱和吸收；通过过渡金属合金化引入费米能级附近的虚束缚态，赋予金纳米颗粒可调控的非线性光学响应；采用激光烧蚀液相法合成合金纳米颗粒，避免表面配体干扰。
summary.significance: 该研究突破了纯金纳米颗粒仅在小团簇中表现反饱和吸收的限制，为非线性光学材料设计提供了实用新路径。其超大非线性吸收截面有望用于光学限幅、激光防护和光电器件等领域，推动纳米合金在光子技术中的实际应用。

papers.title: Nanotechnology-Driven Precision Diagnostics and Therapeutics for Preeclampsia
papers.abstract: Abstract Preeclampsia originates in placental dysfunction yet it is detected only after maternal hypertension and proteinuria or other organ damage emerge, by which point disease-modifying interventions are not available, and delivery of the baby and placenta remains the only cure. Nanotechnology offers a route to reduce this diagnostic-therapeutic latency. Nanostructured biosensors and liquid biopsy platforms detect placental proteins, cell-free RNA/DNA, and extracellular vesicles at femtomolar concentrations and in a multiplex manner, enabling earlier risk stratification when integrated with machine-learning models. In parallel, placenta-targeted lipid-, peptide-, polymeric-, dendrimeric-, and small extracellular vesicle-based nanocarriers deliver angiogenic mRNA, antiangiogenic siRNA, antioxidants, and immunomodulators selectively to the trophoblast cells while limiting fetal exposure. Placenta-on-a-chip platforms and ex vivo placental perfusion models provide human-relevant test beds for these systems. We critically appraise these advances, examine the safety-by-design, manufacturing bottlenecks, and regulatory constraints unique to obstetric nanomedicine, and outline the convergence of theranostics and digital health that could move preeclampsia care from reactive symptom management toward proactive, placenta-targeted monitoring and therapy.

summary.one_liner: 纳米技术实现先兆子痫早期诊断与胎盘靶向治疗，推动产科纳米医学从症状管理转向主动干预。
summary.innovation: 开发纳米生物传感器与液体活检平台，实现胎盘蛋白、cfRNA/DNA及细胞外囊泡的多重超灵敏检测；设计胎盘靶向纳米载体，递送mRNA、siRNA及抗氧化剂等至滋养层细胞并限制胎儿暴露；整合胎盘芯片与离体灌注模型作为人源化测试平台。
summary.significance: 该研究可显著缩短先兆子痫的诊断-治疗延迟，实现早期风险分层与精准干预。结合机器学习与数字健康，有望开发治疗诊断一体化系统，变革产科疾病管理模式，并推动安全设计与监管框架的完善。

papers.title: Opening Avenues for Rheumatoid Arthritis Treatment via Transdermal Application of Microneedles: Progress so far and Future Outlook
papers.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease with a global prevalence of 0.5% to 2%, causing serious impairment and early mortality. Presently approved therapeutics comprising non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (DMARDs), corticosteroids, etc. only lower pain, edema, and inflammation. Most of these therapeutics have been administered orally, intravenously, and intra-articularly, minimizing patient adherence. Additionally, high doses of these drugs need to be taken for a long duration and have poor specificity, causing fatal side effects. The conventional and nanocarrier (NCs)-based topical cargo delivery pose challenges like poor residence, possibility of skin reactions, and low patient adherence. Therefore, transdermal delivery of these therapeutics using microneedles (MNs) can be promising to improve permeability, bioavailability, targeting, and patient compliance while minimizing side effects. Moreover, NCs-assisted MNs, biomimetic NCs-based MNs, and MNs for biologics delivery have also emerged as a promising platform for targeting RA efficiently. This review attempts to give an overview on the transdermal drug delivery using MNs and NCs-based MNs in the efficient management of RA. Thus, different MNs and their amalgamation with NCs could effectively deliver and manage RA via the transdermal route.

summary.one_liner: 综述微针经皮递药及纳米载体复合微针治疗类风湿关节炎的进展与前景，旨在提高药物渗透性、生物利用度与依从性。
summary.innovation: 系统归纳微针联合纳米载体、仿生纳米载体及生物制剂递送平台用于类风湿关节炎靶向治疗；提出经皮微针给药可克服传统口服/注射高剂量、低特异性及副作用问题；整合不同微针类型与纳米载体在透皮途径中的协同优势。
summary.significance: 该综述为类风湿关节炎的无创、高效治疗提供了新策略，有望改善患者依从性并降低全身毒性。未来可推动微针及纳米复合微针制剂的临床转化，实现个性化与精准治疗。

papers.title: SLC46A3 Mediates Lysosomal Egress of Auristatin Derivatives
papers.abstract: Abstract The lysosomal transporter SLC46A3 has been implicated in the pharmacology of antibody−drug conjugates (ADCs) by facilitating the transport of payloads from lysosomes to the cytosol. To date, two payload classes, maytansinoid catabolites (e.g., DM1 and Lys-SMCC-DM1) and the pyrrolobenzodiazepine (PBD) dimer SG3199, have been identified as SLC46A3 substrates; however, the transport mechanisms for other payloads remain to be elucidated. Auristatin derivatives (auristatins) are among the most widely deployed payloads in approved ADCs, yet the mechanism by which these highly potent peptides egress from the lysosome remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate that SLC46A3 directly transports auristatins. At pH 5.0, mimicking the lysosomal environment, SLC46A3 significantly facilitated the membrane transport of all tested auristatins, whereas transport via passive diffusion was negligible. Among the auristatins, monomethyl auristatin F (MMAF), which bears a negative charge, was a superior substrate for SLC46A3 compared to monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE), a finding consistent with the preference of SLC46A3 for organic anions. Interestingly, MMAF conjugated with a non-cleavable maleimidocaproyl (mc) linker, was also recognized as an SLC46A3 substrate, exhibiting higher transport activity than unmodified MMAF. Furthermore, depletion of SLC46A3 in HER2-positive cancer cells attenuated the cytotoxicity of trastuzumab-mcMMAF, suggesting that SLC46A3 mediates the lysosomal egress of its active metabolites. Taken together, our findings highlight lysosomal transporters including SLC46A3, as critical determinants of the efficient cytoplasmic release of auristatins, providing an opportunity to optimize ADC efficacy.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现溶酶体转运蛋白SLC46A3直接介导auristatin类ADC载荷的溶酶体逸出，并影响其细胞毒性。
summary.innovation: 首次证明SLC46A3直接转运auristatin衍生物；发现带负电的MMAF及其非可裂解mc连接子偶联物均为SLC46A3底物，且偶联物转运活性更高；揭示SLC46A3敲低可减弱trastuzumab-mcMMAF的细胞毒性。
summary.significance: 该发现明确了溶酶体转运体是auristatin高效胞质释放的关键决定因素，为优化ADC设计和提高疗效提供了新靶点与策略，填补了auristatin溶酶体逃逸机制的研究空白。

papers.title: A Dicyanocobinamide Conjugate of the GLP-1R Agonist Exendin-4 Improves Glucose Homeostasis in Tumor-Bearing Rats without Exacerbating Anorexia and Weight Loss
papers.abstract: Abstract Cancer anorexia−cachexia syndrome (CACS) is a prevalent and debilitating complication of malignancy, characterized by reduced food intake, loss of skeletal muscle mass, and severe metabolic dysfunction. Insulin resistance and impaired glucose tolerance are prominent features of CACS and contribute to worsened prognosis, yet treatment options that improve metabolic regulation without exacerbating anorexia are limited. Although GLP-1 receptor (GLP-1R) agonists effectively enhance glucose control, their centrally mediated anorectic and aversive effects limit their use in cancer patients. To address this limitation, we developed a peripherally restricted GLP-1R agonist by conjugating exendin-4 (Ex4) to dicyanocobinamide (Cbi), a vitamin B12-derived corrin ring with minimal blood−brain barrier penetration. Here, we evaluate Cbi-Ex4 in vitro and across healthy and tumor-bearing rodent models. Cbi-Ex4 retained GLP-1R agonism and improved glucose tolerance without inducing anorexia, weight loss, or malaise, in contrast to native Ex4. These findings support peripheralized GLP-1R agonism as a promising strategy to improve metabolic dysfunction in cancer without worsening malaise and cachexia.

summary.one_liner: 将Exendin-4与二氰基钴胺素偶联形成外周限制性GLP-1R激动剂，改善肿瘤大鼠血糖且不加重厌食和体重下降。
summary.innovation: 利用维生素B12衍生物Cbi偶联Exendin-4实现外周限制性作用；在肿瘤模型中保留GLP-1R激动效应同时避免中枢介导的厌食和厌恶反应。
summary.significance: 为癌症厌食-恶病质综合征患者的代谢紊乱提供了新治疗策略。该策略有望弥补现有GLP-1R激动剂在肿瘤患者中因加重厌食而受限的不足，改善血糖控制而不恶化生活质量。

papers.title: FXF‐OMe Is a Stable Tripeptide Motif for Ultra‐Short Peptide Coacervates That Establishes Structure‐Property‐Function Relationships
papers.abstract: Ultra-short peptide coacervates (USPCs), formed via liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) of peptides containing five or fewer amino acids, offer a minimal platform for microreactors and for probing structure-property relationships governing LLPS and liquid-to-solid transitions (LSTs). USPCs form uniquely hydrophobic liquid interiors compared to larger peptide-based and complex coacervates, enabling aqueous reactivity with hydrophobic substrates. As a result, USPCs have emerged as promising candidates for next-generation microreactors with the potential to surpass nanoparticle-based systems in modularity, scalability, and biocompatibility. Existing USPCs face two major challenges: poor stability against LSTs, which irreversibly eliminate the liquid microenvironment, and a lack of well-developed structure-property relationships that would enable rational materials design. Here, we establish FXF-OMe as a minimal motif, inspired by previously reported sticker-spacer USPC motifs, that dramatically enhances resistance to LSTs while enabling investigation of structure-property relationships. Using this platform, we identify hydrophobic effects as the dominant determinant of coacervate material properties over specific peptide-peptide interactions. We further demonstrate that improved stability and tunability enable selective dye partitioning, enhanced reaction yields, and kinetic control in sulfur photo-oxidation reactions. Collectively, these results position FXF-OMe as a foundation for de novo USPC design and establish USPCs as tunable, stable platforms for precision microreactor applications.

summary.one_liner: FXF-OMe三肽基序可稳定形成超短肽凝聚液滴，提升抗液固转变能力，并揭示结构与功能关系。
summary.innovation: 发现FXF-OMe作为最小稳定基序，显著增强超短肽凝聚体对液固转变的抵抗性；明确疏水效应是决定凝聚体材料性质的主导因素，超越特异性肽-肽相互作用；通过稳定性和可调性实现选择性染料分配及硫光氧化反应的动力学控制。
summary.significance: 该研究为超短肽凝聚体的理性设计提供了简化平台，推动了结构-性能-功能关系的建立。同时，稳定的超短肽凝聚体可作为精准微反应器，在绿色催化、药物递送及仿生纳米技术领域具有广阔应用前景。

papers.title: Single‐Molecule Detection of Enzymatic PET Hydrolysis Using Fluorogenic Probe‐Doped PET Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Enzymatic depolymerization of plastics offers a sustainable route to polymer recycling, yet the mechanism of action of poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET) hydrolases at solid polymer interfaces remains poorly understood. In particular, it is still unclear whether individual enzymes perform isolated cleavage events or catalyze multiple successive reactions during a single adsorption event. Here, we employ fluorogenic probe‐doped PET nanoparticles together with a leaf‐branch compost cutinase variant (LCC ICCG ) to visualize interfacial PET hydrolysis at the single‐molecule level and reveal the dynamic principles governing interfacial catalysis. Fluorescence trajectories reveal multi‐burst events with short intervals, consistent with semi‐processive hydrolysis during a single enzyme adsorption event. Based on the quantitative correspondence between the experimentally observed fraction of multi‐burst events and the simulated nearest‐neighbor distance distribution, we estimate an apparent effective reaction distance of approximately 2 nm for individual enzymes. We further show that burst frequency exhibits a nonmonotonic temperature dependence governed by the surface‐chain mobility near the glass transition, whereas the overall PET degradation rate increases continuously. Our findings provide a quantitative framework linking enzyme dynamics, the local reaction environment, and polymer interfacial physics, providing a basis for engineering more efficient PET hydrolases.

summary.one_liner: 利用荧光探针掺杂PET纳米颗粒，在单分子水平揭示PET水解酶界面催化动态机制。
summary.innovation: 开发氟ogenic探针掺杂PET纳米颗粒实现单分子水平可视化界面水解；发现酶单次吸附可引发半持续性多burst水解事件，估算有效反应距离约2 nm；揭示burst频率与温度呈非单调关系，受玻璃化转变附近表面链迁移率调控。
summary.significance: 该研究提供了连接酶动力学、局部反应环境与聚合物界面物理的定量框架，深化了对塑料降解酶工作机制的理解，为设计更高效的PET水解酶及优化酶法塑料回收工艺提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Hydrogel Microneedle‐Integrated Electrochemical Sensor With Negative‐Potential Readout Toward Wash‐Free and Anti‐Interference Monitoring of miRNAs in Tumor Interstitial Fluid
papers.abstract: Electrochemical quantification of microRNAs (miRNAs) in tumor interstitial fluid (TIF) may provide complementary molecular information for tumor microenvironment assessment, but analytical accuracy is often limited by extraction-induced biomarker loss/degradation and background interference from endogenous electroactive metabolites. Herein, a hydrogel microneedle-integrated electrochemical biosensor is developed as a complementary ex vivo molecular sensing approach for wash-free and anti-interference monitoring of miRNAs via negative-potential readout. The sensing platform employs a four-way junction (FWJ) nucleic acid nanoreservoir to encapsulate the electroactive indicator doxorubicin (DOX), which is released upon target miRNA-triggered strand displacement. The characteristic oxidation potential of DOX (-0.65 V) enables detection in a negative potential window, thereby reducing co-oxidation interference by endogenous electroactive species. The porous hydrogel microneedle architecture facilitates rapid TIF sampling and directional diffusion of released DOX toward the electrode interface. The biosensor achieved a detection limit of 1.25 pM for miRNA-21 with an interassay variability of <1.9%. Preliminary analysis of clinical TIF samples from breast cancer and healthy donors further supported the feasibility of direct miRNA detection, yielding an AUC of 0.92. This work offers a novel strategy by integrating ex vivo in situ TIF sampling with negative-potential readout to achieve wash-free and anti-interference detection of biomarkers in complex physiological matrices.

summary.one_liner: 开发水凝胶微针集成电化学生物传感器，通过负电位读出实现肿瘤间质液中miRNA的无清洗抗干扰检测。
summary.innovation: 采用四路连接核酸纳米储库封装电活性指示剂DOX，靶标触发链置换释放并产生负电位信号；多孔水凝胶微针实现快速采样与定向扩散，避免生物标志物损失；负电位窗口有效抑制内源性电活性代谢物干扰。
summary.significance: 该传感器无需清洗步骤即可直接检测复杂生理样本中的miRNA，检测限达1.25 pM且重复性好。临床样本分析显示其区分乳腺癌与健康供体的AUC为0.92，为肿瘤微环境评估和液体活检提供了新型分子传感工具。

papers.title: Profiling Inflammatory Pathogenesis and Therapy: Ratiometric Photoacoustic Imaging of Energy Metabolism Dynamics With Upconversion Nanoprobes
papers.abstract: NAD(P)H is a critical redox cofactor in cellular energy metabolism, yet real-time monitoring of its spatiotemporal dynamics in pathological contexts remains challenging due to the limited penetration depth and resolution of conventional imaging modalities. In this study, we developed a dual-modal ratiometric imaging nanoprobe that enables precise photoacoustic (PA) and upconversion luminescence imaging of this energy metabolism substrates. The nanoprobe conjugates an NAD(P)H-responsive chromophore and an internal reference dye onto NIR-excited upconversion nanoparticles, enabling self-calibrated quantification through ratiometric UCL and mPAT signals. This design minimizes artifacts from nanoprobe distribution and environmental variations, enhancing spatiotemporal accuracy. The utility of the nanoprobe is demonstrated in multiple disease models: it visualizes metabolic reprogramming during macrophage M1 polarization, tracks aberrant NAD(P)H accumulation in drug-induced and acute liver injury (ALI), and monitors metabolic responses to NAC and 2-DG interventions. Furthermore, in a calorie restriction (CR) combined immunotherapy model, the nanoprobe reveals that the TLR7/8 agonist R848 and glycolytic inhibitor 2-DG synergistically suppress tumor growth by reprogramming tumor-associated macrophage metabolism. This work provides a robust imaging platform for tracking energy metabolism dynamics, offering insights into the interplay between metabolic pathways and inflammatory diseases for developing targeted therapies.

summary.one_liner: 开发上转换纳米探针，通过比率光声成像实时监测NAD(P)H动态，揭示炎症代谢重编程与治疗机制。
summary.innovation: 构建UCL与光声双模态比率成像探针，实现能量代谢底物NAD(P)H的自校准定量检测；在巨噬细胞极化、肝损伤及联合免疫治疗模型中可视化代谢动态；首次揭示TLR7/8激动剂与糖酵解抑制剂协同抗肿瘤的代谢重编程机制。
summary.significance: 解决了传统成像深度与分辨率不足的瓶颈，为炎症疾病中能量代谢的时空追踪提供普适平台。该技术可指导代谢靶向治疗策略开发，推动炎症与肿瘤免疫治疗的基础研究和临床转化。

papers.title: Nanocatalytic Phase Separation Augments Tumor‐specific cGAS‐STING Activation for Spinal Metastasized Breast Cancer Metalloimmunotherapy
papers.abstract: The cGAS-STING pathway is a pivotal therapeutic target for antitumor immunity, yet clinical translation of its small-molecule agonists is hindered by poor tumor specificity, suboptimal pharmacokinetics, and systemic off-target effects. Here, we report a nanocatalytic strategy based on a tumor microenvironment (TME)-responsive iron-oxygen-vanadium metal-organic framework (MIL-88B(Fe─O─V)) that enables tumor-specific cGAS-STING activation via catalytic phase separation for targeted immunotherapy in spinal metastasized breast cancer. Specifically, MIL-88B(Fe─O─V) undergoes disassembly within the acidic TME to release iron ions and polyoxovanadate (POV). Iron ions enable catalytic reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation to release double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) and induce immunogenic cell death (ICD). Critically, we demonstrate for the first time that POV potently promotes liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) of cGAS, enhancing its affinity for dsDNA and amplifying STING pathway activation in dendritic cells (DCs) without systemic immune dysregulation. Such combinational ICD induction and LLPS-driven cGAS activation synergistically boost DC maturation, cytotoxic T-cell responses, and establish durable antitumor immunity. In spinal metastasis models, MIL-88B(Fe─O─V) not only achieves robust tumor regression and prolonged survival, but also mitigates cancer-related pain via IFN-β-mediated suppression of TRPV1 channel activity. Our findings unveil a paradigm of nanocatalytic STING activation for advanced metastatic cancer metalloimmunotherapy and cancer pain alleviation.

summary.one_liner: 报道一种肿瘤微环境响应性铁氧钒金属有机框架，通过催化相分离激活cGAS-STING通路，用于脊柱转移乳腺癌免疫治疗与止痛。
summary.innovation: 首次发现多氧钒酸（POV）可促进cGAS液-液相分离，增强其与dsDNA亲和力并放大STING激活；设计TME酸响应型MIL-88B(Fe─O─V)纳米催化剂，同时实现铁基ROS诱导免疫原性死亡与POV催化相分离联合作用。
summary.significance: 该策略解决了cGAS-STING小分子激动剂肿瘤特异性差和系统毒性问题，为转移性肿瘤金属免疫治疗提供新范式。在脊柱转移模型中实现肿瘤消退和生存期延长，并通过IFN-β抑制TRPV1缓解癌痛，兼具抗肿瘤与镇痛应用前景。

papers.title: Dual‑Channel Hypoxia Detection Using PET‐Based Water‐Soluble Cyanine Probes to Suppress False Negatives in Image‑Guided Pancreatic Cancer Resection
papers.abstract: Fluorescence‑guided surgery using activatable probes is promising, but single‑channel probes often give false negatives-especially in pancreatic cancer due to tumor heterogeneity and limited imaging depth. Here, we built a universal charge-switching gated PET platform based on cyanine dyes bearing a meso-quinolinium moiety. This platform-by decoupling quenching from the recognition group-enabled the construction of two structurally analogous, hypoxia-activatable near-infrared (NIR) probes (Cy5-Ql-NTR and Cy7-Ql-NTR), which have comparable responsive kinetics (sensitive, fast-responding, and low-background), good water solubility and favorable renal clearance, but differ in tissue imaging depth: the former generates brighter signals in superficial regions, while the latter enables deeper tissue penetration and serves as a self-calibration reference. Notably, compared to a single probe, the combined metabolic distribution of the two probes covers a broader range of tumor target tissues. Through their dual-channel imaging, depth-dependent signal attenuation is corrected, and blind spots during probe delivery are reduced. Compared to single-channel fluorescence-guided surgery in subcutaneous pancreatic cancer and orthotopic pancreatic tumor, the dual-channel approach yielded clean margins, preserved significantly more normal tissue, and left no residual tumor on histology. This self-referenced detection strategy suppresses false negatives in single-channel detection, offering a practical and optimized solution for intraoperative guidance in pancreatic cancer.

summary.one_liner: 开发基于花菁的水溶性双通道低氧探针，校准信号衰减，抑制胰腺癌手术导航中的假阴性。
summary.innovation: 构建电荷开关门控PET平台，将猝灭与识别基团解耦，设计出响应动力学相似的近红外探针Cy5-Ql-NTR和Cy7-Ql-NTR；双通道成像可校正深度信号衰减并减少递送盲区，实现自参考检测。
summary.significance: 该策略有效克服了单通道探针在胰腺癌异质性和有限成像深度下的假阴性问题，提升手术切缘准确性。双通道探针兼具浅表高亮与深部穿透优势，组合代谢分布覆盖更广泛肿瘤组织，为临床术中导航提供实用优化方案。

papers.title: A Self‐Assembling Janus Dendron‐Modified Phthalocyanine Enables Deep Tumor‐Targeted Therapy for Gastric Cancer Peritoneal Metastases
papers.abstract: Peritoneal metastasis is a leading cause of mortality in end-stage gastric cancer and remains poorly responsive to conventional chemotherapy. To address this unmet need, Janus dendron-modified phthalocyanines were developed as tumor-targeted photosensitizers for photodynamic therapy (PDT). A series of Janus dendron-modified phthalocyanines with tailored surface functionalities s synthesized, exhibiting spontaneous self-assembly into nanoparticles with augmented fluorescence, amplified reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, and improved tumor-targeting specificity. Among them, the lead compound TT1-4PYR, bearing pyrrolidone moieties, demonstrated ascites-derived protein corona and macropinocytosis-mediated cellular internalization, enabling deep penetration and selective accumulation in peritoneal metastasis lesions. Comprehensive evaluation in vitro, in vivo, and in human-derived gastric cancer organoid models confirmed its potent and targeted photodynamic cytotoxicity, effectively suppressing tumor progression without inducing systemic toxicity, achieving a favorable biosafety profile. These results highlight TT1-4PYR as a promising and deep-penetrating therapeutic agent for peritoneal metastasis, with potential applicability to other metastatic malignancies.

summary.one_liner: 设计Janus树突修饰酞菁光敏剂，自组装纳米粒靶向深部胃癌腹膜转移灶，实现高效光动力治疗。
summary.innovation: 利用Janus树突修饰酞菁实现自发组装，增强荧光与活性氧产生；通过吡咯烷酮基团介导腹水蛋白冠及巨胞饮内吞，促进深部穿透与选择性富集；结合类器官模型全面验证靶向光动力杀伤效力。
summary.significance: 该策略解决了传统化疗对胃癌腹膜转移响应差的问题，提供深层肿瘤靶向的光动力治疗方案；TT1-4PYR具备良好生物安全性，有望拓展至其他转移性恶性肿瘤的治疗应用。

papers.title: A Self‐Adjuvant Photothermal Carbon Dot‐Based Nanovaccine for Multimodal Nasopharyngeal Cancer Treatment and Prophylaxis
papers.abstract: Developing a "full-cycle" strategy that integrates both treatment and prophylaxis remains a central challenge against nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). Here, a biomimetic nanovaccine (CDC/Toy@CCM) is designed by coating toyocamycin (Toy)-loaded redox-responsive carbon dot clusters (CDCs) with homologous cancer cell membranes (CCMs). The obtained nanovaccine exhibits an average size of 70.7 nm, a high drug loading capacity (12.3%), and a superior photothermal conversion efficiency of 48.7%. The nanovaccine leverages the homologous targeting capacity of CCMs for precise tumor homing, while the disulfide-cross-linked CDCs enable glutathione-triggered drug release specifically within the tumor microenvironment for controlled chemotherapy. Under near-infrared laser irradiation, the CDCs generate robust photothermal ablation of primary tumors, and the combination of chemotherapy and photothermal therapy (PTT) effectively induces immunogenic cell death (ICD), which synergizes the self-adjuvant of CDCs and CCM antigens to generate significant antitumor response to suppress both primary and distant tumors in a bilateral NPC mouse model. In a prophylactic setting, the nanovaccine pre-vaccination generates effective immune protection against subsequent tumor challenge. This work provides a promising "full-cycle" nanoplatform that synergistically integrates PTT, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy for both NPC treatment and prophylaxis.

summary.one_liner: 开发仿生碳点纳米疫苗CDC/Toy@CCM，结合光热、化疗与免疫治疗，实现鼻咽癌治疗与预防的全周期策略。
summary.innovation: 利用同源癌细胞膜包覆和氧化还原响应碳点簇，实现肿瘤靶向及GSH触发释药；碳点簇兼具光热转换与自佐剂功能，协同化疗诱导免疫原性细胞死亡；构建同时用于治疗和预防的双侧肿瘤模型验证“全周期”抗肿瘤效果。
summary.significance: 该纳米疫苗通过协同光热、化疗和免疫治疗，有效抑制原发及远处肿瘤，并在预防性接种中产生免疫保护。为鼻咽癌的整合治疗与预防提供了一种有前景的仿生纳米平台，推动多功能纳米疫苗的临床转化潜力。

papers.title: Bio‐Inspired Albumin Platform for Synergistic Co‐Delivery of Tanespimycin, Dasatinib, and Quercetin and Enhanced Therapeutic Efficacy in Triple‐Negative Breast Cancer
papers.abstract: Despite increasing awareness of molecular subtypes of breast cancer, this heterogeneous malignant disease is still one of the leading causes of cancer death in women worldwide. Although receptor status may define the precise therapeutic targets, treatment of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) relies mainly on chemotherapy with accompanying side-effects. Thus, there is a need for the design and testing of more effective drug delivery systems and drug combinations. In this study, biomimetic self-assembled bovine serum albumin (BSA) capsules (Cs) co-loaded with a new drug combination, namely two drugs tanespimycin (T) and dasatinib (D), and natural compound quercetin (Q), were fabricated, and their anti-breast cancer effects were assessed. (T-D-Q)-BSA Cs were more active against TNBC cells compared to other types of breast cancer. Encapsulated drugs potentiated apoptotic cell death in TNBC cells compared to the effect of the free three-drug formulation. In TNBC cells with mutated TP53, (T-D-Q)-BSA Cs also induced necroptotic cell death accompanied by RAP1-mediated stimulation of NFκB activity and IL-6-related proinflammatory response. (T-D-Q)-BSA Cs also inhibited TNBC-based tumor growth in two zebrafish xenograft in vivo models. In conclusion, the efficacy of (T-D-Q)-BSA Cs as a novel therapeutic strategy to eradicate TNBC in vitro and in vivo was demonstrated.

summary.one_liner: 构建仿生白蛋白囊泡共递送坦螺旋霉素、达沙替尼和槲皮素，协同增效三阴性乳腺癌治疗。
summary.innovation: 首次实现三药共载的仿生BSA自组装囊泡平台；针对TP53突变TNBC诱导坏死性凋亡并激活RAP1/NFκB/IL-6通路；在两种斑马鱼异种移植瘤模型中验证体内抑瘤效果。
summary.significance: 该平台为TNBC提供多药协同递送新策略，可增强凋亡并克服突变型TP53耐药性。有望降低化疗副作用，推动精准联合治疗转化应用。

papers.title: CD80-targeted songorine nanotherapy restores PINK1-dependent mitophagy in proinflammatory macrophages for osteoarthritis treatment
papers.abstract: Synovial macrophage-mediated inflammation and mitochondrial dysfunction are increasingly implicated in osteoarthritis (OA) progression, yet targeted restoration of mitochondrial quality control remains challenging. Here, we developed a macrophage-targeted, targeted delivery nanoplatform (CBP-NPs@Song) by conjugating a CD80-binding peptide to songorine-loaded lipid nanoparticles for preferential and CD80-dependent delivery to proinflammatory (M1) macrophages. CBP-NPs@Song significantly enhanced intracellular drug accumulation and improved multiple indices of mitochondrial function and integrity in inflammatory macrophages. Mechanistically, songorine stabilized PINK1 by reducing its ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation, thereby activating the PINK1–Parkin mitophagy pathway, supporting enhanced clearance of damaged mitochondria through PINK1-associated mitochondrial quality-control processes, and suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation. Targeted mitochondrial regulation in macrophages attenuated the adverse effects of proinflammatory macrophages on co-cultured chondrocytes and protected chondrocytes from oxidative and inflammatory injury. In vivo, CBP-NPs@Song exhibited prolonged intra-articular retention with minimal systemic exposure, significantly attenuating synovial inflammation, osteophyte formation, and cartilage degeneration in OA rats. This study presents a targeted nanotherapeutic strategy that integrates selective immunomodulation with mitochondrial quality control, offering a potential strategy for structure-preserving and immunomodulatory OA therapy. Proposed mechanism of CD80-targeted Songorine nanotherapy for osteoarthritis. CBP-NPs@Song preferentially target CD80-expressing proinflammatory macrophages and enhance intracellular Songorine delivery. Songorine treatment is associated with reduced PINK1 ubiquitination and prolonged PINK1 stability, supporting PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitochondrial quality control. This reduces mitochondrial ROS and NLRP3/Caspase-1/IL-1β signaling, thereby attenuating macrophage-to-chondrocyte inflammatory crosstalk and alleviating osteoarthritis-associated joint damage.

summary.one_liner: 开发CD80靶向载songorine纳米粒，恢复M1巨噬细胞PINK1依赖性线粒体自噬，缓解骨关节炎炎症与软骨退化。
summary.innovation: 构建CD80结合肽修饰的靶向脂质纳米粒，实现向促炎M1巨噬细胞的CD80依赖性递送；揭示songorine通过减少PINK1泛素化降解激活PINK1-Parkin线粒体自噬通路，抑制NLRP3炎症小体；实现关节腔长滞留与低全身暴露，协同改善滑膜炎症和软骨损伤。
summary.significance: 该策略将选择性免疫调节与线粒体质量控制相结合，为骨关节炎提供结构保护性免疫调控疗法；通过靶向巨噬细胞-软骨细胞炎症串扰，具有改善OA病理进程和促进关节结构保留的转化潜力。

papers.title: Chiral by Nature: Chiroptical Activity in Fe3O4 Magnetic Nanoparticles from Bacterial Biomineralization
papers.abstract: Abstract The coexistence of chirality and magnetism in nanomaterials has been observed with metallic complexes but remains rarely achieved in magnetic oxides. Here, we identify biologically induced chiroptical activity in the magnetotactic bacterium Magnetospirillum gryphiswaldense strain MSR-1, which biomineralizes Fe3O4 crystals within a prokaryotic organelle known as a magnetosome. Natural and magnetic circular dichroism spectra were recorded for wild-type MSR-1, a magnetosome-deficient mutant (ΔmamAB), and the magnetosomes extracted from the bacterial cells. While chiroptical signals appeared when the particles remained within the bacterial matrix, the isolated nanoparticles did not demonstrate detectable natural optical activity. Subsequent surface modification of the extracted optically inactive nanoparticles with enantiopure aspartic acid produced chiroptical responses. These observations suggest that the biological environment of magnetosomes imposes chiral asymmetry on magnetic nanoparticles and that surface functionalization revealed optical activity. The results collectively describe a biologically mediated induction of chiroptical signals in Fe3O4 nanoparticles.

summary.one_liner: 研究首次发现趋磁细菌生物矿化Fe3O4磁小体具有天然手性光学活性，表面修饰可诱导手性响应。
summary.innovation: 首次在磁性氧化物纳米颗粒中观察到生物诱导的手性光学活性；通过对比野生型、缺陷突变体及提取磁小体，揭示生物环境对手性不对称的关键作用；表面修饰天冬氨酸可使光惰性纳米颗粒产生手性响应。
summary.significance: 该研究填补了磁性氧化物手性与磁性共存研究的空白，为手性磁性纳米材料的生物合成提供新思路。未来可用于手性催化、光学器件及生物医学成像等领域。

papers.title: Blood–Brain Barrier Regulation: Evolving From Classic Strategies to Electrochemical Ion and Reactive Oxygen Species Control
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The blood–brain barrier (BBB), while indispensable for maintaining central nervous system (CNS) homeostasis, constitutes the principal impediment to effective therapeutic delivery for neurodegenerative disorders, particularly hindering spatially resolved modulation of extracellular ions and reactive oxygen species (ROS) within the neural microenvironment. Contemporary electrochemical methodologies have emerged as a paradigm shift for dynamically reconciling these dual parameters, thereby enabling targeted neuroregulation. Critical review of this field reveals a distinct evolution from passive physiological interventions to active electrochemical engineering approaches. Current research, however, encounters persistent translational barriers including insufficient spatiotemporal resolution in neural interfaces, incomplete mechanistic understanding of ROS‐ionic crosstalk, and scalability limitations of nanoscale delivery systems. To transcend these limitations, the synergistic convergence of electrochemical platforms with machine learning (ML)–guided predictive analytics, near‐infrared (NIR) phototherapy, and biocompatible nanocarrier‐mediated delivery systems constitutes a strategic imperative in next‐generation neurotherapeutic development. Such interdisciplinary convergence is not merely incremental but rather a fundamental prerequisite for realizing clinically translatable neural microenvironment modulation.

summary.one_liner: 综述血脑屏障调控从经典策略向电化学离子与活性氧控制的演进，提出多技术融合方向。
summary.innovation: 系统梳理从被动生理干预到主动电化学工程调控的范式转变；指出当前时空分辨率、机制理解及递送可扩展性三大瓶颈；提出电化学平台与机器学习、近红外光疗及纳米载体协同的下一代策略。
summary.significance: 为神经退行性疾病的靶向治疗提供新思路，推动神经微环境动态调控走向临床转化。其跨学科融合将提升血脑屏障调控精度，助力个性化神经治疗技术发展。

papers.title: D4F‐Functionalized Ceria Nanozyme‐CasRx Platform Suppresses STING and Reprograms the Renal Immune Niche in Acute Kidney Injury
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Acute kidney injury (AKI) is sustained by reciprocal amplification of oxidative stress, innate immune signaling, and maladaptive immune–parenchymal crosstalk. Here, we developed a lipid nanoparticle containing a ceria nanozyme and a STING‐targeting CasRx plasmid and functionalized it with D4F, an 18‐residue apolipoprotein A‐I mimetic peptide composed of D‐amino acids. The resulting D4F‐CeO 2 @LNP‐CasRx(STING) formulation retained radical‐scavenging activity, supported CasRx encapsulation, and showed enhanced cellular and renal delivery. In macrophages, the formulation reduced oxidative stress and total STING abundance together with downstream TBK1 and IRF3 phosphorylation, shifted the CD86/CD206 profile toward a less inflammatory state, and altered the secretome in a manner that protected hypoxia‐challenged tubular epithelial cells. In kidney organoids and peripheral‐blood‐mononuclear‐cell‐coupled organoid cultures, D4F functionalization improved intratissue accumulation, increased the frequency of CD4 + FOXP3 + T cells, and attenuated the hypoxia‐associated DNA damage response and tubular injury. In mice with renal ischemia–reperfusion injury, treatment reduced STING signaling in CD11b + renal macrophages, improved renal function and histology, and lowered whole‐kidney inflammatory and injury readouts. Spatial transcriptomic and proteomic analyses were consistent with contraction of inflammatory immune states and restoration of repair‐associated programs. These findings support a DNA‐delivering nanozyme strategy for renal immune‐niche modulation in AKI.

summary.one_liner: 开发D4F修饰的二氧化铈纳米酶-CasRx递送平台，通过抑制STING信号重编程肾免疫微环境，治疗急性肾损伤。
summary.innovation: 首次将D4F肽功能化修饰的二氧化铈纳米酶与STING靶向CasRx基因编辑系统结合，实现肾巨噬细胞靶向递送；通过清除自由基与基因编辑双重机制协同抑制STING通路并重塑免疫微环境；在肾类器官、外周血单核细胞耦合类器官及缺血再灌注小鼠模型中系统验证疗效与机制。
summary.significance: 为急性肾损伤提供了一种兼具抗氧化与基因调控功能的纳米平台新策略。该平台通过调节先天免疫和促进修复性免疫程序，有望推动纳米酶与基因编辑联合疗法向临床转化，并拓展至其他炎症性肾病。

papers.title: Innate Immunocompetent hiPSC‐Derived Neurospheroids Capture Early CNS Responses to rAAV
papers.abstract: Gene therapies using adeno-associated viruses (AAVs) for central nervous system (CNS) disorders face challenges because host immune responses are not represented in classical preclinical models. Here, we present a human-induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived innate immunocompetent 3D CNS model that recapitulates neuroinflammatory hallmarks, serving as a platform for preclinical gene therapy development. By utilizing various scales of stirred-tank bioreactor systems, we generated neurospheroids (iNSpheroids) composed of neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes, alongside microglial cells (iMGLs) to mimic the neuroimmune axis. These systems enabled large-scale production of iNSpheroids and subsequent miniaturization for co-culture experiments and screening of inflammatory stimuli, while maintaining a highly controlled environment. The iMGL-iNSpheroids demonstrated active neuron-microglia crosstalk and exhibited distinct inflammatory responses to a series of neuroinflammatory factors. iMGL-iNSpheroids mounted an early response to rAAV9, which is underscored by the activation of inflammatory pathways (e.g., TNF-via NF-κB activation) in glial cell populations. This model offers a valuable tool to dissect neuroinflammatory mechanisms, accelerating gene therapy development.

summary.one_liner: 构建含小胶质细胞的hiPSC神经球模型，模拟中枢神经系统对rAAV的早期免疫反应，用于基因治疗临床前评估。
summary.innovation: 开发了人诱导多能干细胞来源的先天免疫活性三维神经球模型，包含神经元、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质细胞和小胶质细胞；利用搅拌式生物反应器实现规模化生产，并支持微型化共培养与炎症刺激筛选；该模型能捕获rAAV9早期炎症应答，如TNF-NF-κB通路激活。
summary.significance: 该模型填补了传统临床前模型缺乏宿主免疫反应的空白，为中枢神经系统基因治疗的免疫安全性评估提供可靠平台。通过重现神经炎症特性，有助于解析神经炎症机制，加速基因疗法的临床转化。

papers.title: The TUBA1B–G3BP2 Axis Sustains p65 Transcriptional Activity to Promote Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression
papers.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer mortality, yet mechanisms sustaining malignant progression remain incompletely defined. Integrative analyses across multiple HCC cohorts identified TUBA1B as one of the most consistently upregulated tubulin isotypes whose high expression associates with poor prognosis and metastasis. In hydrodynamic tail-vein injection (HTVi) models, co-expression of Tuba1b with myr-AKT enhanced liver tumor growth, supporting a tumor-promoting role for Tuba1b in vivo. TUBA1B knockdown suppressed HCC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro and reduced tumor growth and metastasis in orthotopic models. HTVi-mediated delivery of sgTuba1b suppressed hepatocarcinogenesis in NRasV12/myr-AKT- and MYC/sg-p53 HCC models and prolonged survival in the former, whereas sgTuba1b delivery to normal livers caused no detectable histological abnormalities. Mechanistically, TUBA1B bound and stabilized G3BP2 by restraining TRIM25-dependent K48-linked ubiquitination, thereby promoting G3BP2-IκBα association and sustaining basal NF-κB/p65 transcriptional activity; enforced G3BP2 expression rescued the proliferative and metastatic defects caused by TUBA1B loss. Clinically, combined upregulation of TUBA1B and G3BP2 with elevated p65 activity delineated a high-risk HCC subgroup with the poorest outcomes. Collectively, these findings define a TUBA1B-G3BP2 stability axis that supports malignant phenotypes and highlight a potential therapeutic vulnerability in HCC.

summary.one_liner: 研究揭示TUBA1B通过稳定G3BP2维持p65转录活性，促进肝细胞癌进展，是潜在治疗靶点。
summary.innovation: 发现TUBA1B-G3BP2轴通过抑制TRIM25介导的泛素化稳定G3BP2，增强NF-κB/p65活性；体内多种肝癌模型验证TUBA1B促癌功能及靶向治疗可行性；联合标志物可识别预后最差的高危HCC亚群。
summary.significance: 该研究为肝癌恶性进展机制提供新见解，表明TUBA1B-G3BP2轴是潜在治疗靶点。联合检测TUBA1B、G3BP2及p65活性可改善患者风险分层，为精准治疗和预后判断提供依据。

papers.title: Tumor Exposomics: A New Paradigm for Individualized Continuous Exposure Monitoring
papers.abstract: Exposomics provides a systems-level framework to characterize the environmental exposures experienced across the life course and their biological consequences, offering critical insights into tumor initiation and precision prevention. Advances in sensing technologies, intelligent materials, and data science now enable continuous acquisition of external exposures alongside endogenous molecular and phenotypic responses. In this emerging paradigm, exposure is conceptualized not as an isolated variable statistically associated with disease, but as a temporally structured driver embedded within multiscale biological processes. By integrating multimodal monitoring with AI-enabled causal modeling, exposomics moves cancer risk assessment beyond population averages toward individualized, dynamically updated exposure-informed risk assessment. This Perspective highlights key technological directions in external-internal monitoring integration, intelligent sensing ecosystems, and causal data fusion, and outlines a translational framework aimed at supporting precision cancer prevention and early risk management.

summary.one_liner: 提出肿瘤暴露组学新范式，通过多模态监测与AI因果建模，实现个体化连续暴露监测与动态癌症风险评估。
summary.innovation: 将暴露视为多尺度生物过程中的时间结构驱动因素，而非孤立统计变量；融合外部-内部监测、智能感知生态与AI因果数据融合，实现个体化动态暴露风险评估。
summary.significance: 该范式推动癌症风险从人群平均评估转向个体化动态更新，为精准癌症预防和早期风险管理提供了转化框架。未来可整合可穿戴传感与多组学数据，提升暴露-健康因果推断能力。

papers.title: A Dual‐Membrane Biomimetic Nanoplatform Enables Triple‐Modal Therapy Against SARS‐CoV‐2 Through Viral Decoy, Inflammation Neutralizing, and Intracellular RNAi
papers.abstract: The persistent evolution of SARS-CoV-2 and the concomitant risk of life-threatening hyperinflammation, such as cytokine storm syndrome, underscore the urgent need for therapeutic strategies that simultaneously target viral replication and dysregulated host immunity. Herein, we describe a dual-membrane biomimetic nanoplatform, designated [A&T]MLN, comprising siRNA-loaded lipid nanoparticles with a hybrid membrane derived from ACE2-overexpressing HEK293T cells and THP-1 macrophages. This design integrates a high-density viral decoy based on ACE2 with the inherent immunomodulatory capacity of macrophage membranes. [A&T]MLN demonstrates broad-spectrum and potent neutralization of diverse SARS-CoV-2 variants by competitively blocking viral entry, while actively scavenging key inflammatory cytokines (including IL-6, IL-1β, and TNF-α) via membrane-displayed receptors. In a murine model of acute lung injury that recapitulates COVID-19 immunopathology, [A&T]MLN treatment significantly attenuated pulmonary inflammation and tissue damage. Additionally, the platform enabled efficient cytosolic delivery of siRNA, establishing a third modality for intracellular suppression of viral gene expression. Collectively, [A&T]MLN represents a complementary triple-modal therapy that simultaneously addresses viral entry, intracellular replication, and hyperinflammation (the core interconnected pathologies of severe COVID-19), offering a versatile and adaptive strategy against evolving SARS-CoV-2 variants and related inflammatory syndromes.

summary.one_liner: 构建双膜仿生纳米平台，通过病毒诱饵、炎症中和及胞内RNAi三重机制协同抗SARS-CoV-2。
summary.innovation: 设计ACE2过表达细胞与巨噬细胞杂合膜包覆siRNA脂质纳米颗粒；整合病毒诱饵、炎症因子清除与siRNA胞内递送三重治疗模态；实现对多种SARS-CoV-2变异株的广谱中和及炎症微环境调控。
summary.significance: 该平台同时靶向病毒入侵、胞内复制和过度炎症三大病理环节，为重症COVID-19提供多模态协同治疗策略。其仿生膜设计可灵活适配不同抗原或载荷，具有应对病毒持续变异及相关炎症性疾病的广阔应用前景。

papers.title: RNAi in the Rhizarian Phytopathogen Plasmodiophora brassicae : The Causal Agent of Clubroot Disease in Cruciferous Crops
papers.abstract: Although RNA interference (RNAi) is widespread and functionally important across eukaryotes, RNAi pathways are diverse or even lost in some lineages. Rhizaria represents a major and distinct eukaryotic supergroup that includes Plasmodiophora brassicae (Pb), the causal agent of cruciferous clubroot disease, yet RNAi in this lineage remains poorly understood. Here, we characterized an unusual RNAi pathway in Pb. Small RNA sequencing across five representative Pb life stages revealed abundant siRNAs and miRNAs characterized by a predominant 21-nt length, phased genomic distribution, 2-nt 3' overhangs, and a strong 5'-cytidine bias. Three Pb miRNAs were further validated by northern blotting and stem-loop RT-qPCR. Genome analysis identified two canonical AGO homologs, PbAGO1 and PbAGO2, but no Dicer homologs, except for an RNase III-containing Drosha-like protein, PbDRL. Functional analyses showed that PbAGO1 and PbAGO2 mediate gene silencing, whereas PbDRL is required for sRNA biogenesis. Further, the cell wall component chitin was identified from Pb zoosporangia during the early infection and RNAi interfering with its biosynthesis in transgenic plants of Arabidopsis and Brassica napus blocked Pb early infection and conferred broad-spectrum resistance. Our study uncovers an unusual RNAi pathway in Rhizaria and provides a promising strategy to control cruciferous clubroot disease.

papers.title: A Dual‐Mode In Situ EV‐miRNA Profiling Platform for Machine‐Learning‐Assisted Gastric Cancer Liquid Biopsy
papers.abstract: EV-miRNAs are promising gastric cancer (GC) biomarkers for early diagnosis, yet their clinical application is limited by major detection challenges arising from the low abundance and high sequence homology of EV-miRNAs. Herein, we developed a dual-mode platform for sensitive EV-miRNA in situ profiling based on liposome-encapsulated localized exponential catalytic hairpin assembly (L-LECHA). L-LECHA enables the localized exponential catalytic hairpin assembly system to be delivered into EVs and activates exponential signal amplification, resulting in sensitive and rapid detection of EV-miRNAs. Based on the L-LECHA, this platform achieved a limit of detection of 52.48 aM, representing a 10.96-fold improvement over typical ECHA. Compared to single-mode detection, the dual-mode platform demonstrated a wider linear detection range and greater accuracy. By combining an EV-miRNA panel with a k-nearest neighbors (KNN) model, this platform achieved an AUC of 0.974 for diagnosis of GC. It can also be used for pathological classification of GC. This work provides a robust tool for GC liquid biopsy and precision management.

summary.one_liner: 开发基于脂质体封装局部指数催化发夹组装的双模式EV-miRNA原位检测平台，结合机器学习实现胃癌液体活检。
summary.innovation: 提出L-LECHA策略实现EV内miRNA原位指数扩增，检测限达52.48 aM，较传统ECHA提升10.96倍；构建双模式检测系统，兼具更宽线性范围和更高准确性；整合EV-miRNA面板与KNN模型，实现胃癌诊断及病理分类。
summary.significance: 该平台解决了EV-miRNA低丰度与高同源性带来的检测难题，为胃癌液体活检提供了高灵敏、高准确的工具。其结合机器学习可辅助早期诊断和病理分型，有望推动胃癌精准管理的临床转化。

papers.title: Quantitative Visualization of Intracellular Nanometabolism Using Peak‐Shifted Dual‐State Emissive FRET Nanoprobes
papers.abstract: Many nanoscale materials, ranging from environmental particulates to carrier-free nanomedicine platforms, enter the human body, yet their metabolic fates remain poorly understood. This process involves complex physical changes and molecular transformations within lysosomes; however, the particle-to-molecule transition-defined here as "nanometabolism"-has remained difficult to quantify due to intrinsic limitations of nanoscale bioimaging. To circumvent the fluorescence quenching of conventional fluorophores and the challenges of observing nanoscale dynamics, peak-shifted, dual-state emissive nanoprobes composed entirely of donor-acceptor bithiophene dyes are introduced here. This approach establishes a highly adaptable design strategy for constructing heterogeneous organic nanoparticles templated by these molecular metrics. These molecular probes generate bright, ratiometric spectral shifts that directly encode nanoparticle disassembly, enabling robust optical monitoring of intracellular nanometabolism with cell-type- and particle-size-resolution.
