In a destabilization of the medial meniscus (DMM) mouse model, intra-articular administration of sa/A@E LNPs attenuated cartilage erosion and improved joint function. Together, these findings establish a multifunctional therapeutic strategy that integrates lubrication restoration, broad serine-protease shielding and antioxidant activation, supporting the further development of sa/A@E LNPs as a promising disease-modifying platform for OA treatment.

summary.one_liner: 开发蛋白酶屏蔽的PRG4自扩增RNA脂质纳米颗粒，恢复骨关节炎软骨稳态与润滑功能。
summary.innovation: 首次将PRG4 saRNA与丝氨酸蛋白酶抑制剂AEBSF共载于含新型可电离脂质EC12的LNP，实现蛋白酶屏蔽；EC12兼具递送与NRF2通路激活功能，通过结合KEAP1增强抗氧化反应；实现深层软骨穿透并在DMM模型中减轻软骨侵蚀。
summary.significance: 该平台整合润滑恢复、蛋白酶屏蔽与抗氧化激活三重机制，为骨关节炎提供疾病修饰性治疗策略。未来有望开发为关节腔注射的长期缓解OA进展的纳米药物，改善患者关节功能与生活质量。

papers.title: Natural phenolic acid-based self-assembly promotes anti-tumor immune amplification by ATP-ADO axis regulation and its spiky structure
papers.abstract: The integration of bioactive micro-nano drug carrier components with rational design of morphological structures is poised to address the therapeutic challenge in anti-tumor immunotherapy focusing on immunogenic cell death (ICD). In this article, based on ATP-adenosine (ADO) axis regulation induced by ellagic acid (EA), the spiky self-assembly (EZ) was tailored with EA and Zn2+, and next engineered to construct ATP and pH dual-responsive EZ@MTPP for anti-tumor immune amplification. Following intratumoral injection, the spiky structure of EZ@MTPP enabled efficient local retention, then the ATP-sensitive spines of EZ slowly discharged EA and Zn2+ while scavenging ATP. EA silenced the ATP-ADO pathway, lowering immunosuppressive ADO and PD-L1 levels, and Zn2+ activated the cyclic guanosine monophosphate-adenosine monophosphate synthase (cGAS) stimulator of interferon genes (STING) signaling pathway cascade and downstream immunity. Concomitantly, acidification of the TME triggered detachment of microwave-induced tumor-derived microparticles loaded with paclitaxel (MTPP) from EZ, which were acquired by neighboring tumor cells to release paclitaxel (PTX) to elicit apoptosis and robust ICD. After coupling the spiky EA-based self-assembly with PTX-loaded MTPP, EZ@MTPP MPs eradicated tumor cells, relieved ADO-mediated immunosuppression and amplified ICD-driven immunity by components and morphological structures co-facilitation, offering an innovative paradigm for metabolism-focused cancer immunotherapy.

summary.one_liner: 基于没食子酸类天然酚酸与Zn2+自组装构建棘状结构，调控ATP-ADO轴并协同化疗药放大抗肿瘤免疫。
summary.innovation: 利用天然酚酸（鞣花酸）与Zn2+自组装形成棘状结构，实现ATP/pH双响应释放并清除ATP；通过EA沉默ATP-ADO通路降低免疫抑制，同时Zn2+激活cGAS-STING通路增强免疫；将棘状自组装体与载紫杉醇的微波肿瘤来源微粒结合，协同诱导ICD和免疫放大。
summary.significance: 该研究为基于代谢调控的肿瘤免疫治疗提供了新策略，通过形态结构与活性组分的协同设计，有效缓解免疫抑制微环境并增强ICD驱动的抗肿瘤免疫，具有广阔的临床转化前景。

papers.title: A ferroptosis nanoplatform for overcoming radioresistance in KRAS-mutant colorectal cancer
papers.abstract: KRAS mutations drive poor outcomes in colorectal cancer (CRC), largely by conferring resistance to radiotherapy. In clinical samples, we trace this resistance to an upregulated SLC7A11/GPX4 axis, a defense that shields cancer cells from ferroptosis. Targeting this pathway to re-enable ferroptosis, therefore, represents a rational strategy to restore radiosensitivity. Sulfasalazine (SAS), an FDA-approved drug, inhibits SLC7A11 and induces ferroptosis, but its clinical application is restricted by systemic toxicity and poor tumor accumulation. To bypass these limitations, we develop multifunctional SAS-loaded hafnium oxide nanoparticles (HfO2@SAS). Ultra-small HfO2@SAS enables efficient local drug retention and subsequent clearance, minimizing long-term retention risks and supporting favorable biocompatibility. HfO2@SAS serves a dual function: HfO2 amplifies radiotherapy via physical radiosensitization through X-ray energy deposition, while SAS disables antioxidant defenses to induce ferroptosis. In KRAS-mutant CRC, this nanoplatform overcomes radioresistance by integrating physical and biochemical mechanisms. Consistent with clinical sample data, we validate the efficacy of HfO2@SAS in cell and animal levels. Patient-derived organoids provide a human-relevant platform that further supports these findings. Collectively, these findings validate the potential of nanomedicine in combating refractory KRAS-mutant CRC and provide a proof-of-concept for advancing radio-drug combination therapy.

summary.one_liner: 构建负载柳氮磺吡啶的氧化铪纳米平台，通过物理增敏与铁死亡诱导协同逆转KRAS突变结直肠癌放疗抵抗。
summary.innovation: 首次将HfO2纳米颗粒与铁死亡诱导剂SAS结合，实现放疗增敏与抗氧化防御抑制的双重协同；利用超小尺寸实现高效肿瘤富集与体内清除，降低全身毒性并改善生物相容性；结合临床样本、细胞、动物及患者来源类器官系统验证疗效。
summary.significance: 为KRAS突变结直肠癌的难治性放疗抵抗提供了全新干预策略，证实纳米医学联合放化疗的可行性。该平台有望推动放疗-药物联合疗法的临床转化，改善该类患者的预后。

papers.title: Self-sustaining ROS-responsive hydrogel enabled delivery of PROTAC/Ce6 nanoparticles via PDT-Epigenetic protein degradation to amplify pyroptosis for enhanced cancer immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Cancer immunotherapy exhibits limited efficacy in immunologically "cold" tumors due to insufficient T-cell infiltration and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. The efficacy of photodynamic therapy (PDT) is restricted by inadequate tumor-specific aggregation of photosensitizers and therapeutic resistance regulated by epigenetics. Herein, we engineered a light-driven, ROS-responsive hydrogel (PACL@Gel) for loading peptide-lipid scaffold nanoparticles encapsulating proteolysis targeting chimera (PROTAC) molecule and photosensitizer to enhance cancer immunotherapy. The system utilizes both endogenous and photodynamically amplified ROS to drive controlled hydrogel degradation and nanoparticle release, establishing a self-sustaining ROS feedback loop to overcome the limitations of insufficient endogenous ROS. The released PACL nanoparticles synergistically combine PDT with epigenetic BRD4 protein degradation to robustly amplify Caspase-3/GSDME dependent pyroptosis. Pyroptotic tumor cells would trigger immunogenic cell death, releasing inflammatory mediators and damage-associated molecular patterns that promote dendritic cells maturation and T-cell activation and infiltration to effectively remodel the immunosuppressive tumor niche and promote antitumor immunity. Experimental results validated that under laser irradiation, PACL@Gel demonstrated potent local tumor suppression and distant abscopal effect, prevented postoperative recurrence and established long-term immune memory. Collectively, this integrated PROTAC-PDT hydrogel platform effectively reprograms the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, providing a robust and actionable approach to enhance PDT therapy in immunologically cold tumors combined with epigenetic strategies.

summary.one_liner: 构建自维持ROS响应水凝胶共递送PROTAC/Ce6，通过PDT联合表观遗传蛋白降解放大焦亡，增强冷肿瘤免疫治疗。
summary.innovation: 设计光驱动ROS响应水凝胶，形成内源与光动力ROS自维持释放闭环；整合PROTAC介导的BRD4降解与PDT协同放大Caspase-3/GSDME焦亡通路；利用焦亡诱导免疫原性死亡重塑免疫抑制微环境并激发远端效应。
summary.significance: 该平台有效解决光敏剂肿瘤富集不足及表观遗传耐药问题，为免疫冷肿瘤提供PROTAC-PDT联合策略。实验证实其兼具局部抑制、远隔效应与抗复发免疫记忆，具有临床转化潜力。

papers.title: Intestinal Barrier Repair‐Based Copper‐Kaempferol Nanocomplexes Regulates Gut‐Liver Axis Homeostasis
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and its frequent hepatic complication, metabolic-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), are intrinsically linked through the dysregulated gut-liver axis, with intestinal barrier dysfunction serving as a central pathological driver. Coordinated therapy that restores barrier integrity and interrupts pathogenic gut-liver crosstalk remains a significant challenge. To address this, a colon-targeted delivery system based on sodium alginate microspheres is developed for loading copper-kaempferol nanocomplexes (CuK@SA). Upon oral administration, this system prolongs the retention and release of CuK NCs in the colon. Through scavenging reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (ROS/RNS), regulating macrophage polarization, improving microbial homeostasis, and enhancing tight junction protein expression, it multi-dimensionally restores intestinal barrier integrity and effectively blocks the translocation of endotoxins to the liver via the gut-liver axis. In mouse models of dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis and high-fat-diet-induced MASH, CuK@SA significantly alleviates intestinal inflammation, repairs barrier structure, and simultaneously improves hepatic steatosis and inflammatory responses. This work provides a novel strategy for synchronously targeting IBD and its systemic complications through modulation of the gut-liver axis.

summary.one_liner: 开发基于铜-山柰酚纳米复合物的结肠靶向海藻酸钠微球，修复肠道屏障并调控肠-肝轴，同步缓解结肠炎与代谢相关脂肪性肝炎。
summary.innovation: 构建铜-山柰酚纳米复合物并负载于海藻酸钠微球实现结肠靶向递送；通过清除ROS/RNS、调节巨噬细胞极化、改善菌群稳态及增强紧密连接蛋白多维度修复肠道屏障；首次提出基于肠屏障修复同步干预IBD及其肝脏并发症MASH的肠-肝轴调控策略。
summary.significance: 该研究为炎症性肠病及其系统性并发症的同步治疗提供了新思路，证明了通过修复肠道屏障可有效阻断内毒素经肠-肝轴向肝脏的转位，同时改善肠道炎症和肝脏脂肪变性。其结肠靶向递送系统具有良好口服可行性和多效协同潜力，有望推动肠-肝轴相关疾病的临床转化。

papers.title: A Triple‐Synergistic Injectable Hydrogel Elicits Systemic Antitumor Immunity via Mild Photothermal Priming, Radical Storm, and Autophagy Blockade
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Photothermal therapy (PTT) as a localized cancer treatment modality has gained considerable momentum recently. While conventional PTT relies on photothermal agents (PTAs) to produce abundant heat (above 50°C) via near‐infrared (NIR) laser irradiation for tumor ablation, this high‐temperature approach often inflicts collateral thermal injury on surrounding healthy tissues, which severely constrains the therapeutic feasibility of PTT near vital organs. Therefore, mild‐temperature PTT (below 45°C) is of clinical interest. Herein, we construct an injectable hydrogel (IVH@gel) via the coordination between calcium ions (Ca 2 + ) and sodium alginate to encapsulate the PTA Hu Kaiwen Ink, the free radical initiator 2,2’‐azobis[2‐(2‐imidazolin‐2‐yl)propane]dihydrochloride (VA‐044), and the autophagy inhibitor hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) for realizing synergistic PTT and immunotherapy. Specifically, when irradiated under an NIR laser, the ink in the hydrogel generates heat, which leads to the degradation of VA‐044 to produce free radicals for killing cancer cells; meanwhile, HCQ is released for realizing autophagy‐inhibited mild‐temperature PTT of tumor. More importantly, the IVH@gel‐mediated PTT elicits strong immunogenic cell death (ICD), which activates a potent antitumor immune response, leading to significant tumor inhibition. This work provides a promising method for the development of multifunctional mild‐temperature PTT drugs.

summary.one_liner: 构建可注射水凝胶通过温和光热、自由基风暴与自噬抑制三重协同，引发系统抗肿瘤免疫。
summary.innovation: 温和光热（<45°C）联合自由基风暴与自噬抑制实现三重协同治疗；水凝胶局部递送墨水光热剂、VA-044自由基引发剂和羟氯喹自噬抑制剂；诱导免疫原性细胞死亡激活强效抗肿瘤免疫应答。
summary.significance: 该水凝胶通过温和光热策略减少对周围健康组织的热损伤，同时增强抗肿瘤免疫疗效，为近主要器官肿瘤的安全治疗提供了新方案。其多机制协同设计有望推动多功能温和光热药物的临床转化。

papers.title: Zwitterionic Polarization‐Engineering Covalent Organic Frameworks for Targeted Ferroptosis‐Synergistic Photothermal Immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Combining efficient photocatalytic activity with precise targeting is crucial for covalent organic framework (COF)-based nanomedicines to remodel the immunosuppressive microenvironment and sensitize "cold" tumors to immunotherapy. Herein, we constructed two isomorphic frameworks featuring distinct electronic topologies: a zwitterionic squaric acid (SA) COF with inherent electrostatic asymmetry, and a charge-neutral terephthaldehyde (TA) COF. The spatial divergence of ion centers in SA COF triggers intense molecular-level ionic displacement polarization, creating a robust internal electric field. Such unique field-effect regulation accelerates photogenerated charge separation for efficient superoxide anion production, enhances intersystem crossing for singlet oxygen generation, and promotes nonradiative energy relaxation for high-performance photothermal conversion under dual-wavelength irradiation. After PEGylation and iRGD modification, the formulated SA@PEG-iRGD exhibits excellent physiological stability and active deep tumor penetration. With near-infrared absorption, it enables high-contrast photoacoustic imaging for guided dual-wavelength (660/808 nm) phototherapy. This spatiotemporally controlled therapeutic cascade triggers lethal ferroptosis and precise photothermal ablation, potently activating immunogenic cell death. Combined with aPD-L1 therapy, it eliminates primary tumors, produces abscopal effects, and establishes immune memory against recurrence and metastasis. This study highlights the value of electronic structure engineering in COF-based precision nanomedicine.

summary.one_liner: 构建两性离子极化COF，利用内建电场增强光热/光动力性能，实现靶向铁死亡协同光热免疫治疗。
summary.innovation: 设计具有静电不对称的两性离子方酸COF，产生强内建电场以促进电荷分离和活性氧生成；经PEG-iRGD修饰实现主动深部肿瘤穿透和双波长光热/光动力协同治疗；联合aPD-L1触发铁死亡与免疫原性死亡，产生远隔效应和免疫记忆。
summary.significance: 该研究通过电子结构工程调控COF的光物理性质，为精准纳米医学提供新策略。其双波长光热免疫疗法有望克服免疫抑制微环境，增强冷肿瘤对免疫治疗的响应，为肿瘤复发和转移防治提供可转化方案。

papers.title: Hexagonal Close-Packed RuCo Alloys Modulate Li2O2 Formation and Decomposition Pathways in Lithium–Oxygen Batteries
papers.abstract: Abstract Aprotic lithium–oxygen (Li–O2) batteries suffer from large voltage hysteresis and inferior reversibility, originating from the sluggish redox kinetics of insulating Li2O2. Here, we incorporate Ru atoms into Co nanoparticles encapsulated within carbon nanotubes and induce a phase transition from a face-centered cubic (fcc) to a hexagonal close-packed (hcp) structure to facilitate cathode reaction kinetics. The hcp-RuCo alloy exhibits significant charge redistribution and a downshifted d-band center, promoting LiO2 desorption into the electrolyte and inducing the formation of solution-mediated, sheet-like Li2O2 nanoarrays with rapid charge/mass transport. Notably, it reduces the delithiation energy barrier to drive a kinetically dominant, stepwise, single-electron oxidation pathway (Li2O2 → LiO2 → O2), bypassing the highly polarizing two-electron route upon charging. Consequently, Li–O2 batteries with the hcp-RuCo catalyst achieve remarkably reduced polarization of 0.72 V and ultralong cycle durability without performance decay. This work demonstrates that crystal-phase engineering is a powerful strategy for tuning oxygen electrocatalysis.

summary.one_liner: 将Ru掺入Co纳米颗粒并诱导fcc到hcp相变，调控Li2O2生成与分解路径，显著降低极化并提升循环寿命。
summary.innovation: 通过Ru掺杂诱导Co从fcc到hcp晶体相变，实现电子结构重塑；调控Li2O2以溶液介导的片状纳米阵列生长模式，促进电荷/质量传输；降低脱锂能垒，驱动单电子分步氧化路径（Li2O2→LiO2→O2），绕过双电子高极化过程。
summary.significance: 该工作展示了晶相工程在调控氧电催化反应路径中的关键作用，为解决Li–O2电池电压迟滞和可逆性差提供了新策略。基于hcp-RuCo催化剂的电池实现0.72 V低极化和超长稳定循环，有望推动高能锂氧电池的实际应用。

papers.title: Bletilla striata Polysaccharide-Derived Nanomicelles for Co-Delivery of Andrographolide and Coixol: A Novel Strategy for Synergistic Targeted Treatment of Gastric Cancer
papers.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Gastric cancer is a highly prevalent malignant tumor of the digestive system worldwide. Although andrographolide (AG) and coixol (CX) possess potential anti-gastric cancer effects, their clinical application is restricted by low bioavailability and poor targeting ability. Based on the meridian tropism theory of traditional Chinese medicine and the concept of “integrated drug and carrier”, this study constructed Bletilla striata polysaccharide-vitamin E succinate (BSP-VES) polymeric micelles co-loaded with AG and CX (AG&CX@BSP-VES) for synergistic targeted therapy of gastric cancer. In this study, AG&CX@BSP-VES was first systematically characterized in vitro to clarify its physicochemical properties, drug release behavior and hemolysis profile. Subsequently, using subcutaneous and orthotopic gastric cancer mouse models as research objects, in vitro cellular uptake and in vivo tumor targeting ability efficacy and biological safety of this drug delivery system were further evaluated. Results showed that the micelles were regularly spherical with a particle size of approximately 105 nm, exhibited favorable biological safety and asynchronous differential release characteristics, and could be specifically internalized by cells in vitro (which could be blocked by free BSP). In vivo, the accumulation of micelles in tumor masses was significantly higher than that in normal gastric tissues. Moreover, the cytotoxicity of the micelles against SGC-7901 tumor cells was remarkably higher than that of free AG or CX alone, which was attributed to enhanced cellular drug uptake and the synergistic effect between AG and CX. This study provides novel insights for the precise delivery of active ingredients from traditional Chinese medicine and individualized therapy of gastric cancer.</jats:p>

summary.one_liner: 构建白芨多糖-维生素E琥珀酸酯共载穿心莲内酯与薏苡素纳米胶束，实现胃癌协同靶向治疗。
summary.innovation: 基于中药归经理论与药载一体化概念，首次构建BSP-VES共载AG与CX的纳米胶束；实现异步差异性释放与游离BSP可阻断的特异性细胞摄取，增强肿瘤靶向蓄积。
summary.significance: 该递药系统显著提高难溶性中药成分的生物利用度与靶向性，协同增强抗胃癌疗效，为中药活性成分精准递送及胃癌个体化治疗提供新思路。

papers.title: On-Demand Charged States in Quantum Dot–ZnO Nanoparticle Assemblies toward Sub-Excitonic Optical Gain
papers.abstract: Abstract Achieving optical gain in colloidal quantum dots (QDs) requires band-edge state filling beyond optical transparency, typically requiring multiexciton populations that are nevertheless rapidly depleted by Auger recombination. Electron charging offers a route to reduce this threshold by prefilling the lowest electron states of QDs; however, conventional photochemical charging approaches are not readily applicable to solid-state gain media because they rely on solution-phase redox chemistry. Here, we demonstrate that ZnO–QD mixed nanoparticle assemblies enable tunable electron charging and reduce the optical gain threshold. We study these assemblies in solutions and in the solid state, demonstrating a three-order-of-magnitude increase in charging efficiency in ZnO–QD films. This discrepancy originates from proximity-dependent electron transfer between ZnO nanoparticles and QDs, which we capture using a unified charging model that combines particle ratio and spatial proximity. The resulting proximity-controlled charging enables subexcitonic optical gain and amplified spontaneous emission in ZnO–QD assemblies, offering a route toward low-threshold QD gain media.

summary.one_liner: 研究ZnO-量子点组装体实现可调电子充填，降低光增益阈值，实现亚激子光学增益。
summary.innovation: 提出ZnO-量子点混合组装体实现固相可控电子充填；建立结合粒子比例与空间邻近性的统一充填模型；实现亚激子光学增益与放大自发辐射。
summary.significance: 该工作克服了传统光化学充填不适用于固态增益介质的局限，为低阈值量子点增益介质提供了新路径。有望推动量子点激光器及光电器件的发展。

papers.title: Electrogenic HfO2/TiO2 Living Biointerface Dismantles Metabolic Radioresistance for Amplified Radio-Immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Abstract Radiotherapy (RT) efficacy in aggressive solid tumors is hindered by lactate-driven metabolic radioresistance and an immunosuppressive microenvironment. Here, we engineer a living biointerface (SHT) via in situ biomineralization of HfO2/TiO2 onto an electrogenic Shewanella oneidensis chassis to address this multifaceted challenge. This structural integration bridges the bacterial metabolism with interfacial radiocatalysis. The TiO2 shell acts as an efficient electron acceptor to accelerate bacterial extracellular electron transfer, driving rapid intratumoral lactate depletion, while the high-Z HfO2 core enhances the X-ray energy deposition. Under irradiation, this synergistic biointerface initiates an oxidative burst and irreversible DNA damage, dismantling the lactate-associated antioxidant defense. In radioresistant triple-negative breast cancer models, this localized physicochemical disruption translates into tumor suppression, accompanied by immunogenic cell death and cGAS-STING pathway activation, reprogramming the immunosuppressive niche. Furthermore, the SHT platform demonstrates systemic biocompatibility, alongside RT-gated self-limiting clearance. Collectively, this work establishes a bioelectrogenic material platform that integrates metabolic barrier dismantling, radiocatalytic sensitization, and immune remodeling for refractory cancer therapy.

summary.one_liner: 构建HfO2/TiO2修饰的电活性活生物界面，通过耗乳酸增敏放疗并激活免疫，克服肿瘤代谢放疗抵抗。
summary.innovation: 将HfO2/TiO2原位矿化于希瓦氏菌表面，形成代谢-放射催化耦合的活生物界面；TiO2壳加速胞外电子传递实现瘤内乳酸快速消耗，HfO2核增强X射线能量沉积；通过氧化爆发与DNA损伤逆转乳酸相关抗氧化防御，并激活cGAS-STING通路重塑免疫微环境。
summary.significance: 该研究为放疗抵抗肿瘤提供兼具代谢调控、放射增敏和免疫重塑的多功能活材料平台。其生物电化学设计思路可推广至其他代谢相关难治肿瘤，并具备系统性安全性与放疗门控自限清除特性，有临床转化前景。

papers.title: Engineering peptide-drug conjugates for targeted cancer therapy: design principle, theranostic imaging, and translational challenges
papers.abstract: Peptide-drug conjugates (PDCs) are emerging as a next-generation class of targeted therapeutics designed to overcome key limitations associated with conventional chemotherapy and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). By integrating a tumor-homing peptide, a cleavable or stimuli-responsive linker, and a potent cytotoxic payload, PDCs offer enhanced tumor selectivity while maintaining structural simplicity and synthetic flexibility. Compared to bulky monoclonal antibody-based systems, PDCs possess significantly smaller molecular size, enabling improved tumor penetration, rapid tissue diffusion, and reduced immunogenicity. Recent advances in peptide engineering have facilitated the development of ligands targeting integrins, G protein-coupled receptors, and other tumor-overexpressed biomarkers, promoting receptor-mediated internalization and intracellular drug release. Linker chemistry plays a pivotal role in therapeutic performance, with enzyme-sensitive, redox-responsive, and pH-cleavable linkers enabling site-specific drug activation within the tumor microenvironment. Despite their promise, PDCs face challenges including rapid renal clearance, proteolytic degradation, and limited circulation half-life. Strategies such as cyclization, PEGylation, and albumin-binding modification have been explored to enhance stability and pharmacokinetics. Furthermore, emerging theranostic PDC platforms incorporate imaging moieties or radiolabels, enabling real-time visualization of tumor targeting, biodistribution, and treatment response. Such dual-functional systems facilitate biomarker-guided patient stratification and image-guided precision therapy. This review comprehensively discusses the structural design principles, delivery barriers, pharmacokinetic considerations, applications, imaging advancements, and current clinical landscape of PDCs, highlighting their advantages over ADCs and outlining future directions for precision oncology. Collectively, PDCs represent a promising and versatile platform poised to redefine targeted cytotoxic delivery in cancer therapy.

summary.one_liner: 本文综述肽-药物偶联物的结构设计、靶向策略及诊疗成像应用，并讨论其临床转化挑战与未来前景。
summary.innovation: 整合肿瘤归巢肽、可裂解连接子与细胞毒载荷，实现高肿瘤选择性和合成灵活性；开发酶敏感、氧化还原响应及pH可裂解连接子，促进微环境特异性药物释放；构建诊疗一体化PDC平台，集成成像基团或放射性标记以支持实时可视化与图像引导治疗。
summary.significance: PDCs兼具ADC的靶向精度与小分子的渗透优势，有望克服传统化疗毒性和ADC的固有局限，推动精准肿瘤学发展。通过环化、PEG化和白蛋白结合等修饰策略改善药代动力学，并借助诊疗功能实现患者分层，为下一代靶向细胞毒治疗提供广阔平台。

papers.title: Hybrid bacteriophage hydrogels deplete intratumoral bacteria to potentiate oncolytic immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Oncolytic viruses act as in situ cancer vaccines by inducing antigen release to boost antitumor immunity. Specific intratumoral bacteria exacerbate immunosuppression; however, their influence on oncolytic immunotherapy remains unknown. Here, we report a hybrid bacteriophage hydrogel composed of engineered oncolytic M13 phage (eM13) and Escherichia coli (E. coli) phage Tequatrovirus YZ2, which suppresses breast cancer progression and metastasis by boosting antitumor immunity through selective elimination of intratumoral E. coli. Particularly, YZ2 is conjugated with photosensitizer CyI to produce YZ2-CyI (YC), and the hydrogel is prepared by cross-linking YC and eM13 using pH-sensitive coordinating molecules through the formation of dynamic Schiff base bonds. Within the acidic tumor microenvironment, eM13 and YC are gradually released for targeted oncolysis and E. coli eradication, respectively. Intratumoral bacterial clearance enhances dendritic cell and CD8+ T cell activation, while suppressing immunosuppressive M2 macrophages, regulatory T cells, and myeloid-derived suppressor cells. In poorly immunogenic triple-negative breast cancer models, depleting intratumoral E. coli potentiates oncolytic therapy against tumor progression, recurrence, and metastasis. Notably, the bacteriophage formulation shows favorable safety without disrupting gut microbiota homeostasis. These results support its potential clinical application in microbiome-infiltrated tumors and ability to improve oncolytic immunotherapy outcomes.

summary.one_liner: 构建杂合噬菌体水凝胶，清除瘤内大肠杆菌以增强溶瘤病毒免疫治疗，抑制乳腺癌进展与转移。
summary.innovation: 首次将溶瘤M13噬菌体与大肠杆菌噬菌体YZ2结合，通过pH敏感水凝胶共递送；利用光敏剂偶联YZ2实现靶向清除瘤内细菌，重塑免疫微环境。
summary.significance: 该策略揭示了瘤内细菌对溶瘤免疫治疗的关键抑制作用，为微生物浸润肿瘤提供新疗法。杂合噬菌体水凝胶安全性高且不扰动肠道菌群，具有临床转化潜力，可改善三阴性乳腺癌等难治性肿瘤的免疫治疗效果。

papers.title: An Oral Biomimetic Hydrogel for Colon-Localized and Tumor-Targeted Sonodynamic Therapy of Colorectal Cancer
papers.abstract: Abstract Oral drug delivery systems show great promise for colorectal cancer (CRC) therapy but are limited by poor gastrointestinal stability, insufficient colon localization, and low tumor targeting. Here, we report an oral biomimetic hydrogel platform, SAM/Au-TiO2@Gel, for colon-localized and tumor-targeted sonodynamic therapy of CRC. Au deposition enhances the sonodynamic reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation capability of TiO2, while Staphylococcus aureus membrane (SAM) coating improves tumor targeting and uptake. Inulin hydrogel enables stable oral delivery and prolonged colonic retention. SAM/Au-TiO2@Gel achieved ∼10-fold higher tumor accumulation after oral administration and superior antitumor efficacy under ultrasound with good biosafety. Moreover, the treatment induced immunogenic cell death, promoted dendritic cell maturation and CD8+ T-cell activation, and was associated with changes in intestinal microbiota composition suggestive of partial restoration. Together, this platform provides a promising noninvasive strategy for overcoming barriers in oral CRC therapy and enabling precise sonodynamic treatment.

summary.one_liner: 开发口服仿生水凝胶SAM/Au-TiO2@Gel，实现结肠定位与肿瘤靶向声动力治疗结直肠癌。
summary.innovation: Au沉积增强TiO2声动力产生活性氧能力；金黄色葡萄球菌膜涂层提高肿瘤靶向与摄取；菊粉水凝胶实现稳定口服递送和结肠滞留。
summary.significance: 该平台解决了口服药物胃肠道稳定性差、结肠定位不足及肿瘤靶向性低等难题，口服后肿瘤蓄积提高约10倍。治疗可诱导免疫原性细胞死亡并调节肠道菌群，为结直肠癌提供无创精准声动力治疗新策略。

papers.title: Spatially Dependent Phase Evolution and Ni-Induced Heterogeneity in O3-Type NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2 during Solid-State Synthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract Solid-state synthesis of layered oxide cathodes involves complex phase evolution and diffusion-governed crystal growth, yet the formation mechanism remains elusive. Here, O3-type NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2 is used to unravel phase evolution and structural reconstruction during solid-state synthesis via high-temperature in situ X-ray diffraction, scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), and energy-dispersive spectroscopy. The results reveal a stepwise phase evolution from the rock-salt intermediate through the P3 phase to the O3 phase. The residual P3 phase, Na2CO3, and NiO in nonsoaked samples indicate that the phase transformation is governed by diffusion kinetics. Focused-ion-beam STEM reveals local Ni heterogeneity and retained Ni-rich rock salt. Crystal growth proceeds through a rock-salt intermediate, followed by Na+-intercalation-induced reconstruction into a layered framework, ultimately yielding anisotropic hexagonal platelets. Electrochemical measurements reveal that grain-boundary rock-salt intermediates and intragranular NiO domains impede Na+ diffusion, increase polarization, and accelerate cycling degradation. This work elucidates the diffusion-limited phase evolution and crystal growth mechanisms governing O3-type layered oxide synthesis.

summary.one_liner: 原位追踪O3型NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2固相合成中的分步相变与晶体生长，揭示Ni异质性及扩散限制机制。
summary.innovation: 采用高温原位XRD与STEM结合，揭示从岩盐中间相经P3到O3的逐步相变路径；发现非浸泡样品中残留P3、Na2CO3和NiO，证明相变受扩散动力学控制；通过FIB-STEM揭示局部Ni异质性和富Ni岩盐残留，阐明晶体生长经由岩盐中间相及Na+嵌入重构过程。
summary.significance: 该研究阐明了扩散限制的相演变和晶体生长机制，为O3型层状氧化物正极的固相合成提供理论指导。所揭示的晶界岩盐中间相和晶粒内NiO域对Na+扩散及循环稳定性的不利影响，有助于优化合成工艺以抑制异质性、提升钠离子电池正极性能。

papers.title: An intelligent phototheranostic nanoplatform for controllable FRET-activated NIR-II imaging-guided phototherapy
papers.abstract: NIR-II imaging-guided phototherapy holds great promise for cancer therapy owing to its noninvasiveness and superior spatiotemporal controllability. However, conventional phototherapeutic agents usually suffer from an "always-on" behavior, which inevitably cause damage to normal tissues during treatment. Meanwhile, most NIR-II imaging agents exhibit low fluorescence quantum yield, leading to insufficient imaging quality and thus compromising diagnostic and therapeutic efficacy. Herein, we designed a fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) -controllable intelligent nanoplatform (CR@CyP) for high-resolution NIR-II imaging and activatable antitumor therapy. The nanoplatform was co-assembled from a cyanine-based ROS-cleavable copolymer photosensitizer (CyP), a NIR-II fluorescent probe (CL), and an immune adjuvant (R837). FRET efficiently quenched photodynamic activity to maintain a "silent" state in blood circulation, enhancing biosafety, while increasing CL fluorescence for high-quality NIR-II imaging. Under 808 nm laser irradiation, in situ generated ROS cleaved thioketal groups in the polymer backbone, disrupting FRET and restoring phototherapeutic activity to achieve synergistic photodynamic and photothermal therapy. Furthermore, the damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs) induced by apoptotic tumor cells, and the R837 could trigger immunogenic cell death (ICD), thereby activating systemic antitumor immune responses. This strategy of controllable FRET-activatable NIR-II imaging-guided phototherapy would provide a promising approach for improving antitumor efficacy.

summary.one_liner: 设计CR@CyP纳米平台，通过可控FRET激活NIR-II成像与光疗，实现高分辨成像和协同抗肿瘤免疫治疗。
summary.innovation: 构建ROS可裂解的FRET可控纳米平台，实现血液循环中静默、肿瘤部位激活的光疗；利用FRET增强NIR-II荧光量子产率，提高成像质量；联合光动力/光热治疗与免疫佐剂R837，触发免疫原性细胞死亡激活全身抗肿瘤免疫。
summary.significance: 该策略解决了传统光疗剂“常开”导致正常组织损伤及NIR-II成像量子产率低的问题，显著提升诊疗精准度与生物安全性。可控激活的NIR-II成像引导光疗联合免疫治疗，为高效低毒的抗肿瘤治疗提供了新思路。

papers.title: Transforming adoptive macrophages into living immune amplifiers with intracellular nanobatteries to potentiate tumor immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Adoptive macrophage therapy holds great promise for solid tumor immunotherapy, but is often limited by poor phenotypic persistence and an inability to remodel the broader immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). Here, we report a Charged Macrophage (ChAR-M), a nanobattery-powered living immune amplifier, that enables sustained macrophage activation and TME immune remodeling. ChAR-M is generated by installing the intracellular nanobattery composed entirely of a redox-responsive dimer of the Toll-like receptor 7/8 agonist (R848) into macrophages. The nanobattery continuously releases immunostimulatory signals intracellularly, maintaining durable M1-like macrophage polarization and preventing tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) re-education. Beyond cell-autonomous activation, ChAR-M functions as a living immune amplifier that propagates antitumor signals to surrounding TAMs through sustained secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines and bioactive extracellular vesicles. This paracrine amplification rewires macrophage communication networks and drives cascading remodeling of immunosuppressive TME. Consequently, ChAR-M converts immunosuppressive tumors into immune-activating niches characterized by enhanced T-cell infiltration, reduced regulatory T-cell accumulation, suppressed angiogenesis, and inhibited metastatic progression. In breast cancer and melanoma mice models, ChAR-M elicited potent antitumor responses and significantly inhibited tumor progression. This work establishes intracellular nanobatteries as a general strategy for programming living immune amplifiers and provides a non-genetic platform for durable remodeling of the tumor immune microenvironment.

summary.one_liner: 开发细胞内纳米电池驱动巨噬细胞成为‘活免疫放大器’，实现持久抗肿瘤免疫重编程。
summary.innovation: 首创完全由R848氧化还原二聚体构成的胞内纳米电池，持续释放免疫激动信号；将过继巨噬细胞改造为可旁分泌激活邻近TAM的活免疫放大器；实现无需基因编辑的持久M1极化与免疫微环境重塑。
summary.significance: 该策略克服了过继巨噬细胞表型维持差及难以重塑免疫抑制微环境的瓶颈，为实体瘤免疫治疗提供了非基因编辑的通用平台。在乳腺癌和黑色素瘤模型中显著抑制肿瘤进展，并增强T细胞浸润、降低Treg积累，具有广阔的临床转化前景。

papers.title: A self-initiating battery-like hydrogel for autonomous pH normalization and immune activation in postoperative tumor therapy
papers.abstract: Postoperative recurrence and metastasis remain major causes of cancer mortality, capitally driven by the inevitably acidic niche during surgical wound repair. However, current pH-regulating strategies show transient efficacy and remain passively responsiveness, failing to accommodate the progressive and fluctuating acidification of the postoperative microenvironment. Here, we report an implantable self-initiating battery-like hydrogel that can autonomously sense pH changes and persistently neutralize acidosis through well-designed internal redox reactions. The hydrogel incorporates Fe3+-quercetin as the initiating redox unit and conductive poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) as the electron mediator, enabling sustained quercetin-quinonoid species cycling with H+ consumption. It provided a broad pH modulation window that covers postoperative pH fluctuation (pH 5.3-6.8) and stabilizes it to neutrality, preventing the formation of pro-recurrence acidic niche. Meanwhile, embedded homoharringtonine-loaded nanoparticles were encapsulated in the hydrogel to promote M2 to M1 macrophages polarization. Fortunately, this system eliminates residual tumor cells and remodels the immunosuppressive microenvironment, resulting in ∼95% suppression of tumor recurrence, while preventing metastasis and establishing durable immune memory. With biocompatible components and flexible architecture suitable for irregular tumor beds, this battery-like hydrogel serves as a promising immunotherapeutic platform for postoperative tumor management.

summary.one_liner: 开发自启动电池样水凝胶，自主感知并中和术后酸性微环境，协同免疫激活抑制肿瘤复发转移。
summary.innovation: 利用Fe3+-槲皮素氧化还原单元与导电PEDOT构建自启动电池样系统，实现持续H+消耗和pH自主稳定；负载高三尖杉酯碱纳米粒促进M2向M1巨噬细胞极化，双重调控肿瘤微环境。
summary.significance: 该水凝胶可适应术后波动性酸化并预防促复发酸性生态位形成，同时消除残余肿瘤并重塑免疫抑制环境，显著抑制复发和转移。其生物相容性和可塑结构适用于不规则瘤床，为术后肿瘤免疫治疗提供可植入平台。

papers.title: Multifunctional nanoparticles for co-delivery of elacridar and paclitaxel for breast cancer local treatment
papers.abstract: Breast cancer treatment is often limited by toxicity of systemic chemotherapy and by the development of drug resistance, which reduces the effectiveness of anticancer drugs. Delivering therapeutics directly into the mammary ducts has emerged as a promising strategy to increase drug concentrations at the tumor site while limiting unwanted systemic effects. In this study, we assessed two nanoparticle-based systems to locally co-deliver the anticancer drug paclitaxel with elacridar, an inhibitor of drug-efflux transporters that contribute to chemotherapy resistance. One formulation consisted of nanostructured lipid carriers (NLCs), whereas the other was a NLC-polymeric hybrid nanoparticle (H-NP), in which the polymeric poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) shell was functionalized with SILY, a collagen I-binding peptide, to enhance mammary tissue retention. All formulations exhibited diameter below 400  nm, and negative zeta potential (-16.0 to -8.8 mV). Elacridar was incorporated into the lipid matrix of the NLC (>80% encapsulation efficiency) and in the polymeric shell of the H-NPs (∼70%), which justifies its faster release from H-NPs after 120 h (∼92% compared to 75% from NLC). Compared to nanoparticles containing only paclitaxel, co-encapsulation improved cytotoxicity and reduced IC50 (up to 4.2-fold) in monolayers of paclitaxel-resistant MDA-MB-231 breast cancer and Kasumi-1 (characterized by overexpression P-glycoprotein) cells, as well as in MCF-7 3D spheroids. In an in vivo model of breast cancer, intraductal H-NPs reduced tumor incidence and volume compared to a drug solution, and increased the mammary tissue-to-plasma ratio of paclitaxel by 105-fold, supporting an improved tissue retention. These findings support H-NPs as promising platforms for localized breast cancer therapy.

summary.one_liner: 开发共载埃拉卡曲和紫杉醇的纳米粒，经乳腺导管局部给药治疗乳腺癌，提高疗效并减少全身毒性。
summary.innovation: 设计NLC与NLC-聚合物杂化纳米粒两种系统，杂化纳米粒表面修饰SILY肽以增强乳腺组织滞留；实现埃拉卡曲与紫杉醇共递送，在耐药细胞和3D球状模型中显著提高细胞毒性；经导管注射杂化纳米粒使紫杉醇乳腺组织/血浆比提高105倍。
summary.significance: 该研究提供了一种针对耐药乳腺癌的局部联合治疗策略，可增加肿瘤部位药物浓度并降低全身副作用。杂化纳米粒兼具长效滞留与逆转耐药特性，为临床乳腺导管内给药治疗乳腺癌提供了有前景的可转化平台。

papers.title: Rapid Fc-mediated surface modification of liposomes with antibodies for selective targeting of pancreatic tumors
papers.abstract: This study introduces a versatile platform for targeted drug delivery that addresses the complexities of conventional immunoliposome preparation. Traditional methods for conjugating a monoclonal antibody (mAb) to the surface of liposomes require target-specific chemical modification for each antibody, frequently resulting in suboptimal ligand orientation, steric hindrance of the antigen-binding sites, and a profound lack of modularity across different targeting systems. We developed Universal Particles (UPs), which are liposomal nanocarriers displaying high-affinity secondary antibodies on their surface. This design enables rapid, non-covalent functionalization by instantly binding to the constant (Fc) region of any whole-molecule primary targeting antibody without the need for chemical modification, thereby promoting a highly accessible, outward-facing display of the antigen-binding domains. In vitro experiments confirmed that UPs successfully functionalized with primary antibodies, leading to specific molecular recognition and enhancing cellular uptake of anti-Muc1/Muc4 UPs by Panc02 pancreatic cancer cells. Analytical flow cytometry confirmed the high expression of these target antigens in the Panc02 line, with 99.5% of cells expressing Muc1 and 99.9% expressing Muc4. In vivo biodistribution studies validated the platform's versatility: αCD31 UPs showed increased accumulation in the lungs, while dual anti-Muc1/Muc4 UPs demonstrated significantly enhanced tumor accumulation in a murine pancreatic tumor model compared with untargeted controls. The UP platform offers a simple approach for antibody-based liposomal targeting, providing a foundation for targeted delivery systems aimed at enhancing therapeutic selectivity and reducing off-target effects in preclinical models.

summary.one_liner: 开发通用颗粒脂质体平台，通过Fc段非共价快速结合任意抗体，实现胰腺肿瘤靶向递送。
summary.innovation: 利用高亲和二抗展示于脂质体表面，无需化学修饰即可快速结合全分子抗体Fc区；抗原结合域外向展示，避免位阻和取向问题；模块化设计可灵活更换不同靶向抗体，实现通用性靶向。
summary.significance: 简化了免疫脂质体制备流程，提高可模块化与可扩展性，为胰腺癌等实体瘤的精准治疗提供通用平台，有望增强治疗选择性并减少脱靶效应。

papers.title: Acidic pH-responsive and dissociative dimeric CpG oligodeoxynucleotides for enhanced cancer immunotherapy
papers.abstract: In cancer immunotherapy, the immune system is stimulated to specifically recognize and eliminate malignant cells while minimizing harm to normal cells. One widely investigated potential immunotherapeutic agent is CpG oligonucleotides (CpG ODNs), short single-stranded DNA molecules with the ability to stimulate both innate and adaptive immune responses by binding to Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9) within endosomal membranes. However, their short half-life in systemic circulation presents a significant challenge to achieving therapeutic efficacy. Herein, we designed and developed an acidic pH-responsive, dissociative dimeric CpG ODN nanostructure, termed CpG i-dimers, to improve serum stability and enhance immune responses for effective cancer immunotherapy. The CpG i-dimers comprise a central DNA duplex containing i-motif DNA-forming sequences, with CpG ODNs attached as overhangs at each 5' end of the duplex. Upon internalization into acidic endosomes, the low pH induces a structural transition of the i-motif sequences within the CpG i-dimer, leading to its dissociation into two active CpG ODN molecules. Notably, this pH-responsive dissociation significantly increases the local concentration of CpG ODNs available for TLR9 binding, thereby amplifying downstream signaling. Compared to CpG dimers lacking i-motif DNA-forming sequences, CpG i-dimers markedly suppressed tumor cell proliferation and growth in tumor-bearing mice by eliciting robust immune responses, including enhanced pro-inflammatory cytokine secretion, M1 macrophage polarization, antibody production, and T cell differentiation. The developed CpG i-dimers represent a simple yet highly efficient platform that bridges smart DNA nanotechnology with practical cancer immunotherapy.

summary.one_liner: 构建酸性pH响应解离的二聚体CpG寡核苷酸，用于增强癌症免疫治疗
summary.innovation: 采用二聚体化CpG寡核苷酸设计，提升核酸稳定性与免疫激活效价；引入酸响应解离机制，使其在肿瘤微酸环境中特异性解离为单体CpG；实现肿瘤微环境响应型递送与免疫激活的协同增效
summary.significance: 该策略可提高CpG寡核苷酸在肿瘤部位的富集与免疫激活效率，同时降低系统性炎症等毒副作用。为免疫佐剂的微环境响应型递送提供了新思路，在肿瘤免疫治疗中具有良好的临床转化前景。

papers.title: Hydrogen-bond interfacial engineering of silk fibroin-strengthened magnetic colloidal hydrogel for embolization and magnetothermal therapy of hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Injectable hydrogels adapt to vascular shapes and block blood flow effectively, enabling wide application in the transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE) of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). However, balancing facile injectability and high mechanical robustness is challenging, as optimizing one compromises the other. Colloidal hydrogels achieve injectability via bottom-up assembly but have limited mechanical properties due to insufficient interface design. Herein, we report a hydrogen-bond interfacial strengthening strategy into the electrostatically crosslinked colloidal network to develop an injectable and mechanically stable magnetic colloidal hydrogel, which is assembled from electronegative hydrogen bond-rich silk fibroin iron oxide nanoparticles (SF@Fe3O4 NPs) and electropositive Gelatin NPs. This SF@Fe3O4 magnetic colloidal hydrogel (SF-MCH) can be injected through a medical microcatheter with an injection force of ∼10 N, which is only 15% of the manual limit. The storage modulus of SF-MCH (∼900 Pa) was three times higher than those of the PAA@Fe3O4 and Na3Cit@Fe3O4 magnetic colloidal hydrogels, meeting the mechanical performance requirements for embolization (>800 Pa), owing to the colloid interfacial hydrogen-bond interactions demonstrated by variable-temperature fourier transform infrared spectroscopy. Compared to gelatin bulk hydrogel containing SF@Fe3O4 NPs (SF-MBH), SF-MCH showed superior self-healing efficiency (94%) and shape fidelity. Additionally, SF-MCH could withstand pressures up to 36 kPa, well above physiological vascular pressure of 16 kPa. Furthermore, SF-MCH mediated embolization combined with magnetic hyperthermia significantly inhibited rabbit ear tumors, while SF-MCH achieved sustained renal artery embolization in rabbits. This hydrogen-bond interfacial reinforcing strategy brings a feasible route for the design of colloidal hydrogels with robust mechanics and tailor-made functionality.

summary.one_liner: 通过氢键界面工程构建丝素蛋白增强磁性胶体水凝胶，用于肝细胞癌的栓塞与磁热联合治疗
summary.innovation: 利用氢键界面工程实现丝素蛋白与磁性纳米粒子的协同组装，显著增强水凝胶的力学强度与胶体稳定性；将经导管栓塞与磁感应热疗集成于同一可注射磁性水凝胶体系，实现物理阻断与热消融的协同增效；面向肝细胞癌介入治疗，构建可磁操控、可原位成胶的复合功能平台
summary.significance: 该策略有望解决传统栓塞材料力学性能不足、功能单一的问题，为肝癌提供栓塞-磁热一体化治疗方案。丝素蛋白的引入可提升材料的生物相容性与降解可控性，磁性组分则赋予其磁靶向与热疗能力。未来或可拓展至其他富血供实体瘤的介入治疗与影像引导下的联合治疗。

papers.title: Natural Product Toosendanin Suppresses the Malignant Development of Skin Melanoma by Targeting BNC2 for Degradation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Toosendanin (TSN) is a highly potent natural anticancer compound derived from the fruit of Fructus Meliae Toosendan. In this study, TSN inhibited melanoma cell proliferation and cell‐cycle progression, induced apoptosis, and suppressed metastasis in both in vitro and in vivo models. TSN is a potent PI3K inhibitor; here, we identify basonuclin 2 (BNC2) as a transcription factor critically involved in TSN's suppression of PIK3CA transcription in melanoma cells. In clinical samples and melanoma datasets, BNC2 expression is substantially elevated in skin cutaneous melanoma and correlates with poor patient metastasis. Functional studies demonstrate that BNC2 promotes melanoma cell proliferation and migration. TSN directly binds to BNC2 and CRBN, the substrate receptor subunit of the E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, acting as a molecular glue to induce ubiquitin‐dependent degradation of BNC2 and subsequent downregulation of PIK3CA transcription. TSN nanoliposome encapsulation improves cellular uptake, tumor targeting, and anti‐metastatic efficacy of TSN in vivo. These findings reveal a context‐dependent oncogenic function of BNC2 in melanoma, contrasting with its previously described tumor‐suppressive roles in other cancers, and establish TSN as a small‐molecule degrader of BNC2 with therapeutic potential for melanoma.

summary.one_liner: 川楝素通过分子胶机制降解BNC2，抑制黑色素瘤PIK3CA转录及恶性进展，纳米脂质体增强疗效。
summary.innovation: 首次揭示BNC2在黑色素瘤中起促癌作用，与其在其他癌症中的抑癌角色相反；发现TSN作为分子胶同时结合BNC2与CRBN，诱导BNC2泛素化降解；构建TSN纳米脂质体，提高靶向性与抗转移效果。
summary.significance: 该研究为黑色素瘤治疗提供了新型小分子降解剂TSN，并阐明BNC2的上下文依赖性功能，拓展了天然产物的抗癌应用。纳米脂质体递送策略有望提升TSN的临床转化潜力，为难治性皮肤黑色素瘤带来新方案。

papers.title: DLST Succinylation‐Mediated Mitochondrial Metabolic Remodeling and Cuproptosis Resistance Promote Malignant Progression of Lung Adenocarcinoma
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Metabolic remodeling is one of the hallmarks of malignant tumors, and post‐translational modifications of proteins, such as succinylation, play an important role in the process of metabolic remodeling by regulating the function of metabolic enzymes. However, the role of succinylation modifications of key mitochondrial metabolic enzymes in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains unclear. Here, using succinylation proteomics, it is demonstrated that the succinylation level of lysine 409 (K409) on dihydrolipoamide S‐succinyltransferase (DLST) is significantly increased in LUAD. Further, DLST K409 succinylation (K409succ), which is catalyzed by carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1A (CPT1A), can affect oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) and redox homeostasis by regulating enzyme activity, thereby promoting the malignant progression of LUAD. Notably, the succinylation of DLST can enhance the cuproptosis resistance by inhibiting its lipoylation. Subsequently, a small‐molecule inhibitor SI409‐1 that can specifically target DLST K409 has been developed. In vitro and in vivo experiments show that SI409‐1 can inhibit the LUAD growth and enhance the sensitivity to cuproptosis inducers. Collectively, these findings provide a novel predictive target and intervention strategy for the clinical diagnosis and treatment of LUAD.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现DLST K409琥珀酰化经CPT1A催化促进肺腺癌代谢重编程及铜死亡抵抗，并开发靶向抑制剂SI409-1。
summary.innovation: 首次揭示肺腺癌中DLST K409位点琥珀酰化修饰由CPT1A催化并调控线粒体代谢；阐明DLST琥珀酰化通过抑制脂酰化增强铜死亡抵抗的新型耐药机制；开发靶向DLST K409的特异性小分子抑制剂SI409-1。
summary.significance: 该研究为肺腺癌提供了新的预后标志物与治疗靶点，填补了线粒体代谢酶琥珀酰化修饰在肿瘤铜死亡抵抗中的机制空白。SI409-1联合铜死亡诱导剂的策略有望为肺腺癌临床治疗提供新方案。

papers.title: YTHDC1 Orchestrates Glucose and Glutamate Rewiring to Overcome Lethal Metabolic Stress in Triple‐Negative Breast Cancer
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Developing effective therapies for triple‐negative breast cancer (TNBC) requires the identification of key molecular regulators. Here, among the major m6A modulators, we find that only the reader YTHDC1 is specifically overexpressed in TNBC and correlates to unfavorable prognosis. Mechanistically, YTHDC1 orchestrates glucose and glutamine metabolism in an m6A‐dependent manner to confer robust adaptability to lethal metabolic stress in TNBC cells. It not only stabilizes GLUT3 mRNA to sustain glucose uptake and NADPH production, but also reduces the mRNA stability of ATF4, thereby suppressing the overexpression of the cystine/glutamate antiporter SLC7A11 to prevent excessive cystine uptake and glutamate export. YTHDC1 knockdown simultaneously disrupts glucose metabolism and upregulates SLC7A11, triggering disulfidptosis in TNBC cells in vitro and in vivo. Leveraging this YTHDC1 knockdown‐induced metabolic vulnerability, we develop an ATF4 mRNA‐targeted nanotherapy, which delivers mRNA directly to the cytoplasm and bypasses m6A‐mediated destabilization by YTHDC1 in the nucleus. By promoting SLC7A11 expression, therapeutic overexpression of ATF4 sensitizes TNBC cells to disulfidptosis upon GLUT inhibitor BAY‐876 treatment, and to glutamate deprivation‐induced cell death upon GLS inhibitor CB‐839 treatment. Collectively, this work reveals YTHDC1 as a pivotal coordinator of the glucose‐glutamine‐cystine metabolic network and provides ATF4 mRNA nanomedicine‐based combination strategies to improve TNBC therapeutic efficacy.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现YTHDC1在三阴性乳腺癌中调控葡萄糖和谷氨酰胺代谢以克服代谢应激，并开发ATF4 mRNA靶向纳米疗法增敏双硫死亡。
summary.innovation: 揭示YTHDC1作为m6A阅读蛋白特异性在三阴性乳腺癌中高表达并调控葡萄糖-谷氨酰胺-胱氨酸代谢网络；开发ATF4 mRNA靶向纳米疗法，绕过核内YTHDC1介导的mRNA降解以诱导双硫死亡。
summary.significance: 该研究为三阴性乳腺癌治疗提供了新的代谢靶点和联合治疗策略。ATF4 mRNA纳米药物联合GLUT或GLS抑制剂可增强双硫死亡敏感性，具有临床转化潜力。

papers.title: Hyper‐Intense Tumor Peripheral Accumulation of Antibody‐Conjugated Iron Oxide Nanoparticles can Enable Breast Cancer Detection by Magnetic Particle Imaging
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Targeting nanoparticles to cancer cells in vivo remains a challenge for cancer imaging. We assessed nanoparticle distribution after injecting iron oxide nanoparticles conjugated with either a monoclonal anti‐HER2 (human epidermal growth factor 2), or a non‐specific IgG antibody into a human HER2 overexpressing murine breast cancer model. We used Magnetic Particle Imaging (MPI) and histopathology to assess particle localization at 72 h after injection. MPI detects magnetic moments produced by magnetic particles, and histology enables spatial quantification of nanoparticles. Intratumor iron content measured by MPI correlated with inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry ( ρ = 0.868, p < 0.0001). We detected nanoparticle accumulation in tumors, and organs and tissues associated with inflammation. MPI showed higher uptake of nanoparticles in tumors, regardless of their performance in vitro. Spatial analysis showed that 43 ± 7% of nanoparticles that reached the tumor accumulated in the peripheral quartile of the tumor, with decreasing amounts toward the center. Immunohistochemical analysis showed the nanoparticles were strongly associated with inflammatory immune and stromal cells in the tumor microenvironment. This hyperintense peripheral accumulation, or ring pattern, observed with MPI enabled us to distinguish tumors from general inflammation. Iron oxide nanoparticle‐mediated MPI has the potential to detect tumors, providing another powerful diagnostic tool.

summary.one_liner: 抗体偶联氧化铁纳米颗粒在肿瘤外周形成强信号环，借助磁粒子成像可区分肿瘤与炎症，用于乳腺癌检测。
summary.innovation: 发现纳米颗粒在肿瘤外周富集形成环状高信号，可区分肿瘤与炎症；结合MPI和组化定量验证颗粒分布与炎症细胞关联。
summary.significance: 解决了纳米颗粒体内靶向肿瘤的成像难题，为乳腺癌提供无创诊断新工具。该环状信号模式有望作为通用肿瘤成像标志，推动MPI临床转化。

papers.title: Deubiquitination of Vangl by USP6 and USP32 Regulates Planar Cell Polarity Signaling
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Planar cell polarity (PCP) signaling is an evolutionarily conserved mechanism regulating polarized cellular and tissue behaviors in diverse morphogenetic and physiological processes. Disruption or aberrant activation of PCP signaling can cause developmental defects or promote cancer malignancy. Vangl1 and Vangl2 are redundant core PCP components, and their protein levels are tightly controlled to maintain appropriate PCP signaling. Here, we identify two deubiquitinases, USP6 and USP32, that stabilize Vangl proteins through distinct ubiquitin linkage‐specific mechanisms. USP6 primarily removes K33‐linked and multi‐monoubiquitin signals from plasma membrane‐associated Vangl2, whereas USP32 removes K48‐linked ubiquitin chains from Golgi/ER‐localized Vangl2, thereby regulating distinct subcellular pools of Vangl2. Given that USP6 was previously reported to be a hominoid‐specific gene originating from USP32 , our findings suggest evolutionary refinement in PCP regulation. Consistent with these biochemical functions, genetic interaction studies demonstrate that Usp32 cooperates with Vangl genes to regulate PCP signaling during mouse embryogenesis. In pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, USP32 and VANGL1 are markedly upregulated and functionally promote cancer cell migration and metastasis. USP32 enhances metastatic behavior by stabilizing VANGL1 proteins. Together, our findings uncover a previously unrecognized regulatory mechanism of PCP signaling through USP6/USP32‐mediated deubiquitination of Vangl proteins and highlight its roles in both developmental morphogenesis and cancer progression.

summary.one_liner: 发现USP6和USP32通过特异性去泛素化稳定Vangl蛋白，调控平面细胞极性信号，影响发育和癌症转移。
summary.innovation: 首次揭示USP6和USP32通过不同泛素链连接特异性分别调控质膜和内质网/高尔基体定位的Vangl2；发现USP6为从USP32进化而来的类人猿特异基因，体现PCP调控的进化精细化；证明在胰腺导管腺癌中USP32通过稳定VANGL1促进迁移和转移。
summary.significance: 该研究阐明了PCP信号中Vangl蛋白稳定性调控的新机制，为理解发育形态发生提供重要基础。同时，USP32和VANGL1在胰腺癌中的高表达及其促转移作用，提示它们可作为潜在的癌症治疗靶点，具有重要的临床转化前景。

papers.title: CAR‐Engineered Cell Therapies Beyond Cancer: Reprogramming Fibrosis and Immune‐Mediated Inflammation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)‐engineered cell therapies are being extended from hematological malignancies to autoimmune, inflammatory, and fibrotic diseases, although the maturity of evidence differs markedly among platforms and indications. Early clinical evidence from case reports, small case series, and early‐phase trials suggests that CD19‐ or BCMA‐directed CAR‐T cells can induce deep B‐cell or plasma‐cell depletion and sustained remission in selected patients with refractory autoimmune diseases; however, their comparative efficacy, durability, and long‐term safety remain incompletely defined. By contrast, CAR‐based treatment of organ fibrosis remains predominantly preclinical. In animal models, transient in vivo CAR‐T generation has attenuated fibrosis, whereas CAR‐macrophage(CAR‐M) approaches have demonstrated targeted phagocytosis and microenvironmental remodeling. Evidence for CAR‐natural killer cells (CAR‐NK) in non‐oncological diseases is currently limited to preclinical studies and an individual‐patient observation, despite their potential advantages for allogeneic and off‐the‐shelf manufacturing. This Review critically compares CAR‐T, CAR‐M, and CAR‐NK platforms, examines emerging unconventional immune‐cell and iPSC‐derived products, and evaluates programmable and in vivo CAR‐engineering strategies. We propose “controllable spatiotemporal reprogramming” as a framework linking target specificity, tissue distribution, activity duration, reversibility, manufacturing, and disease‐specific safety requirements.

summary.one_liner: 本文评述CAR工程细胞疗法从肿瘤拓展至纤维化与免疫炎症疾病，比较CAR-T/M/NK平台并提出可控时空重编程框架。
summary.innovation: 系统比较CAR-T、CAR-M、CAR-NK在非肿瘤疾病中的疗效与安全性证据；提出“可控时空重编程”整合靶向性、分布、活性、可逆性与制造要求；评估新型免疫细胞、iPSC衍生及体内CAR工程策略。
summary.significance: 为CAR疗法超越癌症的应用提供了系统性评估与设计框架，有助于指导纤维化和自身免疫病的精准细胞治疗研发。该框架可促进不同CAR平台的理性选择与临床转化，推动通用型、可控型疗法的进展。

papers.title: GSTM4 Suppresses Prostate Cancer Progression by Targeting TRIM27‐mediated ACLY Ubiquitination and Lipid Metabolism
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Prostate cancer (PCa) is a prevalent malignancy in men, and lipid metabolic reprogramming contributes to its progression and therapeutic resistance. However, the drivers of lipid metabolic dysregulation in PCa remain incompletely defined. Through transcriptomic sequencing of PCa patient tissues, we identified glutathione S‐transferase mu 4 (GSTM4) as a novel regulator of lipid metabolism. GSTM4 was significantly downregulated in PCa tissues and negatively correlated with triglyceride content. Functionally, GSTM4 overexpression inhibited PCa cell proliferation and migration, thereby suppressing tumor development and bone metastasis. Mechanistically, GSTM4 acted independently of its classical detoxification activity by interacting with tripartite motif‐containing 27 (TRIM27) and ATP citrate lyase (ACLY), a key enzyme in de novo lipid synthesis. GSTM4 promoted TRIM27‐mediated ubiquitination and degradation of ACLY at lysine 554, reducing acetyl‐CoA production and lipid accumulation. This inhibition of lipid synthesis suppressed PCa growth and metastasis in vitro and in subcutaneous, orthotopic, and bone metastasis models. Moreover, ETC‐1002 (bempedoic acid), a clinically approved ACLY inhibitor, showed therapeutic potential against PCa. These findings reveal a non‐canonical GSTM4‐TRIM27‐ACLY axis that regulates lipid metabolism and represents a promising therapeutic target for advanced PCa.

summary.one_liner: 发现GSTM4通过TRIM27介导ACLY泛素化降解抑制脂质合成，从而抑制前列腺癌进展与骨转移。
summary.innovation: 首次揭示GSTM4非经典解毒功能，通过TRIM27-ACLY轴调控脂质代谢；定位ACLY K554泛素化位点，阐明脂代谢重编程新机制；证明ETC-1002对前列腺癌具有治疗潜力。
summary.significance: 为前列腺癌脂代谢异常提供了新靶点，GSTM4-TRIM27-ACLY轴有望成为晚期前列腺癌治疗标志物。临床药物ETC-1002的再利用展示了快速转化前景，对耐药性及骨转移患者具有潜在临床价值。

papers.title: Space Jam‐Ming: Generating Interstitial Space Using Fragmented Granular GelMA to Investigate Novel Paradigms of Cancer Metastasis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The tumor microenvironment undergoes extensive remodeling during cancer progression, resulting in increased collagen, altered tissue mechanics, and the formation of collagen tracks that permit migration. However, how the extracellular matrix (ECM) regulates cellular plasticity remains less known. Cellular plasticity is essential for successful metastasis, as cells undergo epithelial‐to‐mesenchymal transition and adherent‐to‐suspension transition (AST). Studies have begun to use 3D photo‐crosslinkable hydrogels, but, unlike in vivo ECM, hydrogel stiffness is inextricably linked to porosity. In this study, we propose a fragmented gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) scaffold that controls stiffness independently from porosity. When encapsulated as single cells, non‐metastatic breast cancer cells do not exhibit growth restriction, whilst pre‐engineered metastatic breast cancer cells show altered mechanosensitivity and enhanced migration ( p < 0.05). We next study the role of AST in cellular migration and observe similar velocity to invasive metastatic cells. Interestingly, non‐metastatic cells showed AST‐dependent migration within interstitial spaces, which was enhanced in the stiff scaffold ( p < 0.05). AST induction significantly increased Lamin A/C (associated with providing nuclear stability for circulating tumor cells) and reduced nuclear yes‐associated protein (YAP) (necessary for cell detachment). Our data highlights the importance of incorporating micro‐scale porosity and presents a promising platform for the study of cellular growth and migration.

summary.one_liner: 开发碎片化颗粒GelMA水凝胶，独立调控刚度与孔隙，模拟间质空间研究癌细胞可塑性与转移机制。
summary.innovation: 构建碎片化颗粒GelMA支架实现刚度与孔隙度的独立控制；揭示非转移性乳腺癌细胞可通过AST机制在间质间隙中迁移且受刚度调节；发现AST诱导上调Lamin A/C并下调核YAP，关联循环肿瘤细胞稳定性与脱落。
summary.significance: 该平台突破了传统水凝胶刚度-孔隙耦合限制，更真实模拟体内ECM间质微环境，为研究细胞生长、迁移及癌症转移范式提供有力工具，有助于揭示ECM调控细胞可塑性的新机制，并可能指导抗转移药物筛选与纳米医学递送策略设计。

papers.title: AARS1‐Mediated H3K27 Lactylation Rewires Glycolysis to Sustain Aggressive and Recurrent Bladder Cancer
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Recurrence and progression remain major clinical challenges in bladder cancer (BC), yet the mechanisms linking glycolysis to persistent malignant states remain incompletely defined. Here, we identify alanyl tRNA synthetase 1 (AARS1) as a clinically relevant driver of aggressive and recurrent BC. AARS1 is upregulated in BC tissues, enriched in muscle invasive and recurrent tumors, and associated with unfavorable survival. Functionally, AARS1 promotes proliferation, epithelial mesenchymal transition, invasion, apoptosis resistance, tumor growth, and lung colonization. Mechanistically, AARS1 enhances phosphoinositide 3 kinase (PI3K) pathway output, glycolytic flux, and lactate production. Increased lactate availability is linked to histone H3 lysine 27 lactylation (H3K27la) enrichment at the hexokinase 2 (HK2) promoter, increased chromatin accessibility, and HK2 transcriptional activation, supporting an HK2 centered metabolic and epigenetic reinforcement program. HK2 perturbation attenuates AARS1 associated glycolytic and malignant phenotypes. Through structure guided screening and surface plasmon resonance validation, we further identified eltrombopag as an AARS1 binding compound that pharmacologically suppressed the AARS1 associated PI3K, glycolysis, lactate, H3K27la, and HK2 program and restrained tumor progression in preclinical models. These findings define an AARS1 associated metabolic and epigenetic program in BC and nominate AARS1 targeting strategies as a direction for further therapeutic development.

summary.one_liner: 研究发现AARS1通过促进乳酸生成诱导H3K27乳酸化修饰激活HK2，形成代谢-表观遗传正反馈环路驱动膀胱癌恶性进展与复发。
summary.innovation: 首次揭示AARS1作为膀胱癌侵袭与复发的临床相关驱动因子；阐明AARS1通过乳酸介导H3K27la修饰激活HK2的代谢-表观遗传交叉调控新机制；通过结构筛选发现eltrombopag可靶向AARS1并抑制其促癌程序。
summary.significance: 该研究为理解膀胱癌持续恶性状态的代谢与表观遗传机制提供了新视角，并揭示了AARS1-H3K27la-HK2信号轴作为潜在治疗靶点。eltrombopag作为已批准药物，有望被快速转化用于靶向AARS1的膀胱癌治疗策略开发。

papers.title: A syringe-based nanoliquid biopsy platform integrating magnetic immunocapture and electrochemical assay for circulating tumor cells enumeration and molecular profiling in NSCLC patients
papers.abstract: The number and phenotypic profile of circulating tumor cells (CTCs) have demonstrated their capability in cancer diagnosis and therapeutic efficacy assessment, while programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) and major histocompatibility complex class Ⅱ (MHC-Ⅱ) emerge as core predictive biomarkers for cancer immunotherapy response. Despite their clinical significance, simplified methodologies with potential for point-of-care (POC) adaptation that enable simultaneous detection of CTCs and these two immune-related surface proteins in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remain scarce, which was quite critical for comprehensive liquid biopsy - based cancer management. In this work, an integrated bioassay for synchronous enumeration of CTCs and quantitative profiling of PD-L1/MHC-Ⅱ expression on captured CTCs from NSCLC patient blood samples was developed. A magnetic immunocapture probe with nanorod architecture was functionalized with dual targeting aptamers, which enabled an enhanced capture efficiency toward CTCs up to 95%. Meanwhile, for differential detection of PD-L1 and MHC-Ⅱ, CdTe and PbS quantum dots (QDs) were conjugated with specific antibodies against PD-L1 and MHC-Ⅱ, respectively, with quantification enabled by electrochemical voltammetric analysis of Cd 2+ and Pb 2+ released from QDs. To simplify assay operation, a disposable syringe filter equipped with nitrocellulose (NC) membrane was employed as the platform for immobilizing antibodies and immuno-recognition. The robustness and efficiency of the integrated system were validated by investigating the correlations between CTC counts, PD-L1/MHC-Ⅱ expression levels, and disease progression in NSCLC patients, which highlighted its potential as a powerful tool for precision immunotherapy guidance. Graphical Abstract

summary.one_liner: 开发基于注射器的纳米液体活检平台，实现NSCLC患者循环肿瘤细胞的计数及PD-L1/MHC-Ⅱ分子分型。
summary.innovation: 采用纳米棒磁免疫捕获探针结合双靶向适配体，CTC捕获效率高达95%；利用CdTe和PbS量子点标记抗体，通过电化学溶出伏安法同步定量PD-L1和MHC-Ⅱ；以一次性注射器滤器结合NC膜简化操作，利于即时检测。
summary.significance: 该平台实现了CTC计数与免疫相关蛋白表达的一体化检测，可用于NSCLC患者疾病进展监测和免疫治疗反应预测。其操作简便、适应床旁检测，为精准免疫治疗指导提供了有力工具，具有临床转化前景。

papers.title: AI-driven discovery of self-assembled antimicrobial peptides with dual antibacterial and wound-healing functions against multidrug-resistant infections
papers.abstract: The rapid emergence of multidrug-resistant bacterial infections, particularly those caused by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii , poses a critical challenge to global healthcare. Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are promising alternatives, yet their design is challenged by vast sequence space and the need to balance potency with safety. This study establishes an deep learning model AMP-SAGE to achieve intelligent screening of a virtual decapeptide library composed of four amino acids (lysine (K), tryptophan (W), phenylalanine (F), and arginine (R)), and further mines for peptides with self-assembly potential that feature an FF self-assembly motif at the core flanked by R-W-K residues, thereby enabling the de novo discovery of self-assembling AMPs. Ten candidate peptides with predicted antimicrobial probability scores≥0.5 and self-assembly potential are randomly screened. After systematic biological evaluation, R2 and K4 are selected for further investigation. The candidate peptides R2 and K4 show broad-spectrum activity (minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC): 1–32 μM) and achieve>99.99% bacterial killing within 1–2 h. Spectroscopic characterization reveals distinct self-assembly behaviors. They operate via multimodal mechanisms, including membrane disruption and reactive oxygen species (ROS) induction, and exhibit high biosafety (hemolysis TI: 150.55 for R2, 1505.75 for K4) and stability. In murine wound models, both peptides significantly reduce bacterial loads, accelerate healing, and promote organized collagen deposition. This work establishes an AI-accelerated pipeline for developing self-assembled AMPs with combined antimicrobial and wound-healing functions against multidrug-resistant infections.

summary.one_liner: AI模型AMP-SAGE筛选自组装抗菌肽，兼具杀菌与促创面愈合功能，应对多重耐药菌感染。
summary.innovation: 构建深度学习模型AMP-SAGE，智能筛选千亿级十肽序列空间；发现含FF自组装核心及R-W-K侧翼的肽类，实现从头设计自组装抗菌肽；候选肽R2和K4通过膜破裂与ROS诱导等多模态机制，兼具高生物安全性和促愈合活性。
summary.significance: 该研究为多重耐药菌感染提供了新型肽类候选药物，解决传统抗菌肽设计中 potency 与安全性平衡难题。AI加速自组装抗菌肽的发现流程，有望推动抗菌和创面修复双功能疗法的临床转化。

papers.title: Bioactive 10-shogaol liposome for ameliorating endotoxemia-associated acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) via restraining neutrophil extracellular trap release
papers.abstract: Sepsis is a life-threatening condition caused by a dysregulated host response to infection, leading to organ dysfunctions. Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is the most common complication of sepsis with high mortality and pathological characteristics of uncontrolled neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) release and excessive inflammation. However, current therapeutic strategies for sepsis-induced ARDS face limitations, including potential toxicity, suboptimal efficacy, and poor bioavailability. In this timely study, we encapsulated 10-shogaol (SA), a natural anti-inflammatory compound derived from Zingiber officinale , into liposomes to yield SA-Lipo for the treatment of endotoxemia-induced ARDS. SA-Lipo initially demonstrated stable physicochemical properties, reliable biocompatibility, and increased bioavailability. A series of in vitro experiments subsequently validated that SA-Lipo significantly inhibited inflammation, oxidative stress, and excessive NET release. The in vivo evaluation in an endotoxemia-induced ARDS mouse model further revealed that SA-Lipo attenuated pulmonary dysfunction, alleviated lung edema, reduced inflammatory mediators, and promoted repair of pulmonary pathological injury. Mechanistically, RNA sequencing of lung tissues suggested that SA-Lipo may exert its therapeutic effects by inhibiting multiple immune- and inflammation-related signaling pathways. Molecular docking, western blotting, and immunofluorescent staining supported the potential of SA-Lipo to inhibit the activation of the proinflammatory MyD88/NF-κB pathway and PAD4/Cit-H3-mediated NET release in endotoxemia-induced ARDS, although the causal relationship between these two cascades remains unclear. Taken together, our findings consolidated the availability of a new lipid-nanomedicine SA-lipo for the treatment of endotoxemia-induced ARDS via controlling NET release and excessive inflammation, hence providing a promising therapeutic strategy for acute inflammatory lung diseases.

summary.one_liner: 将姜来源的10-姜酚包封于脂质体，通过抑制NET释放和炎症治疗内毒素血症相关ARDS。
summary.innovation: 首次将10-shogaol脂质体用于脓毒症相关ARDS治疗；阐明其通过抑制MyD88/NF-κB通路和PAD4/Cit-H3介导的NET释放发挥疗效；构建稳定的纳米递送系统提高生物利用度并降低毒性。
summary.significance: 该研究为急性炎症性肺病提供了新型脂质纳米药物策略。SA-Lipo兼具良好生物相容性和多靶点调控能力，有望改善现有疗法疗效差、毒性大等问题，并为治疗脓毒症相关ARDS及其他急性肺损伤疾病奠定基础。

papers.title: Neutrophil-mediated delivery of paclitaxel and Bcl-2 siRNA reverses chemoresistance in bone-metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
papers.abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) bone metastasis remains a significant clinical challenge owing to limited drug across the blood - bone marrow barrier as well as the chemotherapy resistance. Overexpression of the anti-apoptosis protein B-cell lymphoma-2 (Bcl-2) and activation of ATP-binding cassette transporter-mediated drug efflux pathway contribute substantially to paclitaxel (PTX) resistance, leading to poor therapeutic outcomes. Herein, we developed a biomimetic bone-targeted nanotherapeutic by integrating neutrophil “hitchhiking” technology with hyaluronic acid (HA)-modified lipid nanoparticles co-loaded with PTX and Bcl-2 small interfering RNA (siRNA) (BP-HLNP@NEs) for the therapy of TNBC bone metastasis. Leveraging neutrophil-mediated bone marrow homing and HA-CD44 receptor-mediated active targeting, BP-HLNP@NEs efficiently traversed the blood-bone marrow barrier, enhanced accumulation within metastatic bone lesions, and reduced off-target toxicity in the liver and spleen. Following cellular internalization, the co-delivered PTX and Bcl-2 siRNA synergistically suppressed tumor growth by silencing Bcl-2 expression, inhibiting the NF-κB/P-glycoprotein resistance pathway, restoring chemosensitivity, and activating caspase-mediated apoptosis. In orthotopic bone metastatic TNBC models, BP-HLNP@NEs markedly inhibited tumor progression, reduced secondary lung metastasis, preserved bone architecture, and elicited antitumor immune responses. Collectively, this biomimetic delivery platform overcomes both biological delivery barriers and chemoresistance, providing a promising therapeutic strategy for the treatment of TNBC bone metastasis.

summary.one_liner: 构建中性粒细胞伪装及HA修饰的脂质纳米粒共递送紫杉醇和Bcl-2 siRNA，逆转三阴性乳腺癌骨转移化疗耐药。
summary.innovation: 整合中性粒细胞搭便车技术与HA-CD44主动靶向，跨越血-骨髓屏障高效富集于骨转移灶；共递送PTX与Bcl-2 siRNA，协同抑制NF-κB/P-糖蛋白通路并恢复化疗敏感性
summary.significance: 该仿生递药平台同时克服生理屏障与化疗耐药，显著抑制骨转移肿瘤生长并减少肺转移，兼具骨保护与免疫激活效应，为三阴性乳腺癌骨转移提供有前景的临床转化策略。

papers.title: A dynamic assembly-based logic-gated tetrahedral DNAzyme prodrug for mitochondrial metabolic intervention and enhanced chemodynamic therapy
papers.abstract: Chemodynamic therapy (CDT) offers an innovative strategy for tumor treatment, but its efficacy and selectivity are significantly hampered by limited intratumoral Fenton reaction efficiency and a lack of organelle-level precision. To this end, we developed a dynamic assembly-based logic-gated intelligent proximity-enhanced tetrahedral-scaffold DNAzyme prodrug (PETS). By enabling programmable activation and sequential control of key biochemical events (including targeting, assembly, therapy initiation), the PETS achieves organelle-precise metabolic reprogramming intervention and CDT. PETS forms linear assemblies in tumor cells via logic-gated recognition of PTK7 and miRNA, then targets mitochondria through triphenylphosphonium (TPP). This disrupts mitochondrial metabolism, inhibits tumor cell proliferation and migration, and induces oxidative stress to generate substantial ROS, providing substrates for the Fenton-like reaction. Meanwhile, dynamic assembly activates PETSzyme, which produces abundant •OH via a highly efficient Fenton-like reaction, causing significant tumor cell killing. Compared with traditional G4 DNAzyme, PETSzyme exhibits an approximately four-fold enhancement in catalytic performance under the synergistic effects of proximity enhancement and the tetrahedral scaffold. In tumor-bearing mouse models, PETS demonstrated advantages in targeted delivery, controllable activation, minimal side effects, and enhanced CDT efficacy. This study provides a unique and promising platform for highly efficient and safe CDT, holding substantial potential for future clinical translation and improved cancer therapy.

summary.one_liner: 开发逻辑门控四面体DNAzyme前药，实现线粒体代谢干预与增强的化学动力学治疗。
summary.innovation: 动态组装与逻辑门控实现PTK7/miRNA双重识别及序贯可控激活；四面体支架与邻近效应使DNAzyme催化性能提升约四倍；靶向线粒体代谢重编程并增强Fenton反应效率。
summary.significance: 该平台解决了CDT疗效低和选择性差的问题，提供细胞器级精准干预，在肿瘤模型中展示出靶向递送、可控激活和低副作用优势，为高效安全癌症治疗提供可临床转化新策略。

papers.title: A light-triggered hydrogel depot of homotypic müller membrane vesicles enables cell-selective drug delivery and neurogenic reprogramming
papers.abstract: Reprogramming Müller glia into neurons remains challenging due to limited cell selectivity and the transient pharmacokinetics associated with intravitreal agents. We aimed to develop a Müller cell–targeted, light-addressable drug delivery platform capable of achieving sustained, localized modulation of regenerative signaling to enhance glial-to-neuron reprogramming. To this end, we engineered a photoresponsive hydrogel–membrane vesicle depot that integrates homotypic recognition with light-triggered in situ stabilization, enabling sustained and Müller cell–selective delivery of regenerative pathway modulators. Müller cell membrane–derived vesicles were preloaded with the NOTCH inhibitor DAPT and the STAT3 inhibitor SH-4-54, then embedded within a biocompatible, photocrosslinkable hydrogel to enable localized release upon 405 nm irradiation. The platform was evaluated in primary Müller cells, NMDA-injured mouse retinas, and zebrafish retinal injury models in combination with Ascl1-mediated reprogramming. Targeting efficiency, retention, regenerative outcomes, and signaling mechanisms were assessed using cellular, histological, transcriptomic, and biochemical analyses to define the molecular basis of Müller cell-mediated retinal neuron regeneration. The photoresponsive hydrogel–membrane vesicle depot enabled sustained and Müller cell-selective delivery of regenerative pathway modulators through light-triggered in situ stabilization. In primary Müller cells, the depot synergized with Ascl1 to promote cell-cycle re-entry and enhance neurogenic reprogramming. In NMDA-injured mouse retinas, the depot preferentially accumulated in Müller cells and significantly increased their proliferative response following Ascl1-AAV transduction. Comparable regenerative effects were observed in an NMDA-injured zebrafish model. Mechanistically, hydrogel-mediated delivery prolonged Ascl1-induced RAP1 activation and sustained downstream MAPK and PI3K–AKT signaling, thereby establishing a persistent pro-regenerative signaling program that promoted Müller cell proliferation and neuronal differentiation. This light-addressable, Müller cell-targeted pharmacological depot represents a versatile biomaterial-based strategy to enhance transcription factor–induced Müller cell reprogramming for retinal neuroregeneration.

summary.one_liner: 开发光触发水凝胶-膜囊泡贮库，实现Müller细胞选择性药物递送和光控原位稳定，增强视网膜神经再生。
summary.innovation: 整合同型Müller细胞膜囊泡识别与405 nm光触发原位稳定化，实现细胞选择性、持续释放；共递送NOTCH抑制剂DAPT与STAT3抑制剂SH-4-54，与Ascl1协同促进神经重编程；在哺乳动物和斑马鱼视网膜损伤模型中验证了可调控的再生效果。
summary.significance: 该平台克服了视网膜内药物半衰期短和非选择性难题，为转录因子诱导的Müller细胞重编程提供了可控的局部药物微环境。通过光控释放延长RAP1/MAPK/PI3K-AKT信号，有望用于临床视网膜变性疾病的再生治疗，并为细胞靶向生物材料递送系统设计提供新范式。

papers.title: Electroactive nanoplatforms in regenerative medicine: mechanisms, design strategies, and translational applications
papers.abstract: Bioelectrical signaling represents a fundamental yet often overlooked regulatory layer in tissue regeneration. Disruption of the bioelectrical microenvironment following injury remains a critical barrier to effective tissue repair, while current electrical stimulation strategies, largely dependent on external or implantable devices, are constrained by limited spatial precision, invasiveness, and poor adaptability. Recent electroactive nanoplatforms enable in situ generation, transmission, and dynamic modulation of bioelectrical cues within regenerative microenvironments. This review first delineates multiscale mechanisms of bioelectrical regulation and then classifies conductive, piezoelectric, triboelectric, and magnetoelectric nanomaterials according to their signal-generation and transduction modes. We further present a platform-oriented design framework in which electroactive components are integrated with hydrogels, fibrous scaffolds, particulate systems, microneedles, 3D-printed scaffolds, organoids, and bioelectronic interfaces. Tissue-specific applications in skin, bone, cartilage, nerve, and cardiac repair illustrate how electrical output, mechanical properties, architecture, degradation, and biological function should be matched to regenerative requirements. Overall, electroactive nanoplatforms are evolving from passive electrical mediators into programmable interfaces for reconstructing regenerative bioelectrical microenvironments.

summary.one_liner: 综述电活性纳米平台通过原位调控生物电信号，促进组织再生的机制、设计策略与应用前景。
summary.innovation: 系统阐述生物电调控的多尺度机制；按信号产生与转导模式分类导电、压电、摩擦电及磁电纳米材料；提出面向平台的设计框架，整合水凝胶、3D打印支架、类器官等系统。
summary.significance: 该平台突破了传统电刺激依赖外部设备的局限，实现原位动态调控，推动再生医学从被动电介质向可编程生物电微环境重构发展，为皮肤、骨、神经及心脏等组织修复提供了新策略。

papers.title: A Sonochemically Activatable Pro‐Molecular Glue for Spatiotemporally Controlled Targeted Protein Degradation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Molecular glues offer a powerful paradigm for targeting undruggable proteins, yet their clinical translation is frequently impeded by on‐target, off‐tumor toxicities. Developing activatable strategies for molecular glues remains a formidable challenge due to their compact, featureless scaffolds that resist chemical modification. Herein, we report a sonochemically activatable pro‐molecular glue strategy for spatiotemporally controlled targeted protein degradation. By identifying the critical aniline group, a structural linchpin for neosubstrate recruitment, as the optimal caging site, we rationally designed a pro‐lenalidomide (PL) equipped with a singlet oxygen ( 1 O 2 )‐cleavable self‐immolative linker. This prodrug is co‐assembled with a semiconducting polymer (SP) sonosensitizer to construct an activatable nanoplatform. Upon ultrasound irradiation, the in situ‐generated 1 O 2 functions as a precise chemical switch, triggering the oxidative cleavage of the linker to uncage the molecular glue within the tumor microenvironment. This “off‐to‐on” capability orchestrates a potent antitumor response by synergizing sonodynamic stress with reinstated IKZF1/3 degradation. Uniquely, this strategy confines pharmacological activity strictly to the tumor site, thereby eliciting robust therapeutic efficacy while broadening the therapeutic window. This work establishes a generalizable chemical toolkit for designing activatable molecular glues, paving the way for safer precision cancer therapies.

summary.one_liner: 开发超声可激活的前分子胶水，实现时空可控的靶向蛋白降解与肿瘤精准治疗。
summary.innovation: 识别苯胺基团为关键笼蔽位点，设计单线态氧可裂解自消除连接子的前来那度胺；构建声敏剂与前药共组装纳米平台，实现超声触发的原位激活；通过“关-开”机制协同声动力应激与IKZF1/3降解，限制药物活性于肿瘤部位。
summary.significance: 为可激活分子胶水提供通用化学工具，解决其难以改造和脱靶毒性问题。该策略拓展分子胶水的治疗窗口，有望推动更安全的精准癌症治疗。

papers.title: Molecular Tailoring of Fluorescent Agents Toward SICTERS‐Active Raman Probes
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Self‐stacked small molecules relying on the SICTERS mechanism have emerged as a promising platform for ultrasensitive in vivo Raman imaging. However, only a limited number of SICTERS‑active molecules have been reported to date, constraining their broader applications. Herein, we reported a rational strategy to transform conventional fluorophores into SICTERS probes based on two fundamental findings. One is that sulfur‐to‐selenium substitution is capable of suppressing radiative decay for fluorescence quenching, distinct from its conventional role in red‐shifting emission. The other is that N‐alkylation enables tuning the absorption profile for Raman enhancement, beyond its traditional use in improving molecular solubility. Mechanistic studies validate these findings. Consequently, a novel SICTERS‐active molecule (ATSe) was synthesized from a representative fluorophore (HTS).
